items.name: arnaudvolp/hero-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Two-column hero section with an announcement badge, headline, subtitle, and primary/secondary CTA buttons. Place it as the first section of your landing page to immediately communicate your product value and drive sign-ups.

items.name: arnaudvolp/hero-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Centered hero section with a grid background, headline, CTA buttons, and a featured product screenshot. Use it above the fold on app or SaaS landing pages to visually showcase your product and guide visitors toward action.

items.name: arnaudvolp/hero-03
items.description: [Shadcnship] Two-column hero with star rating social proof, key statistics card, and call-to-action buttons. Use it when you need to build immediate trust and highlight traction metrics on SaaS or agency landing pages.

items.name: arnaudvolp/hero-05
items.description: [Shadcnship] Minimal full-screen centered hero with headline, subtitle, and CTA buttons on a clean background. Use it as a distraction-free entry point for products that rely on strong copy rather than visuals.

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Three-column feature grid displaying product benefits as icon cards with titles and descriptions. Use it to quickly communicate your product's key capabilities anywhere on a SaaS or marketing landing page.

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-03
items.description: [Shadcnship] Two-column image grid showcasing product features with visual screenshots and short descriptions. Use it to let your interface speak for itself while giving context for each feature shown.

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-04
items.description: [Shadcnship] Three-column icon card grid for listing product features with icons, titles, and short descriptions. Use it as a lightweight, fast-loading feature showcase section that stays scannable on any screen size.

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-05
items.description: [Shadcnship] Interactive accordion feature section where clicking each item reveals a corresponding product screenshot. Use it to keep the section compact while letting users explore features at their own pace.

items.name: arnaudvolp/pricing-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Three-column pricing table with a monthly/yearly billing toggle, a highlighted recommended plan, and feature lists. Use it on dedicated pricing pages to help users choose the right plan and increase conversion.

items.name: arnaudvolp/pricing-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Side-by-side pricing comparison table with feature rows and checkmark/cross indicators. Use it when your plans share many features and you want to make the differences crystal clear for potential buyers.

items.name: arnaudvolp/pricing-03
items.description: [Shadcnship] Three-column pricing section with a tabbed billing toggle, feature lists with separators, and CTA buttons. Use it as an alternative pricing layout when you want to visually emphasize the most popular plan.

items.name: arnaudvolp/pricing-04
items.description: [Shadcnship] Three-column pricing section with a highlighted popular plan featuring a dark gradient background, monthly/yearly billing toggle with a green indicator, and custom price display. Use it for SaaS products that want to visually differentiate the recommended plan.

items.name: arnaudvolp/pricing-stripe-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Connected pricing section that fetches products and prices live from the Stripe API and renders them as cards. Each card shows the plan name, description, amount, and a checkout button that creates a Stripe Checkout session.

items.name: arnaudvolp/cta-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Horizontal call-to-action section with a heading, description, and primary/secondary CTA buttons. Use it at the end of landing page sections to nudge visitors toward sign-up or purchase at the right moment.

items.name: arnaudvolp/cta-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] CTA card with an app or device mockup image, headline, and action button. Use it to close a landing page with a visually driven conversion prompt that showcases your product in context.

items.name: arnaudvolp/cta-03
items.description: [Shadcnship] Newsletter subscription CTA with an email input and a submit button. Use it to capture leads directly within your content by embedding a low-friction email signup anywhere on the page.

items.name: arnaudvolp/cta-04
items.description: [Shadcnship] Centered CTA card with a subtle grid background, bold headline, description, and action button. Use it as a section-closing block that re-engages visitors who scrolled past earlier conversion points.

items.name: arnaudvolp/faq-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Single-column accordion FAQ section with expandable question and answer items. Use it on landing pages, pricing pages, or support sections to address common objections and reduce incoming support requests.

items.name: arnaudvolp/faq-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Two-column accordion FAQ grid for displaying a larger set of questions side by side. Use it when you have ten or more questions and want to keep the FAQ section compact and well-organized.

items.name: arnaudvolp/testimonial-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Scrolling testimonial section with two animated marquee rows of customer review cards. Use it as a social proof belt on landing pages to continuously surface customer validation without requiring any user interaction.

items.name: arnaudvolp/testimonial-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Masonry grid wall-of-love section displaying multiple customer reviews in a varied layout. Use it on marketing sites where you have rich social proof and want to display it in a visually engaging way.

items.name: arnaudvolp/stat-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Stats section displaying key product or business metrics in individual icon cards with labels. Use it to quantify your impact on landing pages and give visitors concrete, trust-building numbers.

items.name: arnaudvolp/stat-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Horizontal stats section with large numbers and labels separated by dividers. Use it as a compact, eye-catching metrics strip that fits naturally between any two sections on a landing page.

items.name: arnaudvolp/logo-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Logo cloud section with two infinite scrolling marquee rows showcasing partner or customer logos. Use it immediately after your hero section to build trust through brand association with recognized names.

items.name: arnaudvolp/contact-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Contact section with a card-wrapped form (name, email, message) alongside company contact information. Use it on contact or about pages to give visitors a direct, professional way to reach your team.

items.name: arnaudvolp/footer-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Multi-column footer with company branding, grouped navigation links, and social media icons. Use it on every page of your site to provide consistent navigation, important links, and legal information at the bottom.

items.name: arnaudvolp/navbar-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Responsive navbar with dropdown navigation menus on desktop and an accordion-based mobile menu. Use it as your site-wide header to provide clear, accessible navigation across all screen sizes and devices.

items.name: arnaudvolp/team-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Team section displaying members in cards with profile photos, names, job roles, and social links. Use it on about pages to humanize your brand and help visitors connect with the people behind your product.

items.name: arnaudvolp/social-icons
items.description: [Shadcnship] Collection of SVG social media brand icons (GitHub, Google, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, and more) as composable React components. Use them in login forms, footers, navbars, or any UI that references external social platforms.

items.name: arnaudvolp/login-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Split-screen login page with a gradient background on one side and an email/password form with OAuth buttons on the other. Use it as a drop-in authentication page when you need a polished login experience fast.

items.name: arnaudvolp/blog-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Blog section with post cards featuring cover images, category badges, titles, excerpts, and author info. Use it on content sites or product blogs to display articles in a clean, scannable grid layout.

items.name: arnaudvolp/register-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Centered registration card with full name, email, and password fields, including client-side validation. Use it as a clean sign-up page for any web application that requires user account creation.

items.name: arnaudvolp/background-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Customizable square grid background component with adjustable line color, grid size, and opacity props. Use it as a decorative backdrop for hero sections, cards, or any area that benefits from a subtle geometric texture.

items.name: arnaudvolp/background-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Customizable dot pattern background with adjustable dot color, size, spacing, and opacity. Use it behind hero sections or feature areas to add visual depth without distracting from your main content.

items.name: arnaudvolp/background-03
items.description: [Shadcnship] Customizable diagonal stripes background with adjustable line color, width, spacing, and opacity. Use it to add a subtle textile-like pattern to sections, cards, or full-page backgrounds.

items.name: arnaudvolp/background-04
items.description: [Shadcnship] Customizable vertical lines background with adjustable line count, width, color, and opacity. Use it behind hero or pricing sections to create a structured, architectural visual backdrop.

items.name: arnaudvolp/background-05
items.description: [Shadcnship] Interactive grid background where individual cells highlight on hover with a configurable glow color. Use it behind hero sections or interactive showcases to add a playful, dynamic feel to an otherwise static layout.

items.name: arnaudvolp/changelog-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Timeline-style changelog listing product updates with version numbers, release dates, and descriptions. Use it on product or documentation sites to communicate release history and build trust with power users.

items.name: arnaudvolp/integration-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Dark-themed integration showcase with a curved connection path drawn between tool logos. Use it on landing pages to visually communicate how your product fits into your users' existing toolchain.

items.name: arnaudvolp/banner-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Full-width announcement banner with a short message, an arrow link, and a dismiss button. Use it at the top of any page to surface time-sensitive promotions, feature launches, or important product updates.

items.name: arnaudvolp/waitlist-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Waitlist signup section with an email capture form and social proof avatars showing subscriber count. Use it on coming-soon pages to build an audience before your product launches and validate demand early.

items.name: arnaudvolp/waitlist-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Waitlist section with a Supabase-connected email form that stores submissions directly to your database. Use it when your backend is Supabase and you want a zero-config waitlist with persistent storage out of the box.

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-06
items.description: [Shadcnship] Four-step process section with numbered badges, step titles, descriptions, and an optional screenshot. Use it to explain how your product works, step by step, on landing and onboarding pages.

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-07
items.description: [Shadcnship] Full-width video player section with a poster image and an animated play button overlay. Use it on landing pages to embed a product demo or explainer video where showing beats telling.

items.name: arnaudvolp/comparison-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Product comparison table with images, specification rows, and checkmark/cross value indicators. Use it on product or pricing pages to help users make confident purchase decisions by clearly highlighting key differences.

items.name: arnaudvolp/dashboard-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Sales analytics dashboard with revenue KPI cards, interactive bar charts, and a recent orders table. Use it as a starting point for admin panels, analytics views, or any SaaS backend interface.

items.name: arnaudvolp/logo-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Client logo grid with clickable industry and technology category filters and featured logo cards. Use it on portfolio or case study pages to showcase logos while allowing visitors to filter by what matters to them.

items.name: arnaudvolp/login-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] Full-stack split-screen auth page with Supabase email/password login and OAuth provider support. Use it as a complete, ready-to-ship login page when your backend is powered by Supabase Auth.

items.name: arnaudvolp/data-table-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] Paginated data table with global search and sortable columns. Two modes: pass a data array for client-side rendering, or a Supabase table name for server-side pagination. Supports text, date, badge, tags, and status cell types.

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-09
items.description: [Shadcnship] An integrations grid with icon cards in a 3x2 layout and social proof ratings

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-08
items.description: [Shadcnship] A bento-style feature grid with a large featured card and icon-based feature cards

items.name: arnaudvolp/hero-04
items.description: [Shadcnship] A centered hero with multi-image cards below at varying heights

items.name: arnaudvolp/stat-03
items.description: [Shadcnship] A bento-grid stats section mixing images and metric cards

items.name: arnaudvolp/navbar-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] A responsive navbar with mega menu, grouped columns, featured panel, and mobile accordion

items.name: arnaudvolp/cookie-01
items.description: [Shadcnship] A floating cookie consent card with accept button and learn more link

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-11
items.description: [Shadcnship] A feature section with a split left-aligned header and two large image cards with text below

items.name: arnaudvolp/testimonial-03
items.description: [Shadcnship] A two-column testimonial carousel with prev/next navigation and portrait image cards

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-12
items.description: [Shadcnship] A feature section with a large clickable title list on the left and an image with description on the right that updates on selection

items.name: arnaudvolp/image-compare
items.description: [Shadcnship] A before/after image slider — drag the divider to compare both sides in real time

items.name: arnaudvolp/hero-06
items.description: [Shadcnship] A full-screen centered hero with background image, announcement badge, and CTA buttons

items.name: arnaudvolp/cta-05
items.description: [Shadcnship] A centered CTA with a fanned stack of rotated photos, badge, contrast title, and pill button

items.name: arnaudvolp/stat-04
items.description: [Shadcnship] A stats section with minimal navbar, large headline, and icons orbiting a center avatar

items.name: arnaudvolp/stat-05
items.description: [Shadcnship] A split stats section with badge, title, CTA link, and avatars on the left and an asymmetric grid of metric cards on the right

items.name: arnaudvolp/stat-06
items.description: [Shadcnship] A stats section in a rounded card with intro paragraph, dark hatched metric cards, and an outline pill button

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-13
items.description: [Shadcnship] A how-it-works section with a 3-card carousel, progress tab bar, and active step details

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-14
items.description: [Shadcnship] A how-it-works section with centered header and a 2-column grid of image cards

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-15
items.description: [Shadcnship] A centered feature section with badge, phone mockup on a dot pattern background, and highlighted description

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-16
items.description: [Shadcnship] A two-column feature section with labels, titles, learn-more links, and visual cards below

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-17
items.description: [Shadcnship] An alternating 2-column feature grid with thin borders, text and illustration cells, and category tags

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-18
items.description: [Shadcnship] A dark case-studies section with gradient title, white cards with category labels and plus buttons, and a view-all link

items.name: arnaudvolp/testimonial-04
items.description: [Shadcnship] A testimonial gallery with a dominant featured landscape card and three narrow portrait brand cards

items.name: arnaudvolp/contact-02
items.description: [Shadcnship] A pro contact form with split layout, tour select, image slot, and contact info strip

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-19
items.description: [Shadcnship] An editorial split section with large title, two compared image panels, circular arrow button, and footer bar

items.name: arnaudvolp/feature-20
items.description: [Shadcnship] A 3-card feature section with decorative UI mockups (form, call, pricing) and split header

items.description: [ReUI] Sales rep performance summary: a 3-up KPI grid with up/down trend deltas, a pipeline progress bar, a recent activity list, and a quarter filter. ReUI Frame, Badge with shadcn Progress, Select, DropdownMenu, Button. For dashboards and scorecards.

items.name: reui/stats-7
items.description: [ReUI] Bordered ReUI Frame panel split into three divided cells, each with a title, large metric value, colored trend Badge and period comparison subtext. KPI overview, dashboard stats, sales and churn metrics row.

items.name: reui/stats-8
items.description: [ReUI] Responsive 1 to 3 column metric grid; each card pairs a colored icon tile with a value, label, up/down trend Badge, and reporting date range. ReUI Frame, Badge, shadcn Item. For dashboards, analytics overview, KPI summary.

items.name: reui/stats-9
items.description: [ReUI] Task summary card: animated Tasks Done Progress bar, range Select filter, 3-column Backlog/In Progress/In Review buckets with colored counts, and AI prediction footer. ReUI Frame, shadcn Progress, Select. Project dashboard, productivity stats widget.

items.name: reui/timeline-1
items.description: [ReUI] Customer onboarding timeline where each activation milestone is a collapsible card with owner, priority and status badges, assignee avatars and due date. ReUI Timeline, Frame, Badge plus shadcn Avatar, Collapsible, Spinner. Onboarding tracker.

items.name: reui/timeline-2
items.description: [ReUI] Vertical activity timeline of onboarding milestones, each with date, action title, owner, colored status and risk badges, optional star rating and downloadable attachment. ReUI Timeline, Badge, Rating. Customer success, audit log, milestone feed.

items.name: reui/timeline-3
items.description: [ReUI] Vertical finance feed of payouts, risk flags, invoices, and ledger updates. Avatar nodes, dot plus colored status Badges, attachments, participant AvatarGroup, inline action Buttons. ReUI Timeline, Badge, Avatar, Button. Audit log, activity feed.

items.name: reui/timeline-4
items.description: [ReUI] Vertical activity stream mixing actor avatars, attachment downloads, participant avatar groups, status badges, progress bars, star ratings, and a per-event action menu. Uses ReUI Timeline, Badge, Rating, Avatar, Progress, DropdownMenu.

items.name: reui/timeline-5
items.description: [ReUI] Vertical changelog feed: each release shows a version title, summary, and tagged badges for type (New, Fixed), impact, and changes, with a left date rail. ReUI Timeline, Badge. Release notes, product updates, version history.

items.name: reui/timeline-6
items.description: [ReUI] Horizontal scrollable timeline tracking approval steps, each with a phase status badge, attachment download, star rating, action button, and owner avatar. ReUI Timeline, Badge, Rating with shadcn Avatar, Button, ButtonGroup. For approval flows.

items.name: reui/timeline-7
items.description: [ReUI] Dropdown holding a scrollable vertical timeline of rollout steps, each with date, owner, status badge, dot-meta badge, attachment and star rating. ReUI Timeline, Badge, Rating with shadcn DropdownMenu, ScrollArea. Activity feed, audit log.

items.name: reui/timeline-8
items.description: [ReUI] Right-side activity feed panel listing team events as timeline entries with avatars, status badges, progress bars, attachments, ratings, and a per-item action menu. ReUI Timeline, Badge, Rating with shadcn Sheet, Avatar, DropdownMenu, ScrollArea.

items.name: reui/timeline-9
items.description: [ReUI] Floating right sheet with a scrollable activity feed of payouts, risk reviews, and ledger entries with avatar indicators, status badges, attachment downloads, and inline actions. ReUI Timeline, Badge; shadcn Sheet, Avatar. Audit log, notifications.

items.description: [ReUI] Saved-items wishlist as selectable rows with thumbnail, brand, variant, stock dot, and price. Select-all toolbar morphs into bulk Add to Cart, Remove, Clear; per-row Notify Me. ReUI Badge, shadcn Checkbox, Button, Item. Account and saved-items pages.

items.name: reui/wishlist-2
items.description: [ReUI] Ecommerce wishlist that flags saved products with price-drop, restock, almost-gone, or unavailable badges, filters by status tabs, and bulk-adds in-stock items to cart. ReUI Badge, shadcn Tabs, Item, Button. Saved items, favorites, watchlist.

items.name: reui/wishlist-3
items.description: [ReUI] Saved-items wishlist grid where each card shows a stock or price signal badge, Move To Cart or Notify When Restocked, and hover remove. Line Tabs filter by signal with live counts. ReUI Badge, shadcn Tabs, Button, Item, Empty. For favorites, saved.

items.name: reui/wishlist-4
items.description: [ReUI] Account wishlist as named boards with 2x2 mosaic cover cards, +N overflow, item count, updated time, Shared badge, hover share/delete. Line Tabs filter All, Recently Updated, Shared, plus a dashed New Collection tile. ReUI Badge, shadcn Tabs, Item.

items.name: reui/wishlist-5
items.description: [ReUI] Saved-items page grouping products into Must Have, Save For Later, Maybe buckets with per-item stock status, price savings, a total, and lock-on-add cart actions. ReUI Badge; shadcn Button, Empty, Item, Tooltip. Wishlist, favorites, saved items.

items.name: reui/wishlist-6
items.description: [ReUI] Saved products in selectable collections: a left rail of cover-stacked tiles with count and total, plus a product pane with brand, price, savings, and bulk add-to-cart. shadcn Breadcrumb, Button, Empty, Item. Wishlist, favorites, lookbook.

items.name: reui/wizard-1
items.description: [ReUI] Multi-step account and payment onboarding wizard in a Card: ReUI Stepper nav gates locked steps, validates each step, then shows a review summary with Badge. Uses Field, Input, InputGroup, Select, Switch, Button. For billing, checkout, onboarding.

items.name: reui/wizard-2
items.description: [ReUI] Multi-step vendor KYC intake: company details, compliance with repeatable beneficial owners and tax ID, then a document checklist and review summary. Per-step validation. ReUI Stepper, Frame, Badge plus shadcn Field, Input, Select, Checkbox, Tooltip.

items.name: reui/wizard-3
items.description: [ReUI] Four-step invoice send flow with progress Stepper, editable line-item Table, and live subtotal, tax, discount, and total. ReUI Stepper, Badge, Combobox; shadcn Card, Select, Calendar, Table, Tooltip. For billing, checkout, invoicing wizards.

items.name: reui/wizard-4
items.description: [ReUI] Plan, seats, payment, and review flow that recalculates seat subtotal, annual discount, and support fee into a draft invoice. Uses ReUI Stepper, Badge, Alert plus Card, RadioGroup, Slider, Select, and Calendar. For checkout and seat upgrade screens.

items.name: reui/wizard-5
items.description: [ReUI] Add member emails with inline validation and per-row roles, set sender and expiry, then review a recipients table and send-readiness checks before queuing. ReUI Stepper, Frame, Badge plus shadcn Table, Select, Avatar. For onboarding and seat invites.

items.name: reui/wizard-6
items.description: [ReUI] Add-product flow across details, image gallery, variant option groups, pricing, and a per-variant SKU matrix table. ReUI Stepper, Badge, Alert with shadcn Card, Select, Switch, Table, Dialog. Product setup wizard, multi-step form.

items.name: reui/wizard-7
items.description: [ReUI] Money transfer flow over a 4-step Stepper: pick payee, set amount and funding source, review, authorize with a 6-digit code. Recent-payee grid, searchable saved accounts, multi-currency Combobox, low-balance Alert. ReUI Stepper plus shadcn Combobox.

items.name: intentui/all
items.description: [Intent UI] Installs all UI components from this registry.

items.name: kokonutui/ai-prompt
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated AI chat input with model selection dropdown, file attachment and auto-resizing textarea. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/command-button
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Keyboard shortcut button with a Command icon, hover shimmer sweep, and smooth CSS transitions, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/card-flip
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Interactive card that flips in 3D on hover to reveal features and a call to action, built with React and Tailwind CSS transforms and transitions.

items.name: kokonutui/smooth-drawer
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Bottom drawer with spring-based slide-in and staggered content reveal, built on Vaul with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/shape-hero
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Hero section with translucent geometric shapes that drop in and float over a gradient backdrop. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/ai-text-loading
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated AI thinking indicator that cycles status messages with a shimmering gradient text effect. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/shimmer-text
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated shimmer text with a looping gradient sweep across the letters, built with React, Tailwind CSS gradients and Motion animations.

items.name: kokonutui/carousel-cards
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Horizontally scrolling card carousel with ratings, badges and arrow navigation, built with React, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui primitives.

items.name: kokonutui/file-upload
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Drag and drop file upload with animated progress, file validation and error states. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

items.name: kokonutui/action-search-bar
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Search bar with debounced input, shortcut hints, and an animated action suggestions dropdown, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/ai-input-search
items.description: [kokonut/ui] AI search chat input with toggleable web search mode, file attachment and auto-resizing textarea. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/currency-transfer
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Multi-step currency exchange card with animated progress and SVG checkmark confirmation, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

items.name: kokonutui/background-paths
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated background of flowing SVG line paths drawn across the hero section. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion path animations.

items.name: kokonutui/mouse-effect-card
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Interactive card with an animated dot pattern that repels away from the cursor, powered by React, Tailwind CSS and Motion spring physics.

items.name: kokonutui/beams-background
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated background of drifting light beams rendered on an HTML canvas with configurable intensity. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/flow-field
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Canvas particle flow field background with noise-driven streams of glowing light, color themes and density options. Built with React and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/apple-activity-card
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated activity rings card inspired by the Apple Fitness app, with progress circles built in React using Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

items.name: kokonutui/ai-voice
items.description: [kokonut/ui] AI voice input button with recording timer, pulsing waveform bars and listening state. Built with React and animated Tailwind CSS styles.

items.name: kokonutui/smooth-tab
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated tab switcher with a sliding active indicator and smooth card content transitions, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/team-selector
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated team size selector with stacked overlapping avatars, spring transitions and increment controls. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/switch-button
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Light and dark theme toggle button with a rotating sun icon and shimmer hover effect, built with React, next-themes, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/bento-grid
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Responsive bento grid of feature cards with animated charts, counters and timelines, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

items.name: kokonutui/social-button
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Share button that expands into a row of social icon buttons with staggered Motion animations on hover, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/hold-button
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Press-and-hold confirmation button with an animated progress fill, configurable hold duration, and color variants, built with React and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/attract-button
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Magnetic button that pulls floating particles to its center on hover using Motion spring animations, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/gradient-button
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Layered gradient button with emerald, purple, and orange variants, soft inner glow, and hover overlay, styled entirely with Tailwind CSS in React.

items.name: kokonutui/v0-button
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Open in v0 button that sends a component registry JSON to v0.dev for instant editing, built with React, the shadcn Button, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/toolbar
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Figma-inspired toolbar where the selected tool expands to reveal its label with spring animations, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/ai-loading
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated AI loading state cycling task statuses through a scrolling code-style log with an SVG progress spinner. Built with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/card-stack
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Stack of product cards that expands on click to reveal details and specs, animated with Motion and styled with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/avatar-picker
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated avatar picker with SVG avatar options, colored selection ring and username input. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/type-writer
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Typewriter text animation that types and deletes multiple sequences with a blinking cursor and auto loop, built with React and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/swoosh-text
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Hover text effect with layered colorful shadows that snap flat on mouseover, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion hover animations.

items.name: kokonutui/sliced-text
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Text effect that splits into two offset slices and merges together on hover using clip-path, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

items.name: kokonutui/glitch-text
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Customizable glitch text effect with adjustable intensity, colors and sizes, animated in React with Motion and styled with Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/matrix-text
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Matrix-style text effect where letters scramble through binary characters before revealing, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

items.name: kokonutui/dynamic-text
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated text switcher that cycles through greetings in multiple languages, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion enter and exit transitions.

items.name: kokonutui/particle-button
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Button that bursts animated particles from its center on click with a quick scale press effect, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/tweet-card
items.description: [kokonut/ui] X (Twitter) style post card with author details, verified badge, reply thread and hover gradient, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/scroll-text
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Scroll-driven text list that highlights the active word as you scroll, using IntersectionObserver with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

items.name: kokonutui/liquid-glass-card
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Apple-inspired liquid glass card and buttons using SVG displacement filters for a refractive effect, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/profile-dropdown
items.description: [kokonut/ui] User profile dropdown menu with avatar, subscription and model details, and quick action links, built with React, shadcn/ui, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/loader
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated loading indicator with rotating gradient rings, size variants and customizable title text. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

items.name: kokonutui/slide-text-button
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated link button with a vertical text slide on hover and default and ghost variants, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/morphic-navbar
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Navigation bar whose active link morphs into a rounded pill with smooth CSS transitions, built with React, Next.js Link, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: kokonutui/spotlight-cards
items.description: [kokonut/ui] Feature card grid with ambient aurora glow, magnetic 3D tilt and focus dimming on hover, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion springs.

items.name: kokonutui/use-auto-resize-textarea
items.description: [kokonut/ui] React hook that auto-resizes a textarea to fit its content between a min and max height.

items.name: kokonutui/use-click-outside
items.description: [kokonut/ui] React hook that runs a callback when the user clicks outside the referenced element.

items.name: kokonutui/use-copy-to-clipboard
items.description: [kokonut/ui] React hook that copies text to the clipboard and exposes a copied state with a reset timeout.

items.name: kokonutui/use-mobile
items.description: [kokonut/ui] React hook that reports whether the viewport is below the 768px mobile breakpoint.

items.name: kokonutui/utils
items.description: [kokonut/ui] The cn utility for merging Tailwind CSS classes, built on clsx and tailwind-merge.

items.name: trophy-ui/achievement-list
items.description: [Trophy UI] Vertical React achievement list with icons, descriptions, and optional progress for dense achievement UI. Complements grids and cards in gamification dashboards. Open source, built on shadcn/ui + Tailwind.

items.name: trophy-ui/achievement-unlocked
items.description: [Trophy UI] Celebratory React dialog for newly unlocked achievements with headline, badge, and share actions. Use for unlock moments, level up animations and more. Built on shadcn/ui + Tailwind. Open source.

items.name: trophy-ui/achievement-card
items.description: [Trophy UI] React achievement card with totals, featured badges, and scrollable lists for profile and progress surfaces. Fits achievement UI examples in SaaS, consumer and community products. Open source, built on shadcn/ui + Tailwind.

items.name: trophy-ui/leaderboard-rankings
items.description: [Trophy UI] React leaderboard rankings list—avatars, scores, bylines, and crown highlights for full tables. Open-source leaderboard UI for games, communities, and SaaS challenges. shadcn/ui + Tailwind.

items.name: trophy-ui/leaderboard-card

items.name: trophy-ui/points-badge
items.description: [Trophy UI] Compact React points badge for totals and currency-style scores in gamification UIs. Fits XP-style displays alongside charts and lists. Built on shadcn/ui + Tailwind. Open source.

items.description: [ShadcnCraft] A model's thinking, folded away behind a disclosure so it never competes with the answer. The trigger shimmers while tokens are still arriving and settles once the step closes. Takes an AI SDK reasoning part.

items.description: [ShadcnCraft] A message's text. items.name: shadcncraft/tool-part-1
items.description: [ShadcnCraft] One tool call, through all four of its states: running, done, failed and refused. Takes an AI SDK tool part, whichever tool it is.

items.name: shadcncraft/web-search-part-1
items.description: [ShadcnCraft] The line saying a search happened: objective and a spinner while it runs, a warning when it fails. What it found is not rendered here, because the citations under the answer already carry it; without this row the slowest step of a turn happens in silence.

items.name: shadcncraft/questionnaire-part-1

items.name: shadcncraft/sources-part-1

items.name: zyeon/effect-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One button, seven visual effects (shimmer, shine, spotlight, glow, gradient, glass, ripple) as cva variants.

items.name: zyeon/animated-text
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Character-level text animation — typewriter, scramble and flowing gradient variants in one component.

items.name: zyeon/rating
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An accessible star rating input (whole or half steps) that doubles as a fractional read-only display.

items.name: zyeon/chart-donut-stat
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state donut widget with a center stat and value/percentage legend, driven by one zod contract.

items.name: zyeon/pricing-table
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state pricing section with a data-derived monthly/yearly toggle and a highlighted recommended tier.

items.name: zyeon/stateful-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An action button with a built-in idle → loading → success/error state machine — stable width, live-region announcements, auto-reset.

items.name: zyeon/slide-to-confirm
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A slide-to-confirm control — drag the thumb to the end of the track to fire an action, guarding destructive or irreversible operations against accidental taps.

items.name: zyeon/theme-toggle-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An animated sun/moon theme toggle button — controlled and host-agnostic, with a rotate-and-scale icon cross-fade.

items.name: zyeon/tags-input
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A chips input for free-form multi-value entry — Enter or comma commits, paste splits, duplicates shake, maxTags caps with a counter.

items.name: zyeon/dropzone
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A native drag-and-drop file picker with accept/size/count validation, inline rejection reasons and a removable file list.

items.name: zyeon/number-ticker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A count-up number that eases from 0 to its target the first time it scrolls into view — Intl-formatted with prefix/suffix.

items.name: zyeon/status-badge
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A presence and health indicator — colored dot or tinted pill, with status colors mapped to theme tokens and an optional liveness pulse.

items.name: zyeon/avatar-group
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An overlapping avatar stack with ring cutouts, letter fallbacks for broken images, and a computed +N overflow chip.

items.name: zyeon/timeline
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A contract-driven vertical timeline with done, active and upcoming milestone nodes and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/spinner
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One indeterminate loader, seven shapes — three boxed (ring, dual-ring, bars) and four inline dot rows (dots, ellipsis, bounce, wave), with tone and count props.

items.name: zyeon/progress-meter
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One progress contract in two geometries — a linear bar or a compact ring, each with determinate and indeterminate modes, four tones and four sizes.

items.name: zyeon/banner
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A page-top announcement bar with info, accent and destructive variants, a real action link and consumer-owned dismissal.

items.name: zyeon/dock
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A macOS-style dock with proximity-based icon magnification, spring physics and hover label bubbles.

items.name: zyeon/animated-tabs
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A controlled tab strip with a sliding active indicator — underline and pill variants animated via motion layout animation.

items.name: zyeon/marquee
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A pure-CSS infinite scrolling belt for logo walls and testimonial strips — seamless loop, edge fade and hover pause.

items.name: zyeon/comparison-slider
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A draggable before/after comparison slider with clip-path reveal, pointer capture and full keyboard support.

items.name: zyeon/grid-dots
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A zero-JS grid, dots or cross pattern background container with an optional radial fade mask — a pure server component.

items.name: zyeon/aurora
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An animated aurora-gradient background container — theme-token blobs drifting in pure CSS.

items.name: zyeon/chart-bar-interactive
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An interactive bar chart card with per-series big-number toggles that switch which series the bars plot.

items.name: zyeon/sparkline-stat-card
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A KPI card — headline figure, tone-aware delta badge and a minimal sparkline — with four data states from one contract.

items.name: zyeon/testimonials
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A masonry wall of customer quote cards with avatars, driven by one contract through all four data states.

items.name: zyeon/stats-section
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A marketing KPI band of big formatted numbers with hairline dividers, driven by a four-state contract.

items.name: zyeon/faq-section
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state FAQ accordion block with a self-contained, dependency-free disclosure list and smooth grid-rows expansion.

items.name: zyeon/magnetic-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A button that drifts toward the cursor within a sensing radius and springs back on leave, with a subtle reverse-parallax label.

items.name: zyeon/password-input
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A styled password field with a show/hide toggle and an optional heuristic strength meter.

items.name: zyeon/kbd
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Keycap and key-combination display — semantic `<kbd>` markup with platform-aware glyphs (mod resolves to ⌘ on mac, Ctrl on windows).

items.name: zyeon/credit-card
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A flippable bank card display with a masked number, holder and expiry on the front, magstripe and a hidden CVC placeholder on the back.

items.name: zyeon/animated-tooltip
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A self-contained hover/focus tooltip with a spring pop-in, reduced-motion fallback and an arrow callout — no Radix dependency.

items.name: zyeon/image-zoom
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A clickable thumbnail that opens a full-screen lightbox with a fade + scale transition, Esc/backdrop/click-to-close, and focus management.

items.name: zyeon/word-rotate
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A jitter-free rotating word inside a headline, cycling through slide or fade transitions with zero layout shift.

items.name: zyeon/spotlight
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A cursor-following radial glow background container — pointer coordinates track via ref-driven CSS variables, never React state.

items.name: zyeon/use-copy-to-clipboard
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A clipboard-copy hook with a timed copied state and a non-throwing error channel.

items.name: zyeon/copy-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A ghost icon or label button that writes text to the clipboard and flashes a timed "Copied" confirmation.

items.name: zyeon/search-input
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A search field with an icon, a clear button that appears on value, an optional loading spinner, and a decorative shortcut hint.

items.name: zyeon/autosize-textarea
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A textarea that grows with its content via CSS field-sizing with a scrollHeight-based JS fallback, capped between minRows and maxRows.

items.name: zyeon/accordion
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A zero-dependency accessible disclosure list — single or multiple expansion, grid-rows animation, and full APG keyboard support.

items.name: zyeon/empty-state
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A centered empty-state panel with an icon chip, title, description and up to two actions — link actions render RSC-safe, onClick actions need a client boundary.

items.name: zyeon/skeleton
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A loading-placeholder primitive — line, circle and rect shapes with pulse or shimmer motion — that mirrors the layout it stands in for.

items.name: zyeon/callout
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An inline highlight box for docs, forms and explanatory copy — info, success, warning and danger variants with a tinted accent bar and default icon per variant.

items.name: zyeon/scroll-progress
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A thin fixed bar tracking page or container scroll position, written straight to the DOM with zero re-renders.

items.name: zyeon/breadcrumbs
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An accessible breadcrumb trail with collapsible overflow — first item + ellipsis + last items once maxItems is exceeded.

items.name: zyeon/pagination
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Page-number navigation with a sliding sibling window, edge pinning, and an ellipsis only when the page count actually needs one.

items.name: zyeon/stepper
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A horizontal wizard progress indicator — completed steps are clickable to go back, the current and future steps never are.

items.name: zyeon/carousel
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An embla-powered slide carousel with autoplay (hover-pause, reduced-motion aware), looped or bounded navigation, arrow buttons and synced pagination dots.

items.name: zyeon/use-debounce-value
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A generic hook that returns a value only after it has stopped changing for a delay, with no flash on first render.

items.name: zyeon/use-local-storage
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An SSR-safe localStorage-backed state hook, kept in sync across same-tab instances and other tabs.

items.name: zyeon/use-media-query
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An SSR-safe hook that subscribes to a CSS media query and returns whether it currently matches.

items.name: zyeon/scroll-to-top
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A floating button that fades in past a scroll threshold and smoothly scrolls its container (or the window) back to the top.

items.name: zyeon/number-input
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A capsule quantity stepper with a decrement/increment button either side of a directly-editable, clamped numeric field.

items.name: zyeon/swatch-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An accessible radiogroup of preset color swatches with roving tabindex, arrow-key navigation, and a contrast-safe selected check mark.

items.name: zyeon/chat-bubble
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A single message bubble with role-based alignment and color, an avatar slot, and a bouncing typing indicator for assembling chat message lists.

items.name: zyeon/relative-time
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Auto-refreshing 'time ago' text rendered as a real <time> element, formatted with Intl.RelativeTimeFormat and hydration-safe via useSyncExternalStore.

items.name: zyeon/description-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A semantic key-value list for order details, profile echoes, and settings summaries, in a divided-rows or panel-grid layout.

items.name: zyeon/qr-code
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A tokenized QR code renderer — encodes any string to SVG and inherits currentColor, auto-inverting in dark mode.

items.name: zyeon/countdown
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A ticking days/hours/minutes/seconds countdown for launches and promotions, with a one-shot onComplete callback and SSR-safe hydration.

items.name: zyeon/activity-heatmap
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A GitHub-style contribution grid — daily counts as a five-step color scale over a windowed week-by-week calendar, with four data states.

items.name: zyeon/file-tree
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An accessible hierarchical file/folder tree with WAI-ARIA-nested treeitem/group markup, roving tabindex, and grid-rows expand animation.

items.name: zyeon/masonry-grid
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A pure-CSS waterfall grid container that arranges children into responsive columns via break-inside-avoid wrappers, no measuring or JS required.

items.name: zyeon/video-embed
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A lite YouTube/Vimeo facade — poster and play button until clicked, so the real iframe and its third-party script never load until the user opts in.

items.name: zyeon/text-reveal
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Word-by-word or character-by-character text reveal triggered by scrolling into view, with a staggered fade-up-blur entrance.

items.name: zyeon/meteors
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A decorative diagonal shooting-star field for hero/card backdrops — deterministically scattered, pure CSS.

items.name: zyeon/use-intersection-observer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A callback-ref hook reporting whether an element is intersecting its viewport, with an optional one-shot reveal-once mode.

items.name: zyeon/like-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A social toggle that fills its icon, bursts a ring of particles and rolls the counter on every tap.

items.name: zyeon/share-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A share trigger whose targets fan out on an arc or a rail, one 40ms step apart, with outside-click and Esc dismissal.

items.name: zyeon/download-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A download CTA that fills like a liquid gauge as the transfer advances, then settles into a checked or retryable state.

items.name: zyeon/split-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A primary action welded to an arrow segment that opens its own keyboard-navigable action menu.

items.name: zyeon/gradient-border-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A rotating conic-gradient ring around a solid core, so the border carries the colour and the label keeps full contrast.

items.name: zyeon/fab-menu
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A floating action button that fans a labelled column of secondary actions upward, with staggered entry and focus handling.

items.name: zyeon/otp-input
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A segmented verification-code field with auto-advance, paste-to-fill, optional grouping and masking.

items.name: zyeon/range-slider
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A two-thumb range selector with a minimum gap, value bubbles, marks and full keyboard control.

items.name: zyeon/toggle-switch
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A switch with a sliding knob, Check/X icons fading inside the track, three sizes and a loading state.

items.name: zyeon/currency-input
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A money field that stays raw while you type and normalizes with Intl.NumberFormat on blur — grouping, fixed decimals, clamping, and a number | null value.

items.name: zyeon/phone-input
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A country dial-code picker fused to a number field — searchable self-drawn listbox, keyboard driven, emitting an E.164 string on every change.

items.name: zyeon/inline-edit
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Click-to-edit text that swaps a button for an input in place — pending state on async saves, rollback with the failure reason, and no width jump.

items.name: zyeon/choice-cards

items.name: zyeon/stack-trace
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Parse, inspect, and copy stack traces while preserving unrecognized raw frames.

items.name: zyeon/perspective-marquee
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Present media tiles in a responsive perspective marquee with explicit data states.

items.name: zyeon/slug-input
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A URL field that transliterates the title as you type, detaches the moment you edit it by hand, and debounces an availability check with clickable -2 / -3 suggestions.

items.name: zyeon/unit-input
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A number-plus-unit field for design tokens — 12px, 1.5rem, 50% — with arrow/wheel stepping, optional conversion on unit switch, and an auto state.

items.name: zyeon/repeater-field
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A generic controlled array field — add, remove, move and drag-sort rows of any shape, with min/max clamping and stable row ids that never remount a focused input.

items.name: zyeon/timezone-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A searchable IANA time-zone field — ~90 zones grouped Popular / All, each row showing that zone's live local time and derived GMT offset, in a portalled panel no overflow-hidden card can clip.

items.name: zyeon/cron-input
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A visual five-field cron builder — presets, hour/minute selects and weekday/month chips write the expression, pasting one parses back into them, with a plain-English summary and the next runs.

items.name: zyeon/leaderboard
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A ranked standings board — podium tiers, rank-change arrows, a highlighted current-user row with a pinned "your rank" bar, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: zyeon/invoice-summary
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An invoice / order total block — line items (quantity × unit), discounts, taxes with rates, shipping, total and amount due, all in integer minor units, with full and compact variants and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/request-waterfall
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A DevTools-style network waterfall — one adaptive time axis, bars segmented by DNS/connect/TLS/TTFB/download, hover-or-focus phase breakdowns, duration sorting, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: zyeon/org-chart
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A recursive org/hierarchy chart drawn with pure-CSS connector lines (sibling bus trimmed at both ends), collapsible subtrees, vertical or horizontal orientation, renderNode-swappable cards, and a keyboard-navigable WAI-ARIA tree that scrolls inside its own box instead of overflowing.

items.name: zyeon/api-endpoint
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A collapsible API reference card with a monochrome-safe method badge, grouped parameter tables, expandable response examples, and a generated Copy-as-cURL command that reports failure honestly.

items.name: zyeon/save-indicator
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Autosave status line for an editor toolbar — Saving… holds a minimum beat to avoid flicker, Saved fades back into "Last saved 3 minutes ago", and errors stay put with a Retry.

items.name: zyeon/permission-prompt
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A pre-permission explainer card that says why camera, microphone, location, notification or clipboard access is needed before the browser's one-shot dialog is spent, with per-permission recovery steps and a retry once it's blocked.

items.name: zyeon/connection-status
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An online / offline / reconnecting bar with an exponential-backoff retry countdown, a manual retry button and SSR-safe browser subscription.

items.name: zyeon/workspace-switcher
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A workspace / organization switcher: active workspace in the trigger, grouped searchable menu in a portalled panel, pinned create and settings footer.

items.name: zyeon/image-annotation
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Click-to-pin image annotation — numbered draggable markers with notes, stored as percentages of the image so they never drift when it resizes.

items.name: zyeon/redacted-text
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Blur, black-bar or character-mask a sensitive string with hover / click / press-and-hold reveal — where mask actually removes the plaintext from the DOM.

items.name: zyeon/ripple-rings
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Concentric ripples expanding out of one origin — a pure CSS/DOM backdrop with an optional pointer-following origin and a static reduced-motion fallback.

items.name: zyeon/topography
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A seamlessly tiling contour-map backdrop traced from seeded hash noise — quiet relief lines for docs shells, auth screens and empty states.

items.name: zyeon/use-selection
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A list multi-selection state machine with Shift range, platform-aware cmd/ctrl toggle, tri-state select-all flags, and automatic pruning when items change.

items.name: zyeon/use-pagination
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Headless pagination state — clamped page, page count, item range, client-side slice() and the ellipsis page sequence, controlled or uncontrolled.

items.name: zyeon/address-form
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A postal address form driven by a country rule table: per-country field set, field order and labels, state dropdown or free text or nothing, postal codes that are required, optional or absent, blur-time validation, correct autocomplete tokens, and an announced clear when a value cannot follow you to

items.name: zyeon/rich-text-toolbar
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An editor-agnostic formatting bar: grouped toggle buttons that never steal the editor's selection, collapse into an overflow menu by measurement, and walk on a single tab stop — plus a floating variant that follows the selection.

items.name: zyeon/json-editor
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An editable JSON textarea with live syntax validation, exact line/column errors marked in a synced gutter, optional schema checking, and format/minify/copy/reset tools.

items.name: zyeon/query-builder
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A recursive AND/OR condition tree — operator menus follow the field's type, any condition can be turned into a nested group up to a depth cap, and a read-only SQL-ish expression shows what the tree means.

items.name: zyeon/pin-pad
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A touch-first numeric keypad for PIN entry: 44px keys, masked dot indicator, deterministic shuffled layout, keyboard parity, and pending/error states.

items.name: zyeon/percent-allocator
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Split a total across rows with largest-remainder rebalancing, per-row locks and min/max limits — the shares always add up to the target exactly.

items.name: zyeon/markdown-editor
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A textarea-based Markdown editor with a selection-aware toggling toolbar, ⌘B/⌘I/⌘K shortcuts, write/preview/split modes and a dependency-free preview renderer.

items.name: zyeon/language-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A locale field that lists every language under its own name — 简体中文 beside Chinese (Simplified) — searchable by endonym, English name or BCP 47 tag, with RTL rows rendered in their own direction, optional translation completeness and a browser-language matching ladder.

items.name: zyeon/dimension-input
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A paired width × height field with an aspect-ratio lock that freezes the ratio when you lock it, clamps both sides against min/max, and ships swap plus size/ratio presets.

items.name: zyeon/gradient-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A CSS gradient editor: draggable stop rail with double-click insert, keyboard-reachable stops, an angle dial, and a read-only linear/radial/conic CSS string with copy.

items.name: zyeon/shortcut-recorder
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A field that records a keyboard shortcut by pressing it — swallows every key while recording, waits past the modifiers for a real key, and separates browser-reserved combos (refused) from ones that would override an existing binding (recorded, with a warning).

items.name: zyeon/gantt-chart
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A project schedule chart — sticky task column, adaptive day/week/month axis, progress-filled bars, milestone diamonds, finish-to-start dependency elbows, collapsible groups, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: zyeon/inbox-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A triage-ready message list — unread by weight and dot, Shift-range multi-select with a bulk bar, keyboard shortcuts, hover-and-focus row actions, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: zyeon/audit-trail
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A compliance-grade activity log — one readable sentence per event, day separators, expandable before/after diffs, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: zyeon/permission-matrix
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An editable roles × permissions grid: tri-state cells (allow / deny / inherit), collapsible permission groups, a pinned permission column, locked system-role columns, row/column bulk edits, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: zyeon/data-grid-editable
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A spreadsheet-style editable data grid — per-column cell editors, roving-tabindex keyboard navigation, per-cell validation, async commits that show pending and roll back, TSV paste, sticky header and first column, plus real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: zyeon/session-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Signed-in devices with per-row and bulk sign-out — the current session is highlighted and never revocable, rejected revokes keep the row with a retry, and loading/empty/error are first-class states.

items.name: zyeon/changelog-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] User-facing release notes — one block per version, entries grouped by kind with an icon and a word, a sticky version rail on wide containers and real per-release permalinks.

items.name: zyeon/tree-map
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A squarified treemap that tiles a hierarchy by value — nested groups, click-to-drill with a breadcrumb, rank-based shading and keyboard-reachable DOM tiles (no canvas).

items.name: zyeon/toolbar
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A grouped application toolbar that measures itself and folds its lowest-priority actions into a portalled "More" menu — no breakpoints, roving tabindex, pressed toggles kept intact.

items.name: zyeon/version-history
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A day-grouped snapshot list — preview a version, compare two, and roll one back behind a real confirmation with pending, failure and retry.

items.name: zyeon/mini-map
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A thumbnail navigator for any scroll container — a draggable viewport box over an auto-measured (or custom-drawn) silhouette, kept in sync by a passive rAF-throttled listener that writes transform straight to the DOM.

items.name: zyeon/inline-error-summary
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A top-of-form error summary whose rows scroll to and focus the field they name — persistent polite live region, self-focusing panel, onNavigate hook for collapsed fields and a maxVisible overflow count.

items.name: zyeon/health-check-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A self-diagnostics panel — one independently re-runnable probe per row, shape-plus-word statuses, expandable evidence, real fix actions and a counts-and-verdict summary.

items.name: zyeon/status-timeline
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A read-only progress thread for an async run — per-stage icon + word, live elapsed time on the running stage, expandable failures and a settled-run summary, vertical or horizontal.

items.name: zyeon/diff-confirm
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A confirmation dialog that shows the change list first — grouped create/update/delete counts, expandable before → after rows, type-to-confirm past a destructive threshold, and a failure state that keeps the plan on screen.

items.name: zyeon/app-launcher
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A nine-dot app switcher: a grid button that drops a portalled tile grid of real links, with arrow-key grid navigation, groups, pinned and recent rows, and a search box once the suite outgrows a 3x3.

items.name: zyeon/nav-rail
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A narrow vertical icon navigation bar that widens into a labelled column — keyboard-reachable tooltips, top/bottom zones, badges and a controllable expanded state.

items.name: zyeon/audio-waveform
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A canvas amplitude waveform with a click/drag/keyboard seek slider — takes precomputed peaks or decodes a src itself, highlights regions, and stays a controlled display while your own audio element plays.

items.name: zyeon/media-grid-selectable
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A multi-select photo/video grid with Shift range, cmd/ctrl toggle, two-dimensional arrow-key navigation, a selection cap, lazy thumbnails and type-icon fallbacks.

items.name: zyeon/audio-visualizer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A real-time AnalyserNode visualizer — spectrum bars, oscilloscope, radial ring or segmented level meter, driven by a stream, an audio element or an analyser you own.

items.name: zyeon/file-preview
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A preview card for any single file — image/video thumbnails, a working audio play bar, type icons with MIME-or-extension metadata, card/row/tile variants and leak-free object URLs.

items.name: zyeon/truncate-middle
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Middle-ellipsis text that keeps both ends readable — a fixed head/tail cluster count, or as many characters as the measured width actually fits.

items.name: zyeon/glitch-text
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Cyberpunk glitch headline — two pseudo-element copies tear the text into slices and slide, in pure CSS, dead still under reduced motion.

items.name: zyeon/search-highlight
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Highlights the parts of a text that match a search query — substring, per-word or fuzzy subsequence, with escaped queries, merged overlaps and a current-match cursor.

items.name: zyeon/starfield
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A layered parallax star field on one canvas — 2-4 depth layers drifting or warping, seeded for a reproducible sky, with a faint-dust fallback on light surfaces.

items.name: zyeon/hex-grid
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A seamlessly tiling honeycomb backdrop — outlined, tinted or vertex-dotted, with an optional edge fade and a few seeded cells breathing on CSS alone.

items.name: zyeon/circuit-board
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A seamlessly tiling PCB backdrop — seeded traces with 45°/90° corners, pads, vias and component footprints, plus an optional signal pulse.

items.name: zyeon/use-focus-trap
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A hook that keeps keyboard focus inside a container: moves focus in, cycles Tab both ways, only the innermost trap reacts, and focus returns to the trigger on release.

items.name: zyeon/use-roving-tabindex
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A roving-tabindex hook that gives a control group one Tab stop and arrow-key navigation inside it — horizontal / vertical / grid lanes, disabled-item skipping, loop or stop, Home/End and typeahead.

items.name: zyeon/use-permission
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Subscribes to navigator.permissions for one name or a whole panel of them — query only, never request — folding Firefox's rejections, Safari's gaps, unknown names and insecure origins into one honest unsupported state with a reason, plus change-event updates and a manual query().

items.name: zyeon/use-web-share
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Opens the native share sheet with typed outcomes — a cancelled sheet is dismissed rather than an error, files are gated behind canShare, and the fallback reports its own success or failure.

items.name: zyeon/use-speech-recognition
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Speech-to-text on the Web Speech API: prefixed-constructor detection, interim vs settled transcripts, a continuous mode that re-arms itself after the engine's silence timeout yet always stops on stop(), and errors split into benign / recoverable / blocked.

items.name: zyeon/use-mutation-observer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A callback-ref hook that watches DOM changes with MutationObserver — filtered attributes, rAF-batched records, and a disconnect/write/observe guard against self-feeding loops.

items.name: zyeon/use-step
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A step machine for multi-step flows — async can-go-next gates with a pending flag, visited/completed sets, loop, and clamping when steps change.

items.name: zyeon/use-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Array state with every mutation you keep hand-writing — push, insertAt, move, swap and keyed upsert, all batch-safe, out-of-range-safe, and reference-stable.

items.name: zyeon/use-clipboard-paste
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Catches pasted images, files and rich text — page-wide or scoped to a ref — draining clipboardData synchronously, gating files through accept/maxFiles with an itemised rejection list, plus an optional permission-checked active read.

items.name: zyeon/use-wake-lock
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Keeps the screen awake for the length of a task and re-acquires the wake lock the browser silently takes away whenever the tab is hidden, with gesture-safe requests and distinguishable refusal errors.

items.name: zyeon/use-hash
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An SSR-safe hook that reads and writes the URL hash as shareable UI state, writing through pushState/replaceState and broadcasting to every instance on the page.

items.name: zyeon/use-notification
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Sends desktop notifications behind a gesture-gated requestPermission() that never throws, keeps the permission state live via the Permissions API, registers each notification by tag so close(tag) works, and skips notifications while the page is visible.

items.name: zyeon/chart-area-stacked
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state stacked area chart card whose legend chips toggle single series, re-stacking the survivors and rescaling the y-axis, with a per-series plus total tooltip.

items.name: zyeon/chart-line-multi
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state multi-series line chart whose shared crosshair reads every series at the hovered x, ranked by value, with null gaps left broken.

items.name: zyeon/chart-radial-progress
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state radial progress card: one concentric ring per metric against its own target, a summary number in the hole, and over-target rings capped at one lap with truncation marks instead of drawing through.

items.name: zyeon/chart-funnel
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state conversion funnel: tapering bands with a minimum width, plus per-stage counts, step conversion and cumulative conversion.

items.name: zyeon/chart-scatter-quadrant
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state decision-matrix scatter chart: median or fixed crosshair, labelled tinted quadrants, collision fan-out and a screen-reader data table.

items.name: zyeon/chart-radar-compare
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state radar chart comparing two or three subjects across mixed-unit dimensions: each spoke is normalized 0-100 while the tooltip keeps the raw values.

items.name: zyeon/chart-waterfall
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A bridge chart of floating bars — derived opening/subtotal/closing anchors, hatched decreases, running-total connectors, slot-aware ticks and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: zyeon/chart-gauge
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state needle dial that reads one metric against contract-driven threshold bands, with explicit boundary attribution and an out-of-range caret.

items.name: zyeon/chart-bullet
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state bullet chart: one row per KPI with its own scale, a measure bar against a target tick and qualitative bands, plus clamped off-scale markers.

items.name: zyeon/chart-candlestick
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state OHLC candlestick chart: hollow-up / solid-down bodies, wicks, doji and limit-locked sessions kept visible, and a full-OHLC tooltip.

items.name: zyeon/chart-histogram
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state distribution chart that bins raw values itself — auto / fixed-count / fixed-width bins with optional percentile reference lines.

items.name: zyeon/chart-stacked-bar-pct
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state 100% stacked bar chart with largest-remainder rounding, so every bar's percentages add up to exactly 100.

items.name: zyeon/chart-step-line
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state step chart for discrete state over time — values hold flat then jump, with three step alignments, change markers and a change table.

items.name: zyeon/chart-range-area
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state range-area card: a center line inside one or two nested uncertainty bands, with contradictory bounds repaired and disclosed instead of drawn as crossed polygons.

items.name: zyeon/hero-section
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A props-driven landing hero with eyebrow, dual CTAs, social-proof bar and an optional visual that collapses to a centred column when omitted.

items.name: zyeon/feature-grid
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state feature section: equal-weight icon cards with optional real "learn more" links, and no cap on how many render.

items.name: zyeon/cta-band
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A closing call-to-action strip — headline, supporting line and a primary/secondary CTA pair, in four surfaces (plain, card, muted, accent) and row or stacked layouts.

items.name: zyeon/logo-cloud
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A trusted-by logo wall that optically equalises logos of wildly different aspect ratios, as a static grid or a reduced-motion-aware marquee.

items.name: zyeon/newsletter-signup
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An email capture band driven by a real submit state machine: zod validation, a duplicate-submit guard, a role=status confirmation, an idempotent already-subscribed branch, and a failure that keeps the address you typed.

items.name: zyeon/site-footer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A contract-driven site footer: brand block with named social links, collapsible link columns on mobile, and a legal bottom bar with an optional locale switcher.

items.name: zyeon/team-grid
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state team section with equal-height member cards, initials-fallback avatars, real social links and optional department grouping.

items.name: zyeon/contact-section
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A contact block built around its submit state machine: zod-validated name/email/topic/message, a duplicate-submit guard, a confirmation panel that names the address it replied to, and a failure that keeps every character you typed — beside contact rows whose mailto:/tel:/map links are derived from t

items.name: zyeon/blog-card-grid
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state article grid: one stretched link per card (category and author stay independently clickable), a featured post that spans two columns, and deliberate, configurable line clamping so mismatched title lengths still line up.

items.name: zyeon/auth-card
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Sign-in, sign-up and reset in one card: a typed rejection union (bad credentials, address taken, rate limited), per-mode autocomplete tokens, a duplicate-submit guard, and input that survives every failure.

items.name: zyeon/dashboard-shell
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An app shell with a pinned top bar, a collapsible icon rail and a main region that is the page's only scroll container — on mobile the sidebar becomes a scroll-locked, focus-trapped drawer.

items.name: zyeon/integration-grid
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state integrations directory: debounced search and category facets that really filter, a live result count, and per-card connect / disconnect with pending, error and retry.

items.name: zyeon/metric-overview
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A dashboard KPI row — one shared range switcher over comparable cards, deltas coloured by each metric's polarity, and a sparkline per card.

items.name: zyeon/error-page
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A full-viewport error page for 404 / 403 / 500 / offline / maintenance — per-type copy and advice, a back button that degrades when the history stack is empty, live online status, and a copyable error ID behind collapsed diagnostics.

items.name: zyeon/roadmap-board
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A public product roadmap in planned / in-progress / shipped lanes, with optimistic upvoting that rolls back and reports the failure, per-lane empty states and real loading/empty/error branches.

items.name: zyeon/job-listings
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state careers board: roles grouped by department, three filters that really combine (department, location, remote-only), a live result count, and salary ranges whose absence is spelled out instead of left blank.

items.name: zyeon/git-graph
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A commit-DAG viewer with reusable swimlanes — topological ordering, lane reuse after merges, orphan roots, shallow-history tails, copyable full hashes and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/poll-results
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A poll / survey result readout — one bar per option with largest-remainder percentages that always total exactly 100%, tie-aware leader badges, a your-vote marker, and a ballot view that hides the counts until the visitor votes.

items.name: zyeon/resource-usage
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A quota panel for heterogeneous resources — per-unit formatting (1024-based bytes, throughput, duration, cores, counts, money), unlimited rows with no bar at all, rescaled over-quota tracks, collapsible groups and usage sorting.

items.name: zyeon/metric-comparison
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A period-over-period comparison table — current, previous, absolute change and change %, with polarity-aware tone, sortable columns, expandable breakdowns and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/token-usage-meter
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An LLM quota panel — tokens used vs quota, split by model with separate input/output prices, an exact cost estimate, days to reset and a burn-rate projection, in four contract-driven states.

items.name: zyeon/tool-call-trace
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An agent's tool-call tree — nested sub-calls with a capped indent, structured args and results in expandable JSON, one shared duration unit, first-class running/failed calls, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: zyeon/event-card
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An event card whose calendar tear-off survives cross-day, cross-month and cross-year spans, formats every instant in an explicit IANA zone, and drives an ordered capacity machine where ended outranks the seat count.

items.name: zyeon/keyboard-map
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A keyboard layout diagram with your app's shortcuts painted onto the caps — platform-correct glyphs and modifier order (⌘ ⌥ vs Ctrl Alt), whole-chord highlighting, and a readable binding list.

items.name: zyeon/csv-import
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A three-step CSV importer — RFC 4180 parsing (quoted delimiters, embedded newlines, doubled quotes), delimiter and BOM detection, auto-guessed column mapping with duplicate and required-field gates, and a capped preview that reports ragged rows by line number.

items.name: zyeon/recurrence-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A calendar-language repeat editor that writes an RFC 5545 RRULE — frequency, interval, weekday chips, "second Tuesday" / "last day of the month", and a Never / N times / until-date ending — with the next dates previewed from the same rule evaluator.
