items.name: zyeon/seat-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A zoomable SVG venue map for picking seats — section/row/seat keyboard navigation, per-seat spoken names, shape+pattern status encoding, a list fallback, max-seat and no-orphan rules.

items.name: zyeon/variant-selector
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Multi-dimension product options resolved against a sparse SKU matrix — impossible combinations stay visible and struck through, availability converges from either direction, and dead ends name the one dimension to change.

items.name: zyeon/model-selector
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An LLM model picker whose options carry context window, per-million input/output rates, capability badges and real availability — and can be filtered and sorted by them.

items.name: zyeon/pdf-viewer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A document viewer shell with a pluggable render layer — controlled paging synced to scroll, fit-width/fit-page zoom that re-fits on resize, thumbnail rail, text search, keyboard and pinch, named loading/404/damaged/encrypted states, and a native <object> fallback.

items.name: zyeon/video-timeline
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A controlled scrub track with chapter-segmented rail, buffered ranges, keyframe hover previews and draggable in/out trim handles — delta dragging, frame-accurate keys, no player attached.

items.name: zyeon/qr-scanner
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A camera QR reader on the native BarcodeDetector with a pluggable decoder — an enforced scan frame, a throttled decode loop, a per-value cooldown, an image fallback, and a camera that is always released.

items.name: zyeon/pagination-cursor
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A load-more control for cursor APIs — a synchronous in-flight guard so one cursor is never fetched twice, an optional intersection sentinel with a burst budget, retry that keeps the loaded rows, and a live-region count.

items.name: zyeon/tab-overflow
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A measured tab strip that folds the tabs it cannot fit into a "More" menu — real tablist semantics, the selected tab is never collapsed, and no breakpoints anywhere.

items.name: zyeon/rate-limit-notice
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A 429 panel whose cooldown recomputes from an absolute target instant, so a suspended tab wakes up to the right number — auto-unlock with milestone-only announcements and no auto-retry, remaining quota with icon/word/outline urgency, consecutive-backoff labelling and an upgrade CTA.

items.name: zyeon/conflict-resolver
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A field-level three-way merge for concurrent edits — base/mine/theirs per field, only the genuinely conflicting fields asked about as radiogroups, bulk fill with per-field override, and a merged record on submit.

items.name: zyeon/settings-page
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A settings page shell — section nav, per-section save, and an unsaved-changes guard that stops a section switch with save / discard / cancel instead of dropping the edit.

items.name: zyeon/api-keys-panel
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state API key manager built around show-the-secret-once — a forced acknowledgement before the reveal can be closed, a name-repeating revoke confirmation, and lifecycle plus never-used called out per key.

items.name: zyeon/chart-sankey
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state Sankey diagram that checks the books before it draws: flow conservation per node, cycle detection, longest-path layering, cross-layer ribbons and a minimum ribbon width, with an sr-only flow table.

items.name: zyeon/chart-cohort-retention
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A triangular cohort-retention table — one row per entry cohort, one column per period since signup, cells that carry both a colour-graded rate and its absolute count, with unobserved periods left blank instead of zeroed.

items.name: zyeon/chart-heatmap-matrix
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A rows × columns value grid with sequential and diverging colour scales — the diverging arms stay symmetric around the centre, the domain is fixable so two grids stay comparable, and missing values never render as zero.

items.name: zyeon/chart-bar-grouped
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state grouped bar chart that flips to horizontal rows when columns would go under 10px, textures every series so colour is never the only cue, and keeps missing readings distinct from measured zeros.

items.name: zyeon/use-optimistic
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Keyed optimistic updates for plain props and event handlers: props always reclaim a stale overlay so counters cannot drift, sync throws become rejections, repeat clicks on a pending key are refused, out-of-order resolves lose, and failures roll back with a readable error.

items.name: zyeon/use-event-source
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Subscribe to a Server-Sent Events stream with a four-state connection machine, capped exponential-backoff reconnects, named-event subscriptions and callbacks that never re-open the stream.

items.name: zyeon/use-query-param
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An SSR-safe hook that keeps a piece of state in a URL query parameter, with typed codecs, defaults kept out of the link, replace-by-default history and every instance on the page in sync.

items.name: zyeon/use-indexed-db
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An async IndexedDB-backed store hook: loading state, versioned upgrades, blocked-deadlock handling, quota errors, key-range queries and cross-tab invalidation.

items.name: zyeon/scrollbar-styles
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Six presets that re-skin the browser's own scrollbar in pure CSS — no JavaScript, no drawn thumb, and one capability-tiered sheet that keeps `::-webkit-scrollbar` and `scrollbar-width` from cancelling each other out.

items.name: zyeon/chart-pareto
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state Pareto chart: bars ranked high to low with a cumulative-percentage curve on a second axis, a configurable 80% line, and the crossing bar named.

items.name: zyeon/chart-boxplot
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state box plot comparing distributions side by side: R-7 quartiles, Tukey 1.5×IQR whiskers on real observations, de-overlapped outliers, and raw points for groups too small for quartiles.

items.name: zyeon/chart-bump
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state bump chart: one line per entity on a reversed integer position scale, competition ranking for ties, edge labels at both ends, and a broken line wherever an entity is off the board.

items.name: zyeon/chart-slope
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state slope chart for two points in time: labels at both ends, a pooling avoidance pass that never moves the points, leader lines back to the real endpoint, and a same-unit refusal.

items.name: zyeon/billing-history
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state invoice list — per-currency money through Intl, a six-state lifecycle with partial-refund arithmetic, real filters and pagination, and PDF links that never render as dead buttons.

items.name: zyeon/notification-preferences
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An events × channels notification matrix that saves as you toggle: per-switch pending and single-switch rollback on failure, locked always-on rows, a disconnected channel column with a real Connect entry point, row/column bulk actions with a bulk-vs-manual marker, and a quiet-hours window that wraps

items.name: zyeon/two-factor-setup
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The enable-2FA flow around its one irreversible step — QR plus a copyable manual key, a six-digit check whose attempt budget only ever goes down, and recovery codes rendered once behind a finish button that refuses to fire until they are saved.

items.name: zyeon/usage-dashboard
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A period-scoped usage block — headline, quota bar, cumulative burn-up curve and per-dimension breakdown all derived from one bucket array, so the four readouts cannot disagree; run-rate projection stated apart from actual usage, and period switches that never put a new label over old figures.

items.name: zyeon/empty-dashboard
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A first-run dashboard: welcome copy, a setup checklist whose progress counts done separately from skipped, a labelled skeleton of the filled dashboard, and a confirmed sample-data escape hatch — the block renders nothing once nothing is left to do.

items.name: zyeon/search-results
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state search results page — query echo, keyword highlighting, faceted type/recency/tag filters whose counts are the real post-click result count, and pagination that snaps back to page 1 on every filter change.

items.name: zyeon/checkout-form
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A one-page checkout — contact, delivery address, payment method and an order summary whose delivery, tax and payment fee are derived from the form in the same render, in integer minor units, so the lines always add up to the button and the money can never lag the address.

items.name: zyeon/order-confirmation
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A post-checkout receipt block — a dictatable, one-click-copyable order number, an itemised table whose money is refined to add up, a delivery window rather than a promised day, ship / pickup / digital fulfillment, and print styles that keep it on paper.

items.name: zyeon/feature-comparison
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A dated us-vs-competitors capability table — yes / partial / no / not-disclosed told apart by shape and word, numeric rows with a per-row unit, a frozen capability column, and a verified-on date measured against an injected now.

items.name: zyeon/case-study-grid
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state customer-story grid where the quantified result is the first-class field: every metric carries value, unit, direction and a required baseline (or says "No baseline captured"), industry and company-size facets really filter with truthful counts, and logos of any aspect ratio are opticall

items.name: zyeon/feature-flag-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A per-environment feature flag table — production toggles gated behind a confirmation that repeats the flag key, rollout percentage kept orthogonal to on/off, optimistic switches that roll back one at a time, expandable targeting rules, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: zyeon/webhook-log
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A webhook delivery log with the retry lifecycle built in — outcome classes that keep timeouts separate from status codes, a countdown to the next attempt derived from an injected clock, masked credential headers, collapsed payloads with honest truncation, and a guarded replay confirmation.

items.name: zyeon/citation-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The numbered reference list under an AI answer — numbering derived the same way Citation Chip derives it so the markers and the list always agree, repeated sources merged with a citation count, graded trust that never relies on colour, and sources with no usable URL that refuse to become dead links.

items.name: zyeon/dependency-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An auditable dependency tree — real semver comparison, graded staleness, ordered CVE severities, licence obligation classes, and the import chain behind every transitive package.

items.name: zyeon/sla-report
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A contract-side availability settlement — real period length, overlap-merged downtime, weighted or worst-service composite, an error budget that is allowed to read past 100%, and the service-credit rung the period landed on.

items.name: zyeon/screen-recorder
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A real getDisplayMedia screen recorder — surface picker, optional microphone mixdown, live duration and size, and a preview you can download.

items.name: zyeon/audio-transcript
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A timestamped, speaker-labelled transcript synced to a playhead — the spoken line highlights and stays in view until the reader scrolls away, any line seeks to its exact start, and search steps through every hit.

items.name: zyeon/fit-text
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One line of text scaled until it exactly fills the width it was given — headline, KPI number or cover title, sized from a real browser measurement instead of an estimate.

items.name: zyeon/balanced-heading
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A heading that breaks its lines to even lengths instead of stranding one word on the last line — pure CSS text-wrap with a copy-safe fallback for engines that lack it.

items.name: zyeon/pull-quote
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Editorial pull quote for body copy: centered, floated left/right with the text wrapping around it, or bled past the measure — figure + blockquote + figcaption, with a decorative quote mark that never lands in the clipboard.

items.name: zyeon/link-underline
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Underline motion for inline body links — slide, center, wipe or thicken — drawn per line box so wrapped links keep a rule on every line, with descender clearance, a focus ring hover never draws, and text-decoration fallbacks for reduced motion, forced colors and print.

items.name: zyeon/install-pwa-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An install CTA that catches beforeinstallprompt at module scope so a late-mounting button still gets it, and renders nothing at all when the app is installed, was refused recently, or cannot be installed here.

items.name: zyeon/record-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A record control with an idle → recording → processing → done state machine — drift-free elapsed timer, minimum/maximum take guards, and an optional hold-to-record gesture with slide-away cancel.

items.name: zyeon/voronoi-cells
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A slowly flowing Voronoi diagram on one canvas — organic cell walls, a tinted mosaic or separated pebbles, seeded so the same field comes back every time.

items.name: zyeon/bokeh-lights
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Slowly floating out-of-focus light discs on one canvas — seeded for a reproducible picture, painted from a pre-rendered sprite instead of a per-frame blur, with an opacity lever that keeps overlaid copy readable.

items.name: zyeon/scanlines
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A CRT line grille whose pitch is snapped to the display's physical pixel grid, with an optional one-pixel-per-step roll and a WCAG-clamped flicker.

items.name: zyeon/chat-sidebar
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A conversation-history sidebar — calendar-day groups cut in the display time zone, in-place rename with rollback, delete confirmed by title, pinning, local search with its own no-match state, and real loading/empty/error branches.

items.name: zyeon/chat-window
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A chat shell in three presentations — inline, docked and modal — with a focus trap, refcounted scroll lock and a resizable dock, that never re-creates the panel when you switch.

items.name: zyeon/streaming-text
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An incremental Markdown renderer for LLM output — finished blocks are frozen, half-written markup is closed speculatively, the caret rides the last character and screen readers hear the answer once.

items.name: zyeon/message-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An AI transcript whose scroll behaves — glued to the newest token while streaming, released the instant the reader scrolls up, anchored when older pages land, and windowed so a 1000-turn thread stays a dozen nodes wide.

items.name: zyeon/chat-composer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A managed chat composer: one send⇄stop button slot, optimistic draft clear with restore-on-failure, AbortSignal handoff, IME-safe Enter and attachments with their own upload lifecycle.

items.name: zyeon/message-actions
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The action bar under one chat message — revealed by hover, focus and touch alike (never hover alone), costing zero layout, with copy in either Markdown or plain text, an exclusive thumbs tri-state, a streaming-safe Regenerate and speech that stops when the message unmounts.

items.name: zyeon/reasoning-block
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A collapsible model-reasoning panel driven by the stream's lifecycle — auto-opens while tokens arrive, auto-collapses when they stop, and permanently stands down once the reader touches it.

items.name: zyeon/tool-call-card
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One agent tool call inline in a conversation — a first-class approval gate with a one-shot Approve/Decline, structured args and results, key-based redaction that keeps secrets out of the DOM, announced truncation for huge payloads, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: zyeon/citation-chip
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The inline [n] marker that trails a sentence in an AI answer — an inline box that cannot change the paragraph's line height, with a source card portalled past every clipping bubble.

items.name: zyeon/suggested-prompts
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Click-to-send conversation starters and follow-ups — a wrapping strip of one-shot cards that latches after the first pick, goes inert while the assistant streams, and re-rolls without collapsing the row.

items.name: zyeon/artifact-panel
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A side panel for the file the assistant keeps rewriting — a revision rail with the prompt behind each one, preview / source / changes, per-revision scroll memory, and copy plus download that always take the revision you are looking at.

items.name: zyeon/agent-steps
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A live agent run whose plan is still being written — steps stream in without moving what is already on screen, failures retry in place, and a replan cancels the rest of the plan instead of failing it.

items.name: zyeon/context-attachments
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The context list attached to a conversation — files, links, snippets and selections with their token cost, under a budget meter that spells out reserve + attachments = used and names exactly which entries get dropped when the window overflows.

items.name: zyeon/prompt-library
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A saved-prompt library with fill-in-the-blank templates — search across title, body and tags, faceted categories, a variable form ordered by first appearance, and a preview that is character-for-character what gets inserted.

items.name: zyeon/message-branch
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A compact pager for the sibling variants of one reply — an id-stable selection that survives late arrivals, follow-the-tip on regenerate, ends that never steal focus, and one announcement per move.

items.name: zyeon/chat-day-divider
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A muted separator for chat transcripts — day chip, unread watermark and context event — that derives Today/Yesterday from calendar days, relabels itself at local midnight, and can pin to the top while its day scrolls.

items.name: zyeon/message-skeleton
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A chat-shaped loading placeholder — seeded conversation rhythm, alternating bubbles or document rows, a sweep phase-shifted through the thread, and one late screen-reader announcement.

items.name: zyeon/streaming-markdown
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A progressive Markdown renderer for LLM streams that paints only what can no longer change — the ambiguous tail waits in a buffer instead of flashing raw markup.

items.name: zyeon/streaming-table
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A table that renders while its rows are still arriving — the header locks the column geometry on frame one, cells still in flight shimmer in place, and the footer count settles into a total.

items.name: zyeon/streaming-code
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A code panel that renders while the model is still writing it — caret on the last line, frozen finished lines, regex tinting, copy-what-arrived and auto-scroll the reader can break.

items.name: zyeon/model-compare
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A side-by-side arena for two answers to one prompt — per-side streaming states, derived speed, optional blind names, and a vote that fires exactly once.

items.name: zyeon/pinned-messages
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A pinned-messages strip for a conversation — one chip per pin, as many as genuinely fit measured against the real container, the rest collapsed into a +N more panel, unpin behind a confirmation that fires once, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: zyeon/message-search
items.description: [Zyeon UI] In-conversation search that expands from an icon into a field — debounced dispatch, a hit counter walked with Enter and Shift+Enter, and a result list of role, time and an excerpt with the query emphasised.

items.name: zyeon/edit-message
items.description: [Zyeon UI] In-place editor for a message that was already sent — it states how many replies the fork will drop, guards the draft on cancel, keeps it on a rejected resubmit, and never forks for unchanged text.

items.name: zyeon/quote-reply
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Quote-and-reply for a transcript — a floating Quote action over a text selection, a dismissible quote chip above the composer, and a whole-message fallback.

items.name: zyeon/conversation-summary
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A compaction seam for long chats — a hairline marker that reports how many earlier messages were summarized, discloses the bullet summary, and offers a restore that can only fire once.

items.name: zyeon/scroll-to-latest
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A floating jump-to-latest pill for a growing chat viewport — a sentinel decides when the reader has left the floor, arrivals since then ride in the badge, and one click re-pins follow mode.

items.name: zyeon/read-aloud-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A per-message listen toggle — progress ring, tiny equalizer and a speed pill — driven by the browser's speech engine or by your own TTS callbacks.

items.name: zyeon/translation-toggle
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A per-message translation affordance — a pill that names the detected source language, crossfades between original and translation while the box tweens between their measured heights, re-aims at another target language from a menu, and stands in with a skeleton shaped by the source while a request i

items.name: zyeon/ai-disclaimer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The 'AI can make mistakes. Check important info.' line — inline, banner and details-popover chromes, role=note so it never interrupts, and a one-shot dismissal that hands persistence to the app.

items.name: zyeon/ai-badge
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A provenance chip for AI-touched content — generated / assisted / human-edited, with the model and timestamp behind a tooltip or popover and a contrast-safe overlay mode for images.

items.name: zyeon/stop-generating
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One button slot for the whole run — Stop while tokens arrive, Continue generating when the reply hit its length cap, nothing when idle, with a scoped Esc binding and a one-shot lock on both actions.

items.name: zyeon/regenerate-menu
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A split retry control for one assistant answer — the button half re-runs it, the chevron opens a menu with a model submenu that marks the current model and an inline instruction field, and every path emits one discriminated action.

items.name: zyeon/response-feedback
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Thumbs up or down on one AI answer, with a follow-up panel of reason chips and a comment, and exactly one submission per message — locked into a receipt when it lands.

items.name: zyeon/share-conversation
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A publish-a-link share dialog for a chat thread — server-issued URL, optimistic visibility and attachment writes with rollback, copy feedback and a destructive revoke confirm.

items.name: zyeon/conversation-export
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An export menu for a whole conversation — scope radio, a size estimate on every format, and a row that spins, ticks or turns into Retry without the menu ever closing under it.

items.name: zyeon/answer-sources
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The numbered favicon cards behind one AI answer — a scrolling strip or an expandable list, the retrieved excerpt one hover or one Tab away, dead sources that refuse to link, and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/confidence-meter
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A response-confidence reading — segmented bar or small ring banded by your own cut points, with a 'why' disclosure that breaks the score into per-signal factor rows.

items.name: zyeon/moderation-notice
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Content-policy interruption states for chat — blocked input, withheld response and softened answer, with category chips that cross-highlight the flagged passage, a one-shot appeal action, and role=alert only when something was actually stopped.

items.name: zyeon/slash-command-menu
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A caret-anchored "/" command popup for a textarea you already own — sectioned list, roving keyboard cursor, and one commit that either inserts a token or fires an action.

items.name: zyeon/dictation-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A composer mic that turns speech into committed text — toggle or hold-to-talk, an amplitude ring, a live interim chip, and exactly one transcript per session.

items.name: zyeon/prompt-variables
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An inline template filler — every {{variable}} slot becomes a chip-sized text, select or number editor inside the sentence, repeats mirror the first one live, and the preview is byte-identical to what gets sent.

items.name: zyeon/prompt-enhancer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An "improve my prompt" affordance for a prompt field — a shimmering request state, a word-level diff of the rewrite, and a one-shot Accept with undo.

items.name: zyeon/persona-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Choose the assistant persona a turn runs under — seeded avatar cards or a compact combobox, capability tags, the system-prompt fragment each persona quietly injects, unavailable rows that say why, and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/tone-selector
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A radio-group row of rewrite tones where every pill carries a sample phrase, and the custom tone applies only once its free-text instruction is committed.

items.name: zyeon/sampling-controls
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A controlled panel for temperature, top-p, max tokens and the penalties — editable value badges, a worded creative-to-precise scale, per-parameter revert, and a nudge when temperature and top-p are tuned together.

items.name: zyeon/system-prompt-editor
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A system-prompt editing surface: an autosizing monospace field with placeholder highlighting painted behind the caret, a live token estimate against a budget, presets that insert without destroying work, and an unsaved bar that owns Save and Discard.

items.name: zyeon/chat-mode-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The composer's capability chips — web search, deep research, canvas, image — with a plan gate, a context gate, a cap, conflicting pairs, and a set that repairs itself when the model changes.

items.name: zyeon/context-limit-banner
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A context-window warning that escalates from a quiet notice to a blocking wall — a thin usage meter with threshold ticks, rising-edge-only announcements, dismissal that re-arms on escalation, and the three exits out of a full conversation.

items.name: zyeon/agent-inbox
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A human-in-the-loop queue of everything your agents parked on a person — triage ranking, overdue flags, one-shot inline Approve/Deny, grouping by agent or urgency, and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/agent-plan
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An agent's plan while it is still a draft — ordered steps with their rationale, risk chips on the dangerous ones, per-step include/exclude, inline rewriting, a live duration and cost estimate for the steps you kept, and a one-shot Approve or Request changes.

items.name: zyeon/task-queue
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An agent work queue — live progress and the current step for running tasks, drag-to-reprioritise queued ones with a keyboard path, one-shot cancel and retry per row, a concurrency budget in the header, and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/agent-status
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A compact agent state chip — a dot and a label morphing through idle, thinking, tool use, waiting-on-you and failure, with a drift-free phase clock and one polite announcement per phase.

items.name: zyeon/run-summary
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The receipt for one finished agent run — outcome and reason, a duration/token/cost stat strip, and an expandable per-model table that says so when its rows don't add up to the headline totals.

items.name: zyeon/chat-checkpoint
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A conversation save point that guards its own restore — named marker, live age, auto vs manual origin, an "N messages since" cost line, and a one-shot rollback that explains the fork before it happens.

items.name: zyeon/computer-use-panel
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A computer-use session viewer — screenshots with the agent's click, type, scroll and drag markers drawn on them, a synced action log you step through with the arrow keys, and live follow-and-takeover.

items.name: zyeon/web-preview
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A browser pane an agent drives — read-only address bar, a history scrubber that follows the newest page until you step back, a load bar, fit-to-pane width presets and a console drawer.

items.name: zyeon/mcp-server-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state MCP connections manager — transport and live status per server, an enable switch that is intent while status stays reality, cached tool chips with an honest count, and per-row reconnect or authorize.

items.name: zyeon/tool-catalog
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A searchable registry of the tools an agent may call — source facets with live counts, per-tool allow switches, parameter tables that open themselves when the query lands inside a signature, and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/agent-handoff
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An agent-to-agent handoff marker — from/to avatars, a track that marches while the transfer is in flight, the reason control moved, chips for the context passed along, and who holds the run; compact divider and detailed card variants.

items.name: zyeon/agent-roster
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A multi-agent fleet panel — per-agent state dot, model chip, current-task line and capacity bar, attention-first sorting, a real listbox keyboard path, and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/agent-graph
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A workflow DAG drawn in pure SVG from nodes and edges alone — layered auto-layout with crossing reduction, typed node shapes, status tints, flowing active wires, loop-back routing and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/inline-completion
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Ghost text for a textarea — a caret-aligned mirror paints the model's continuation in muted type, Tab accepts it, Cmd/Ctrl+Right takes one word, Esc dismisses.

items.name: zyeon/file-change-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The files an agent touched — middle-truncated paths, A/M/D/R marks, churn bars scaled across the whole run, one-shot Accept/Revert per file plus a bulk bar, and a slot for the inline diff.

items.name: zyeon/interpreter-output
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The result of one code-interpreter run — source collapsed by default, stdout / stderr / rich results behind tabs derived from what actually arrived, the exception pinned above them, tail-capped output that sticks while it streams, and a one-shot Re-run.

items.name: zyeon/human-handoff
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A bot-to-human escalation card that walks one ticket through request, queue, connecting, connected and an offline leave-your-address fallback.

items.name: zyeon/scheduled-tasks
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A list of scheduled agent automations — a human cadence next to a live countdown to the next run, the last run's outcome inline, a pause switch, a one-shot manual trigger, the failure printed on the row that broke, and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/retrieval-results
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The RAG retrieval step opened up — ranked chunk cards with source and page, a similarity bar carrying the pipeline cutoff, whole-word query emphasis, a used-in-answer badge wired to its citation number, and a threshold divider that refuses to lie.

items.name: zyeon/knowledge-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A grounding-scope selector for collections, files and links — tri-state collections that cascade only over what is actually selectable, per-source document and chunk counts with index freshness, an accounting bar that prices the selection in chunks, and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/indexing-progress
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An ingest pipeline board — per-source parse → chunk → embed chips, a byte-weighted aggregate with a derived ETA, failures that keep the stage they died at behind a one-shot retry, and a completed summary.

items.name: zyeon/web-search-card
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One web-search step inline in a conversation — the queries the model typed, the pages that came back, which ones it actually read and which ended up cited, with a data-driven reading shimmer and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/voice-orb
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A voice-session orb — layered token gradients that breathe when idle, ripple to a 0..1 amplitude while listening, swirl while thinking and pulse while speaking.

items.name: zyeon/voice-chat
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A realtime voice session panel — speaking orb, word-by-word live captions, mute, mic picker, connection meter, session clock, and an end-of-call summary.

items.name: zyeon/live-captions
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A broadcast-style caption bar for a live recogniser feed — interim words render muted and solidify when finalised, a rolling two-line window follows the speech, speaker chips carry the turn, and the panel hides itself after silence.

items.name: zyeon/voice-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Pick the TTS voice a reply is spoken in — cards or a combobox, language and accent chips, neutral timbre tags, and a play button that auditions without selecting, with exactly one sample sounding at a time.

items.name: zyeon/model-card
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One model's spec sheet — context window, max output and cutoff, tri-state capability chips, per-million-token pricing with the cached-read discount, benchmark bars that switch to a signed comparison against a baseline, and a deprecation notice that names the successor.

items.name: zyeon/cost-breakdown
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An LLM cost receipt — every metered line as quantity × rate = amount in micro-unit money that keeps sub-cent charges, grouping by model or kind, a highlighted prompt-caching savings line, and four contract-driven states.

items.name: zyeon/eval-scorecard
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One evaluation run at a glance — an overall dial marked with the pass gate, per-criterion bars carrying their own gate ticks and baseline deltas, regressions called out by name, and the worst failing cases disclosed on the row that owns them.

items.name: zyeon/logprobs-viewer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Token-level probabilities for a model response — the answer itself heat-tinted by uncertainty on one chart token, dotted-underlined below a live threshold, with top-k alternatives as probability bars on hover, focus or arrow key.

items.name: zyeon/finetune-status
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One fine-tune run as a card — a pipeline strip that keeps the stage a stopped run died at, derived step/epoch progress, a scrubbable train/validation loss sparkline with broken eval gaps, hyperparameter rows, a checkpoint radiogroup that re-targets the deploy action, and a one-shot cancel behind an

items.name: zyeon/batch-jobs
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A batch inference jobs table — middle-truncated copyable job ids, a stacked done/failed/pending bar per job, spend so far, age and ETA derived from an injected clock, an expandable failed-request preview, a one-shot cancel, partial-result downloads, and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/safety-controls
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Per-category content thresholds on a four-rung scale — a plain-language line for what each rung actually does, strictness presets that batch-set every row, policy floors and locked rows, and an unsaved-changes bar that names the filters you are about to loosen.

items.name: zyeon/memory-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The things an assistant remembers about someone, as a list they can audit — inline editing behind a one-editor lock, a two-step bin that fires exactly once, an add box that refuses duplicates, per-memory and master switches, the "used in this chat" highlight, and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/custom-instructions
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An end-user preference form for assistant instructions: autosizing questions with example popovers, per-field character budgets, one switch that gates every field without erasing it, and a Save / Cancel bar whose Cancel stays undoable.

items.name: zyeon/model-router
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A routing policy panel — ordered first-match-wins rules with testable condition chips, per-rule switches with optimistic rollback, a health-aware fallback chain, and a prompt tester that names the rule which claims a request and the ones never asked.

items.name: zyeon/cache-indicator
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A prompt-cache chip for one request — hit / partial / miss / write derived from the token counts, a tooltip breakdown of cached vs fresh tokens and money saved, and a self-correcting TTL ring that flips the chip to expired and fires onExpire exactly once.

items.name: zyeon/tokenizer-preview
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A tokenizer playground for input text — alternating-tinted token chunks from a deterministic built-in splitter or your own, token/char/word counts, a live cost estimate at an editable per-Mtok rate, and markers for whitespace and unusually long tokens.

items.name: zyeon/few-shot-editor
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A few-shot example manager — paired input/output cards you add, duplicate, drag-reorder and switch off, with per-example and total token estimates against a budget, and gentle hints for blank outputs and near-duplicate inputs.

items.name: zyeon/embedding-map
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A 2-D embedding scatter in pure SVG — clusters carried by chart token and mark shape, centroid names that yield instead of overlapping, a query wired to the retriever's own ranking, and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/structured-output
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A JSON-mode response rendered through its schema — labelled rows in schema order, kind-aware values, field-level expected-vs-got validation, pending fields while the stream runs, off-schema keys kept, and a raw JSON view.

items.name: zyeon/pii-detector
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A pre-send privacy scan — detected emails, phones, cards, IDs and names underlined by category, a hover or focus popover per entity, a mask-or-keep decision on each, and a masked preview of exactly what will be sent.

items.name: zyeon/thinking-indicator
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A transcript-line thinking status — a highlight sweeping the label, a phase walk that never lies about progress, a clock that only appears once the wait is real, and a fade-out that hands the slot to the answer.

items.name: zyeon/queue-position
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A generation-queue waiting room — a position dial that rolls down through every place it passes, a drain bar measured from where you joined, a self-correcting ETA, an optimistic notify-me switch and an arm-before-you-lose-it leave action.

items.name: zyeon/conversation-title
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An auto-generated chat title — a sparkle provenance hint, click-to-edit rename with a length counter, and a regenerate button that shimmer-cycles candidate names before settling.

items.name: zyeon/ai-selection-menu
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An Ask-AI row that floats over a text selection — action shortcuts, submenus, a free-form question field, one captured excerpt and a keyboard path in.

items.name: zyeon/rewrite-preview
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A prose rewrite review panel — sentence-level tints, per-paragraph Accept / Keep verdicts, measured delta chips and a one-shot Apply that hands back the merged draft.

items.name: zyeon/assistant-avatar
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An assistant identity chip whose ring carries the state — a portrait or a seed-derived token gradient inside, ripples while listening, a conic sweep while thinking, equalizer ticks while speaking.

items.name: zyeon/image-generation
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An image-generation result card — the prompt above a variations grid that blurs up and scans while it renders, per-image download / upscale / vary, a first-class safety-blocked state, and the seed behind whichever variation you pick.

items.name: zyeon/video-generation
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A text-to-video render as one card — prompt, a storyboard that fills in frame by frame, a staged bar that cannot rewind, a poster with a duration chip when it lands, and a failure that keeps the frames it managed to make.

items.name: zyeon/chatbot-widget
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An embeddable support chat widget — launcher bubble with an acknowledged unread badge, a panel that keeps its draft when minimised, quick replies, and a rating row on the way out.

items.name: zyeon/ai-answer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A search-answer section — the question, the sources it stands on, prose whose every sentence carries a numbered chip back to a source, follow-ups, and a streaming pass where sources land before the text.

items.name: zyeon/research-report
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The finished output of a deep-research run — prose whose citation numbers are derived from one walk of the data, per-section source chips, an outline that follows the reader, and a methodology footer that shows the queries run and the sources rejected.

items.name: zyeon/agent-dashboard
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An agent-ops overview — KPI tiles whose trends are derived, a runs-over-time bar chart, a recent-runs table whose failing rows expand to the error line, and a live-agent rail that filters the table without moving the window figures.

items.name: zyeon/assistant-welcome
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A first-run assistant hero — greeting, capability cards and starter chips that prefill the host's composer instead of sending, over a token-only animated accent.

items.name: zyeon/api-error-card
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An LLM API failure card whose recovery is chosen by error class — a countdown ring with one-shot opt-in auto-retry for 429s, a key-settings exit for auth, a status-page exit for overload, and trim / summarize exits when the context is too long.

items.name: zyeon/stream-inspector
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A developer feed of the raw frames of one streamed model response — per-frame offsets and gaps, a TTFT marker line, header stats, stall marking with jump-to-next, delta folding, tail-follow with break-away and a pretty/raw toggle per row.

items.name: zyeon/prompt-diff
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A word-level diff of two prompt versions — split or unified columns, version chips with author, date and run count, side swap, per-version copy and a one-shot restore.

items.name: zyeon/throughput-meter
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A live tokens-per-second readout — rolling sparkline, time to first token, current-vs-average delta, a stall flag raised by the meter's own clock, and a run summary when the stream ends.

items.name: zyeon/context-inspector
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A stacked map of the assembled prompt — system, tools, files, memory and history as proportional slices with per-entry token costs, an expandable breakdown that never hides what it didn't itemise, a reply-headroom band that warns before the answer stops fitting, and a what-if preview of every evicta

items.name: zyeon/guardrail-trace
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The safety evaluation of one request, rule by rule — a verdict header derived from the rules rather than asserted beside them, matched-span excerpts with per-rule rationale, verdict filter chips, a passing-row budget that can never hide a block, and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/conversation-tree
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The branching map of a whole chat — a flat parentId list nested into a vertical tree, the current path lit as a continuous spine, abandoned forks folded into counted stubs, WAI-ARIA tree keyboard navigation, and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/agent-permissions
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A capability-scoping panel for one agent — per-tool switches with risk bands, a spend cap metered against what is already spent, an add-and-remove domain allowlist, an ordered file-access scale with policy ceilings, and an unsaved-changes bar that counts every change that expands the agent's authori

items.name: zyeon/latency-breakdown
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Per-request phase bars — queue, TTFT, generation and tool time on one shared scale, with a floor that keeps sub-pixel phases visible, a legend that ranks the runs by a phase, and a p50/p95 footer that names the population it came from.

items.name: zyeon/prompt-arena
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Pairwise prompt results as a scoreboard you can act on — an A/tie/B split bar, a verdict gated by a Wilson interval instead of a raw lead, sampled matchups with their own vote splits, the two outputs for one input on demand, and a rerun that fires exactly once.

items.name: zyeon/dataset-browser
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A prompt/completion dataset row by row — one-line pair previews, quality-flag chips with the rule behind each one, the full pair one click away, OR'd flag filters, and a selection that survives filtering feeding a bulk export/remove bar.

items.name: zyeon/labeling-queue
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A one-item-at-a-time human labeling queue — number-key label buttons, skip and flag escapes, a resumable "34 / 200" progress bar, undo for the last call, an all-done screen, and a one-shot lock per item so a double press can never double-label.

items.name: zyeon/detection-overlay
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Object-detection results drawn over the picture they came from — per-class tinted boxes with label and confidence chips, a live confidence gate, a class legend, and a rail whose hover, focus and selection stay in sync with the boxes.

items.name: zyeon/ocr-viewer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A scanned page beside the text read off it, kept in sync both ways — hover or focus a line to light up its source box, click a box to focus its line, with low-confidence words underlined in place.

items.name: zyeon/upgrade-prompt
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An in-feature paywall — usage note, benefit bullets, a two-tier mini compare, an async upgrade CTA and a "remind me tomorrow" snooze that round-trips through the host, as a banner or as an overlay that blurs only its own box.

items.name: zyeon/usage-alerts
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A budget alert-rule manager — threshold tripwires on a scale that runs past 100%, per-rule channels, a one-shot test send with a real in-flight state, and a fired-alert history waiting to be acknowledged, in four contract-driven states.

items.name: zyeon/request-history
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A playground's run rail — every request with the model and knobs it was sent with, pinned favourites kept above the churn, one click to load a run back into the editor, and a confirmation when that would overwrite your draft.

items.name: zyeon/open-in-chat
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A provider menu that turns the content on the page into a written prompt and hands it to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or the clipboard — deeplink when it fits the URL, copy when it does not.

items.name: zyeon/mcp-install-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A one-click MCP install control — one server description, translated per client into a Claude Code command, a Claude Desktop or VS Code config or a Cursor deeplink, with copy feedback, placeholder env keys and a verify-connection check.

items.name: zyeon/commit-card
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One agent commit as a card — a Conventional Commits badge parsed out of the raw git message, the files it touched behind an announced cap, an agent and timestamp line, a two-step one-shot revert, and a grouped rail for a whole run.

items.name: zyeon/sandbox-status
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A sandbox lifecycle card — provisioning through reclaimed, CPU / memory meters, an uptime clock that freezes on teardown, and restart / tear-down behind a confirm and a one-shot lock.

items.name: zyeon/fallback-notice
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An inline "answered by a backup model" notice — the failed primary and the model that answered as a chip chain, reason-class copy, and a one-shot retry-with-primary button that suppresses itself when a retry cannot help.

items.name: zyeon/persona-editor
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An authoring form for one assistant persona: a seed-derived face with a deterministic shuffle, trait chips that refuse rather than truncate, a tone select, budgeted instructions, a preview bubble recomposed on every keystroke, and a save bar that names which fields moved.

items.name: zyeon/content-credentials
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A C2PA-flavoured provenance panel — a four-rung signature verdict, the signing issuer, the created/edited/exported chain, an expandable raw manifest, and a compact chip that opens the whole thing in a popover.

items.name: zyeon/rate-limit-meter
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A live request-budget meter — a rolling-window gauge, a burst-dot timeline of recent calls, an escalating severity band, an expiry-aware forecast of when the limit lands, and a reset countdown once it does.

items.name: zyeon/byok-setup
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A bring-your-own-key card — configurable provider slots, a masked field that cleans what you paste and checks the shape per provider, a cancellable live test with latency or a reason, a storage disclaimer that never leaves, and removal behind a confirm.

items.name: zyeon/data-controls
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An AI privacy panel where every control saves on its own — a training consent switch with a plain-language consequence line, a retention scale that warns when it deletes nothing, an export job with progress, and a type-to-confirm deletion.

items.name: zyeon/chat-import
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A staged importer for assistant exports — reads ChatGPT, Claude and JSON-Lines files, previews the conversations it recovered with per-item checkboxes, and ends on a summary that names every skipped item and why.

items.name: zyeon/ai-form-assist
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Model-filled form fields — a sparkle per row, ghost-rendered values with a confidence tint, source popovers, a staggered fill-all wave, and per-field accept, dismiss and undo.

items.name: zyeon/translation-panel
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A document beside its machine translation, aligned segment by segment — hover or focus a pair and both halves light up, with per-segment translated / waiting / failed states, a swappable language header, a formality control and progress over the whole job.

items.name: zyeon/date-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A typeable single-date field with a calendar panel — Intl-driven formatting and parsing, a complete keyboard grid, and refusals that keep what you typed.

items.name: zyeon/input-group
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A composable affix shell for one field — static text, icon slots and interactive trailing controls flush inside a single border, with size, invalid and disabled flowing down to every slot.

items.name: zyeon/icon-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A searchable icon grid in a popover — the pickable set is a name → component map you supply, paged into bounded windows, with combobox keyboard navigation and recents.

items.name: zyeon/button-group
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A welded row or column of independent actions — 1px seams, outer corners only, an unclipped focus ring, and a measured unweld when the row stops fitting.

items.name: zyeon/toggle-group
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A row or column of independent aria-pressed toggles — one tab stop per option, optional min/max limits that refuse out loud, and per-item disabled reasons.

items.name: zyeon/skip-link
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A hidden-until-focused link cluster that moves focus — not just the scroll — to a page landmark, clearing a sticky header by a configurable offset.

items.name: zyeon/popconfirm
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A confirmation anchored to the control that raised it — non-modal, keyboard-complete, one-shot, with a pending state and an inline rejection that keeps the panel open.

items.name: zyeon/pull-to-refresh
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A pull-down-to-refresh wrapper: a rubber-banded drag claimed only while the scroller is at the top, a threshold that arms the release, an async refresh held until it settles, and a keyboard-reachable refresh button.

items.name: zyeon/infinite-scroll
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A sentinel-driven feed with four first-class data states — a failed page keeps every row already loaded, the in-flight lock is a ref so no page is ever fetched twice, and the manual trigger plus a role=feed keyboard walk make it reachable without a mouse.

items.name: zyeon/swipe-actions
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A list row whose horizontal drag uncovers real action buttons — resistance, velocity snapping, a full-swipe commit, a second press for destructive actions, and the same actions on the keyboard.

items.name: zyeon/chart-sunburst
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state zoomable sunburst in hand-rolled SVG — concentric rings whose sweeps compose exactly, click-to-zoom with a breadcrumb, keyboard-walkable slices and an sr-only breakdown table.

items.name: zyeon/chart-chord
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state chord diagram drawn in plain SVG — entities on a ring sized by inflow plus outflow, bezier ribbons sized by volume, symmetric pairs or directed arrowheads, a keyboard-walkable ring and an sr-only flow table.

items.name: zyeon/chart-violin
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state violin plot that estimates each group's density itself — Silverman bandwidth, a quartile box inside the silhouette, prominence-tested peak detection and an sr-only stats table.

items.name: zyeon/chart-ridgeline
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state ridgeline (joyplot) that estimates every row's density itself — one shared axis, overlapping curves, keyboard-walkable rows with a peak and median readout, and a pinnable median comparison line.

items.name: zyeon/chart-parallel-coordinates
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state parallel coordinates plot for mixed-unit records — per-axis normalisation, drag-to-brush filtering that dims rather than deletes, draggable axis order, and a rank-correlation reading for every neighbouring pair.

items.name: zyeon/chart-scatter-matrix
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A SPLOM whose panels share one domain per variable, brushes a record across every panel at once, puts distributions on the diagonal and Pearson r on the upper triangle, and states its panel cap instead of melting on 20 variables.

items.name: zyeon/chart-marimekko
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state mosaic chart where column width is each column's share of the total and stacked height is its internal mix, so a cell's area is its share of everything — with a minimum-width floor, texture tiers past the fifth band, and labels that drop out cell by cell.

items.name: zyeon/chart-dumbbell
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state dumbbell chart — one row per category, two dots joined by a bar on one shared scale, ranked by valence-aware change with direction carried by shape, arrow and row order as well as colour.

items.name: zyeon/chart-stream
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state streamgraph whose bands stack on a wiggle-minimising baseline — inside-out ordering, overshoot-free monotone curves, a per-column readout and an sr-only series-by-tick table.

items.name: zyeon/chart-bubble
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state bubble chart in plain SVG: area-proportional radii from a zero baseline, hue paired with fill texture for the fourth dimension, and an optional time slider that interpolates positions between snapshots.

items.name: zyeon/chart-pyramid
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state back-to-back band chart — two cohorts mirrored on one shared scale, with per-side totals, an earlier period overlaid as dashed outlines, and every band keyboard-reachable with a readout.

items.name: zyeon/chart-hexbin
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state hexbin that bins the raw scatter itself — nearest-centre binning, sqrt / linear / quantile bands, colour paired with hexagon size, a live bin-radius control and a ranked screen-reader table.

items.name: zyeon/chart-word-cloud
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state word cloud that sizes terms by the square root of their count and packs them along a deterministic spiral, with every word a focusable button and a ranked list for screen readers.

items.name: zyeon/chart-venn
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An area-proportional Venn for two or three sets that measures what it drew and falls back to a labelled region table when circles cannot tell the truth.

items.name: zyeon/chart-polar-area
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A Nightingale rose where every period owns an equal angle and the radius is area-corrected, drawing measured zeros, missing readings and below-zero periods each in their own way.

items.name: zyeon/chart-radial-bar
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Concentric arc bars — one ring per category on one shared ceiling, with a per-ring target tick, capped overflow, anticlockwise negatives and an sr-only value table.

items.name: zyeon/chart-tile-map
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A grid cartogram where every region is an equal-size tile at a hand-supplied grid position, classed by quantile, equal interval or manual breaks — choropleth readability with no projection and no geographic data.

items.name: zyeon/chart-burndown
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state sprint burndown: remaining work against an ideal that only burns on working days, scope changes drawn as steps, and a projected finish from a burn rate a descope cannot fake.

items.name: zyeon/chart-cumulative-flow
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state cumulative flow diagram that reads band thickness as work in progress and the horizontal gap between the arrival and delivery curves as approximate lead time, annotated on the plot and reachable by keyboard.

items.name: zyeon/chart-control
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state SPC control chart that estimates its own limits from the moving range and flags every rule violation with the rule it broke.

items.name: zyeon/chart-waffle
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state waffle (square pie) that apportions categories onto a countable grid with largest-remainder rounding, reserves a cell for shares worth less than one, and keeps the palette readable past five categories.

items.name: zyeon/chart-arc-diagram
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state arc diagram in plain SVG — nodes on one sequence-preserving baseline, half-ellipse arcs sized by weight, back-edges below the axis, hover to raise a node's arcs, and a keyboard walk over an sr-only node and arc table.

items.name: zyeon/multi-select
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A multi-selection field: removable chips with a +N collapse in the trigger, a searchable checkbox listbox, select-all / clear, group headings, and a cap that refuses out loud.

items.name: zyeon/checkbox-group
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A flat fieldset of checkboxes with a genuinely indeterminate select-all, per-row descriptions, shift-range selection, and min/max limits that answer with a message instead of a dead control.

items.name: zyeon/assignee-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A people picker with searchable presence-aware rows, a first-class Unassigned option, a recently-assigned shortcut group, single or multi assignment, blocked rows that say why, and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/password-generator
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A crypto-backed password generator with a length slider, required character sets, look-alike exclusion, a live entropy readout and an explicit refusal for impossible rule sets.

items.name: zyeon/key-value-editor
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An editable list of flat key/value pairs — drag or Alt+Arrow to reorder, switch a row off instead of deleting it, paste a block of Key: value lines, and see both halves of every duplicate key.

items.name: zyeon/sort-builder
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A multi-key sort composer — ordered field plus direction rules, drag or keyboard reprioritising, direction wording that follows the field type, and a live plain-language summary of the whole chain.

items.name: zyeon/activity-feed
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A grouped activity stream — consecutive entries that share a verb and a target fold into one line, with day separators, an unread boundary and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/stopwatch
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A count-up stopwatch with start/pause/reset and lap recording, timed off a monotonic clock so laps stay exact and a throttled background tab never loses time.

items.name: zyeon/calendar-month
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A month grid of events — multi-day bars packed into shared lanes, a "+N more" day peek, today and out-of-month cells distinguished, configurable week start and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/timeline-swimlane
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Events across parallel resource lanes on one shared time axis, with overlap stacking, hour/day/week zoom, a caller-supplied now marker and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/dashboard-grid
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A draggable, resizable widget grid: widgets snap to a column grid, collisions push neighbours down deterministically, and every accepted change emits the whole layout for the consumer to persist.

items.name: zyeon/column-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A table column manager: show/hide toggles, drag or keyboard reorder, pinned columns that refuse to hide with a reason, search and reset — emitting the ordered visible set.

items.name: zyeon/type-scale
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A living typography specimen: every step set in real type, its px, rem, leading and tracking read back off the DOM, with copy-the-token rows and a heading / paragraph / numerals switcher.

items.name: zyeon/color-palette
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A live specimen sheet for a theme's color tokens — chips grouped by role, values read back from the DOM, ink/fill pairing previews and one-click copy.

items.name: zyeon/contrast-checker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A WCAG contrast readout for one colour pair — resolved through the live cascade, composited on a canvas, with AA/AAA verdicts and the nearest passing lightness.

items.name: zyeon/undo-toast
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An optimistic-delete toast: the row disappears at once, a countdown ring holds the destructive commit, and hover or focus pauses the window.

items.name: zyeon/toolbar-overflow
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An action bar that measures itself off-screen and moves the actions it cannot fit into a trailing overflow menu, lowest priority first.

items.name: zyeon/export-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An export menu for a data table — row scope, a column subset, a live size estimate on every format, and a row that generates, ticks or turns into Retry without the menu closing under it.

items.name: zyeon/oauth-buttons
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A third-party sign-in row whose brand colours arrive as props — one provider goes in flight, the rest lock without ever going natively disabled, and the last-used one stays marked.

items.name: zyeon/pan-zoom
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A pan-and-zoom viewport for content of known size — wheel, pinch and drag anchored under the pointer, a fit / actual-size toolbar, and a full keyboard path.

items.name: zyeon/prose
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A typographic wrapper for CMS or Markdown HTML: token-only vertical rhythm, heading scale, lists, quotes, code, tables and figures, with size, measure and compact axes.

items.name: zyeon/status-page
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A public status page whose overall banner is derived from the worst service state and open incident, with per-service 90-day uptime strips, timestamped incident updates and upcoming maintenance windows.

items.name: zyeon/nps-survey
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A whole Net Promoter Score round in one block: a keyboard-reachable 0–10 scale, a follow-up question reworded per detractor / passive / promoter bucket, an optional contact-me box, and a one-submission-per-session thank-you.

items.name: zyeon/invite-team
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state invite panel: a paste-a-list email field with per-address reasons, a role per invite, a seat meter that blocks over-allocation, undoable revoke and a copyable join link.

items.name: zyeon/use-map
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Map-shaped React state: set, setAll, remove, replace and reset over a real Map, with any key type, copy-on-write updates, no-op bail-outs and a never-changing actions object.

items.name: zyeon/use-raf
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A requestAnimationFrame loop hook that hands every frame a delta/elapsed payload, with start/stop controls, an fps cap and automatic hidden-tab suspension.

items.name: zyeon/use-script
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An on-demand external script loader hook that reports idle, loading, ready or error and keeps exactly one deduped tag per src across every caller.

items.name: zyeon/use-focus-within
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A callback-ref hook that reports whether focus is inside a subtree — no flicker when focus moves between children, and it still flips off when the focused node is removed.

items.name: zyeon/menu-bar
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A desktop application menubar — one click opens, hover then travels between menus, with submenus, shortcut hints, checkable rows and a full roving keyboard.

items.name: zyeon/back-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A back control that traverses history when there is an in-app page behind it and follows a real href when the visitor arrived cold — so a deep link never dead-ends.

items.name: zyeon/ruby-text
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Ruby annotations for CJK and phonetic glosses — parsed from an inline notation or paired arrays, with a parenthesised fallback, per-annotation alignment and leading reserved up front so hiding the readings never reflows the paragraph.

items.name: zyeon/drop-cap
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The oversized opening letter, floated across N lines with its cap-top and baseline solved from the font's metrics — hangs an opening quotation mark and skips short paragraphs.

items.name: zyeon/text-diff
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A word- or sentence-level diff of two prose versions — one unified flow or two columns, with insertions and deletions marked by underline, strikethrough and screen-reader wording instead of colour alone.

items.name: zyeon/payment-buttons
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An express-checkout wallet row — availability decides what is offered at all, brand paint and marks arrive as props, and a dismissed sheet is never dressed up as a failure.

items.name: zyeon/print-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A print trigger that prepares the page before the dialog opens — a cancellable async hook, a print scope class, and a restore raced between afterprint, the print media query and a timeout.

items.name: zyeon/video-playlist
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A queue that sits beside your player — thumbnail rows with duration and watched progress, a now-playing marker, cancellable autoplay-next, shuffle and repeat, and a keyboard-walkable listbox.

items.name: zyeon/avatar-upload
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The whole avatar flow in one control — pick or drop, refuse with a spoken reason, crop square, upload with a progress ring and cancel, and keep the crop when the transfer fails.

items.name: zyeon/file-icon
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An extension-to-icon mark — nine file families, a four-step size scale, tints drawn from your own tokens, and the extension printed whenever the type is unknown.

items.name: zyeon/offline-indicator
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An offline bar for apps that queue work — it names the changes waiting, proves reconnection with an injected probe instead of navigator.onLine, and replays the queue with a per-action verdict instead of declaring success.

items.name: zyeon/session-expiry
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A sign-out warning that arms at a threshold before an injected expiry instant — live countdown, one-shot refresh, a closed state that says why, and cross-tab dismissal over BroadcastChannel.

items.name: zyeon/help-center
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A support landing block whose search ranks titles, keywords and summaries, whose topic cards report honest counts, and whose zero result offers a topic or a human instead of a dead end.

items.name: zyeon/referral-program
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state referral panel: the personal invite link with copy and templated share targets, tier progress counted from the referral list itself, every referred person with their stage and reward, and the program terms behind a disclosure.

items.name: zyeon/app-download
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A get-the-app block that promotes the store matching the visitor's device, encodes the smart link into a scannable QR for desktop visitors, and renders the store badges you supply instead of redrawing brand marks.

items.name: zyeon/cookie-preferences
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A granular cookie consent manager: one row per category with plain-language copy and a vendor-count disclosure, a locked strictly-necessary row, equal-weight accept-all / reject-all / save-selection, and a saved-choice strip that re-opens the editor.

items.name: zyeon/subscription-manager
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A manage-plan block — the running plan with its renewal countdown and seat overage, usage against the plan's own limits, prorated plan changes, and a cancellation that states what is lost and when access actually ends.

items.name: zyeon/cascading-select
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Dependent selects — country then region then city: each rung loads from the one above, changing an upper rung clears the lower ones out loud, and an answer for a rung the reader already left is discarded.

items.name: zyeon/business-hours
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A weekly opening-hours editor — per-day open/closed switches, split shifts, blocks that cross midnight, overlap detection that follows the spill into the next day, and a plain-language summary.

items.name: zyeon/avatar-status
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One avatar carrying its own state — initials derived from the name, a presence ring whose word joins the accessible name, a corner badge slot, five sizes and a circle or squircle frame.

items.name: zyeon/barcode
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A vector Code 128 / EAN-13 renderer — automatic subset switching, a real check digit, spec quiet zones, and a refusal that names what cannot be encoded.

items.name: zyeon/world-clock
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Several time zones on one card — rows ticking on one shared minute timer, with Intl-derived offsets and DST, yesterday/tomorrow markers, and a working-hours band that shows the overlap with your own day.

items.name: zyeon/use-prefers-reduced-motion
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An SSR-safe hook that reports whether the user has asked the system to reduce motion, and updates live when the OS setting changes.

items.name: zyeon/use-cookie
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A cookie-as-state hook with typed attributes, cross-instance sync, an SSR-safe default snapshot, and writes that refuse instead of silently vanishing over the 4 KB cap.

items.name: zyeon/use-retry
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A retry loop for one async call: exponential backoff with full jitter, a shouldRetry predicate, a live countdown to the next attempt, and cancellation that clears every timer.

items.name: zyeon/use-poll
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A polling hook that pauses in hidden tabs, catches up on return, skips a tick while a request is still in flight, and backs off through a dynamic interval.

items.name: zyeon/use-visual-viewport
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A hook that tracks the visual viewport — size, offsets and pinch scale — and derives the keyboard occlusion so a bottom bar can sit above the on-screen keyboard.

items.name: zyeon/use-network-info
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A useSyncExternalStore hook that reports connection quality rather than reachability — effectiveType, downlink, rtt and saveData normalised to nullable fields, plus one coarse quality label.

items.name: zyeon/use-battery
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Reads battery level, charging state and time remaining from the Battery Status API, with a four-way support status and a low-power flag that fails open when no reading is available.

items.name: zyeon/use-vibrate
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A Vibration API hook that plays a normalized haptic pattern from a user gesture, names every refusal instead of failing silently, honours a page-wide haptics mute, and cancels the pattern it owns on unmount.

items.name: zyeon/matrix-rain
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Falling glyph columns on one canvas — every column keeps its own speed, length and bright head, and glyphs swap in place so the stream reads as changing rather than scrolling.

items.name: zyeon/rain
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Layered canvas rainfall — parallax sheets of streaks sheared by a wind prop, landing as ripples on an implied ground line.

items.name: zyeon/snow
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Canvas snowfall with per-flake sway, a foreground-bokeh depth ramp, and an optional drift that builds along the bottom edge and settles under its own angle of repose.

items.name: zyeon/fireflies
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Wandering points of light on one canvas — each walks its own eased random path and flashes on its own period, with the glow blitted from a sprite baked once instead of a per-frame gradient.

items.name: zyeon/constellation
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A drifting node network on one canvas — every pair closer than the link threshold is stroked with distance-faded opacity, queried through a spatial grid, with optional pointer attraction.

items.name: zyeon/lightning
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Branching bolts struck at irregular intervals on one canvas - midpoint-displacement channels with recursive forks, a stacked glow, a decaying afterimage and a flash that lifts the whole surface.

items.name: zyeon/plasma
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The demoscene plasma field on one canvas — sines summed over x, y and time through a cyclic token palette, evaluated at low resolution and upscaled so full-bleed stays cheap.

items.name: zyeon/smoke
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Rising turbulent smoke on one canvas — three scales of a single baked fBm tile, warped per band and thinning with height.

items.name: zyeon/vortex
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A canvas vortex — particles spiral into one point, winding faster as they fall, with comet tails made by fading the buffer instead of storing a path.

items.name: zyeon/silk
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Flowing bands of light on one inline SVG — stacked sine ribbons, each a soft gradient between two chart tokens, drifting slowly enough to read as fabric.

items.name: zyeon/sonar
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A canvas radar sweep — a rotating wedge with a decaying tail over concentric range rings, and prop-driven contacts that flare when the beam passes and fade until the next one.

items.name: zyeon/nebula
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A layered interstellar cloud on canvas — token-tinted noise octaves drifting at different rates under a sparse star layer, with depth from parallax.

items.name: zyeon/ink
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Drops of ink opening into water on one canvas — ragged fronts that expand, thin and dissolve, with every overlap deepening like ink on paper.

items.name: zyeon/prism
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One beam split at an implied prism edge into a slowly drifting fan of token-coloured bands — additive light on dark surfaces, subtractive ink on light ones.

items.name: zyeon/galaxy
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A spiral galaxy on one canvas — stars threaded onto logarithmic arms, a disc that rotates differentially, and a bright core, all painted in your theme tokens.

items.name: zyeon/orbits
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Concentric orbital paths with bodies on real radii and periods — fading arc trails, a chord whenever two orbits line up, and one composed still frame when motion is off.

items.name: zyeon/datetime-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A calendar grid beside an hour/minute/second ladder that emits one Date — min and max bound the combined instant, not the day, so the max day narrows the hours.

items.name: zyeon/period-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A whole-period picker — week, month, quarter or year — whose grid changes shape per granularity and whose value carries the resolved start and end instants.

items.name: zyeon/code-input
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A monospace code field with an aligned line gutter, indent-aware Tab, bracket auto-close, regex syntax tinting and error markers fed by a diagnostics prop.

items.name: zyeon/matrix-rating
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A survey matrix: statements down the side, one shared scale across the top, one native radio group per row, a pinned scale header, answered-row progress, and a stacked fallback instead of sideways scrolling.

items.name: zyeon/pivot-table
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A cross-tabulation grid over flat records — row and column dimensions, sum/count/average, subtotals, a grand total, expandable row groups, and real loading/empty/error states.

items.name: zyeon/flame-graph
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state profiling flame graph — bar width is time, rows are stack depth, click any bar to zoom with a breadcrumb back, and a search that highlights matches across the whole profile with a matched-time readout.

items.name: zyeon/code-tour
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An annotated code walkthrough — numbered steps that each highlight a line range, show a note beside the code, and scroll the active range into view, with prev/next, a jump list and keyboard stepping.

items.name: zyeon/env-diff
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A key × environment configuration diff — every cell judged against one baseline column, secrets compared by fingerprint so no value is ever rendered, and a live count of what promoting one environment into another would change.

items.name: zyeon/data-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A read-only key/value list that folds from two columns to stacked pairs on container width, with per-row copy, focus-revealed truncation and an explicit em dash for empty fields.

items.name: zyeon/maintenance-banner
