items.description: [Zyeon UI] A scheduled-window maintenance notice that counts down to the start, switches to an in-progress state with an elapsed bar, and clears itself once the window ends — every verdict derived from an injected instant.

items.name: zyeon/unsaved-changes-guard
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A three-way exit for unsaved work — beforeunload armed only while dirty, in-app navigation held through an injected navigate handler, and a save / discard / stay dialog instead of the browser's bare prompt.

items.name: zyeon/progress-toast
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A toast bound to one long job — determinate or indeterminate progress, a live percentage in its accessible name, cancel while it runs, and terminal states that hold long enough to read with a retry on failure.

items.name: zyeon/breadcrumb-dropdown
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A breadcrumb trail that measures itself and folds the middle segments it cannot fit into a dropdown, keeping the root and the current page painted at every width.

items.name: zyeon/page-transition
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A route swap wrapper that holds the outgoing view until the incoming one is ready, cross-fades or slides the change, restores each route's scroll offset before paint and moves focus into the new view's heading — reduced to an instant swap under prefers-reduced-motion.

items.name: zyeon/onboarding-checklist
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state getting-started panel driven by a zod task contract — a progress ring whose accessible value is the count rather than the rounded percentage, rows that expand to a description and one real action, instructions that collapse themselves once a task is ticked, an honest time-left figure, a

items.name: zyeon/feature-announcement
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A what's-new surface — modal dialog or anchored popover — that steps through the features a reader has not seen yet and reports every seen id plus the reason it closed.

items.name: zyeon/api-playground
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A try-it console that generates parameter, header and body editors from an operation definition, sends the request through an injected fetcher, and reports status, timing, size and headers with a pretty/raw toggle.

items.name: zyeon/use-form-persist
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A form-draft hook that debounces values into a versioned storage envelope, offers the draft it finds at mount instead of hydrating it, and clears the key on a successful submit.

items.name: zyeon/use-mutation-queue
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A durable offline write queue: enqueue with an optimistic id that doubles as an idempotency key, persist it so a reload keeps the work, drain in order when the connection returns, and park a poisoned write instead of letting it block the rest.

items.name: zyeon/use-drag-drop-files
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Turns any element into a file drop zone through props to spread — a dragenter/dragleave depth counter nested children cannot flicker, an honest drag-time validity preview, dropped folders walked into relative paths, and every refusal itemised with a typed reason.

items.name: zyeon/use-locale
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An SSR-safe locale snapshot — resolved tag, IANA time zone, region, direction, first day of week, numbering system and hour cycle — plus memoised Intl formatters for date, time, number, currency and relative time.

items.name: zyeon/use-media-recorder
items.description: [Zyeon UI] MediaRecorder as a hook — start / pause / resume / stop, a live duration that excludes paused stretches, a container negotiated against what the browser really supports, permission and unsupported as first-class states, and every track stopped on unmount so the recording indicator goes out.

items.name: zyeon/vertical-text
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Vertical CJK writing mode — right-to-left columns whose length is a character count, short Latin and digit runs stood upright as tate-chū-yoko, kinsoku column breaks, and an automatic fallback to horizontal when the copy would not gain from it.

items.name: zyeon/annotated-text
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Prose with notes attached — marked phrases carry a numbered marker, the note opens on hover or focus, and every note is also listed in full under the passage.

items.name: zyeon/transfer-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A dual listbox: two multi-selectable panes with per-side search and counts, move / move-all buttons between them, and a keyboard move that reports what travelled and where focus landed.

items.name: zyeon/schema-form
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A form generated from a zod object schema — a control per field type, required markers and every verdict read from that same schema, typed values on submit, and an explicit notice for the shapes it will not generate.

items.name: zyeon/font-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A typeface field where every option is rendered in its own face — grouped sans / serif / mono / display, previewed with your own pangram, with system stacks always present and remote families fetched through an injected loader that reports loading and failure per font.

items.name: zyeon/regex-tester
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A regex workbench with flag toggles, matches tinted in place under the caret, a capture-group table, verbatim engine errors, and a worker-backed time budget that survives catastrophic backtracking.

items.name: zyeon/theme-customizer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A live design-token editor: a radius slider plus hue and saturation per colour role, previewed light and dark side by side on real controls, and exported as the :root / .dark CSS you paste.

items.name: zyeon/streak-tracker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A habit-streak card — the live run with a tiered flame, this week as seven day cells, a spendable freeze wallet and an at-risk countdown, all derived from an injected instant.

items.name: zyeon/pricing-calculator
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An interactive price estimator whose seat, usage and add-on axes re-derive the bill on every change — switching tier by itself when a cap is crossed, and naming the cheaper plan when another one wins.

items.name: zyeon/audio-trimmer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A waveform you cut on: two handles bound the kept region, everything outside dims, zoom follows the selection, and a preview starts at the in point and stops itself at the out point.

items.name: zyeon/dot-globe
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A rotating sphere of dots on one canvas — lat/lng places or a Fibonacci lattice, projected orthographically with a dimmed far hemisphere, pulsing markers and optional drag-to-spin.

items.name: zyeon/use-websocket
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One WebSocket as a hook: a four-state connection machine, jittered backoff reconnects gated by a shouldReconnect predicate, an ordered outbound queue that covers the outage, JSON with a raw escape hatch, and a heartbeat that catches sockets that are open but dead.

items.name: zyeon/follow-button
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A follow / unfollow toggle with the hover-to-unfollow reveal, an optimistic follower count that rolls back when the request is refused, and a busy state that never uses native disabled.

items.name: zyeon/vote-buttons
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An up and down vote pair with the score between them — exclusive directions, optimistic score maths where a swap is worth two points, and a rollback when the server refuses.

items.name: zyeon/poll-composer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A create-a-poll form — a question, 2 to 10 reorderable option rows, duplicate answers marked on both halves, an allow-multiple switch, a duration menu and a live ballot preview, emitting a typed draft on every edit.

items.name: zyeon/calculator-input
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A number field that does arithmetic — type =2+3*4 or plain 2+3*4 and it commits 14, parsed by a hand-rolled parser that never calls eval.

items.name: zyeon/coordinates-input
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A latitude/longitude pair that reads decimal degrees or DMS in either field, re-prints between the two on a toggle, names the field that leaves ±90 / ±180, and splits a pasted pair across both inputs.

items.name: zyeon/meeting-planner
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Find a time across time zones — participant rows over one shared 24-hour track, a draggable column that reads the same instant in every zone, hour snapping with Shift for half hours, and working hours derived from Intl.

items.name: zyeon/order-tracking
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A shipment tracking card — a four-stage rail, an ETA derived from an injected instant, exceptions that interrupt without colour alone, per-parcel tabs and a copyable tracking number.

items.name: zyeon/live-cursors
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A multiplayer cursor overlay — labelled peer pointers interpolated between low-rate updates, chart-token colour per peer, idle fade, relayed click ripples and a spoken roster, with the transport left to you.

items.name: zyeon/json-diff
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A structural diff of two JSON values as one tree — added, removed and changed keys marked by sign and wording as well as colour, changed leaves showing before → after inline, unchanged subtrees folded behind counts, and arrays paired by index or by an identity field.

items.name: zyeon/jwt-decoder
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A paste-a-token JWT inspector: header and payload as labelled claims, registered claims explained, exp/nbf/iat judged against an injected instant, and a permanent notice that the signature is never verified.

items.name: zyeon/hexdump-viewer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A windowed hex dump whose offset gutter, hex pane and ASCII pane share one selection, with 8/16/32 bytes per row and copy of the selected range as hex or text.

items.name: zyeon/spin-wheel
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A prize wheel that reveals an outcome drawn somewhere else — weighted SVG slices, a flick or a button to start, ticking deceleration onto a pre-computed angle, and a one-shot settle.

items.name: zyeon/currency-converter
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A two-way money converter: type in either field and the other recomputes through a rate table you pass in, with per-currency Intl decimals, a rate breakdown line and an as-of / stale note.

items.name: zyeon/column-profile
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A per-column profiling panel — inferred type, missing rate, distinct count and a mini distribution per column, expandable into percentiles, top values or a time span.

items.name: zyeon/anomaly-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A triage queue for detector output — each row compares the observed value against its baseline band, states the deviation in σ or %, marks the point on a sparkline, and can be acknowledged, ignored or called a false positive.

items.name: zyeon/threshold-editor
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An alert rule editor where every rule is metric + comparison + threshold + a sustained duration + severity — and each one is replayed against recorded samples, so the number of pages it would have produced is on screen before anyone saves.

items.name: zyeon/run-comparison
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A side-by-side experiment comparison — one column per run, hyperparameter and metric rows, differences lit up against a baseline you can move, a best value per metric decided by contract-declared polarity, and a frozen label column.

items.name: zyeon/ab-test-result
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An experiment readout that turns two conversion counts into a relative lift, its confidence interval, a significance verdict and a sample-size progress line — with every degenerate input handled as its own branch.

items.name: zyeon/slice-explorer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A dimension breakdown you can drill: pick a metric and a dimension, rank every value by its contribution, click one to make it a filter, and step back through a breadcrumb — with contribution computed correctly for rates, not just for totals.

items.name: zyeon/report-scheduler
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A recurring-delivery manager for reports — frequency, send time, IANA zone, recipients and format per subscription, each row carrying its next run, and an editor that previews the next runs as real instants before you save.

items.name: zyeon/data-diff-table
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A row-level diff of two dataset snapshots — rows matched on a key, change kind derived from the data, and a missing field told apart from a null one.

items.name: zyeon/social-proof-toast
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A rotating recent-activity notice: one entry every N seconds at most, paused by hover, focus and a hidden tab, with a mute control that reports back through a callback.

items.name: zyeon/exit-intent
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A leave-detector and its surface — a pointer crossing the top edge or a fast scroll-up opens a dismissable payload once per session, and never over a field somebody is typing into.

items.name: zyeon/passkey-prompt
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A passkey enrolment card that asks the device what it can do before offering anything, runs the WebAuthn ceremony you inject through an AbortSignal, and treats a closed sheet as a retriable answer instead of an error.

items.name: zyeon/product-gallery
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A thumbnail rail driving one stage — pointer-tracked and keyboard-pannable magnification, inline video entries with duration chips, and a layout that follows its container.

items.name: zyeon/stories-viewer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A story-format viewer — one segmented progress bar per item, tap zones for previous/next, press-and-hold to pause, and auto-advance across image and video stories.

items.name: zyeon/swipe-cards
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A two-verdict card deck — the top card tilts under the pointer, stamps its verdict as it nears the threshold, commits on distance or flick, and answers to arrow keys, buttons and an undo stack just the same.

items.name: zyeon/scratch-card
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A canvas foil erased under the pointer, with a coverage threshold that opens the card itself and a Reveal button that does the same from the keyboard.

items.name: zyeon/equalizer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A multi-band graphic equalizer — rotated native faders, a Catmull-Rom response curve through the handles, presets that glide, and a typed gain map out.

items.name: zyeon/lyrics-sync
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Karaoke-style synced lyrics — an injected playhead lights each line, word by word where word timings exist, keeps it on the anchor until you scroll away, and turns every line into a seek target.

items.name: zyeon/chart-combo-dual-axis
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state bar-plus-line combo chart whose two axes are built from one shared row structure, so a zero reading lands on the same gridline in both units and no gridline is meaningful on only one scale.

items.name: zyeon/chart-legend-toggle
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A standalone, controlled chart legend — aria-pressed chips in a roving-tabindex toolbar, double-click or Enter to isolate one series, show-all / hide-all, and a guard that keeps the last series from blanking the chart.

items.name: zyeon/chart-bar-race
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state bar chart race — rows re-rank by transform so an overtake glides instead of cutting, with play/pause, timeline scrubbing, speed gears and a declared top-N board.

items.name: zyeon/chart-small-multiples
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state trellis grid — one repeated mark per category, every panel on one shared y scale with a free-scale toggle that states its cost, axis labels only on the edge panels, and a measured column count that wraps rather than shrinking cells past legibility.

items.name: zyeon/chart-beeswarm
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state beeswarm that keeps every observation — greedy collision-free placement that never moves a dot along the value axis, grouped rows, hover and keyboard readouts per point, and an out-loud sampling notice instead of a silent cap.

items.name: zyeon/chart-lollipop
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state lollipop chart — one hairline and one dot per category on a shared scale, ranked, with an optional reference baseline and a second dimension carried by dot size or shade.

items.name: zyeon/chart-icicle
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state linear-partition hierarchy chart in DOM blocks — one level per row or column, length proportional to value, click-to-drill with a breadcrumb, honest label truncation with tooltips, and an sr-only breakdown table.

items.name: zyeon/chart-horizon
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state horizon chart that folds each series into stacked bands and encodes magnitude as depth of colour, so a dozen dense time series fit in a screenful — one shared band scale, mirrored or split negatives, and a column cursor that reads every lane at the same instant.

items.name: zyeon/chart-punchcard
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A weekday × hour dot grid — every Monday 09:00 folded into one bucket, dot area on a square-root scale, switchable size / colour / both encodings and the aggregation timezone stated on the card.

items.name: zyeon/chart-alluvial
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state alluvial that re-draws the same categories at every reading — band width is how many members moved, one global category order chosen by measured crossing cost, and a retained / arrived / left readout for whatever you point at.

items.name: zyeon/chart-error-bars
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state categorical error-bar chart: one point estimate per category with an interval whose meaning — SD, SE, CI or custom bounds — is declared in the contract and printed in the legend, tooltip and data table.

items.name: zyeon/chart-regression-scatter
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state scatter that fits its own least-squares trend — linear, logarithmic or exponential — draws the confidence or prediction band beside R², slope and sample size, flags outliers by studentised residual, and refuses to invent a fit it cannot compute.

items.name: zyeon/chart-marginal-histogram
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state scatter plot with a binned distribution along each axis — three regions on one shared, pixel-aligned coordinate system, linked by hover.

items.name: zyeon/chart-contour
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state 2-D density contour plot — Gaussian KDE on a grid, marching-squares rings drawn at highest-density levels, a live smoothing slider, an optional raw scatter underneath, and a hard sample floor under which it refuses to smooth at all.

items.name: zyeon/chart-survival
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state Kaplan–Meier card — stepped survival curves computed from raw follow-up times, censoring ticks on the curve, a log-log confidence band and a numbers-at-risk table pinned to the axis.

items.name: zyeon/chart-tornado
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state sensitivity chart — one row per driver, low and high segments measured out from a base-case line that is never assumed to be zero, ranked by swing into a funnel, on an axis that is never forced symmetric.

items.name: zyeon/chart-seasonality
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state seasonal decomposition card — one series split into trend, season and residual across three panels on one shared x axis, with anomalous residuals marked against a robust cut-off and undecomposable feeds refused instead of fitted.

items.name: zyeon/chart-connected-scatter
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state connected scatter: both axes carry a metric, the stops are joined in time order, and direction is encoded four ways — a width ramp, pixel-spaced arrowheads, a start ring against a terminal arrowhead, and named endpoint labels.

items.name: zyeon/chart-lift-curve
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state gain and lift curve for model evaluation — a cumulative capture curve read against the random diagonal and the perfect-model bound, with key quantiles marked and degenerate inputs named instead of drawn.

items.name: zyeon/chart-likert-diverging
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state diverging Likert chart — one row per question with the negative options stacked leftward and the positive rightward around a shared centre, a neutral band that either straddles the axis or steps out of the bar, a switchable percentage base and net-score sorting.

items.name: zyeon/chart-axis-brush
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A time-axis brush: drag a window over a thumbnail sparkline and it emits that window for every other chart on the page to filter by.

items.name: zyeon/chart-network-force
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state force-directed relationship graph in plain SVG — a hand-written repulsion, spring and gravity simulation that converges and then stops, draggable nodes that anchor where you drop them, colour by group or by degree, and hover to light a node’s neighbours.

items.name: zyeon/use-eye-dropper
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The screen eyedropper as a hook: open() resolves to a typed outcome — picked, canceled, unsupported or failed — instead of throwing, with hydration-safe support detection, a one-pick-at-a-time guard, and an AbortSignal that unmount fires for you.

items.name: zyeon/use-sound
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A pooled Audio hook for short UI sounds — preloaded voices so fast triggers overlap instead of cutting each other off, a page-wide mute and master volume, every refusal named, and every element released on unmount.

items.name: zyeon/use-worker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Run a pure function off the main thread: the function is stringified into a Blob worker, every call is a promise matched back by id so out-of-order completions land on the right caller, transferables move in both directions, task errors reject without replacing the worker, and everything is terminat

items.name: zyeon/use-fps
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A frame-rate probe that reports rolling fps over a sliding window of requestAnimationFrame timestamps, counts jank frames, and pauses instead of reporting zero while the tab is hidden.

items.name: zyeon/use-text-to-speech
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The browser speech engine as a hook — speak/pause/resume/cancel, a voice list that survives the async voiceschanged population, word boundary events mapped back into your own string, and a cancel on unmount so navigation never leaves a voice talking.

items.name: zyeon/cart-drawer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A slide-out cart panel whose money re-derives on every change — quantity steppers that refuse with a reason, an undoable remove, a promo field driven by the host's verdict, and free-shipping progress.

items.name: zyeon/age-gate
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A date-of-birth gate with three explicit boxes, a real calendar behind them, and a minimum-age rule whose refusal is honest and always offers a way out.

items.name: zyeon/waitlist
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A viral waitlist block: validated email capture, a joined panel that reports your place and derives the rest of the maths, a referral link worth a stated number of places, and a leaderboard teaser that pins your own row.

items.name: zyeon/chart-treemap
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state squarified treemap in hand-rolled SVG — two levels tiled by area, branches fenced and named, click-to-zoom with a breadcrumb, spatial arrow-key navigation and an sr-only breakdown table.

items.name: zyeon/chart-calendar-heatmap
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A year of days as one week-column grid — quantile or linear colour steps with the bounds printed on the legend, measured zero kept apart from no data, and every tile reachable by keyboard.

items.name: zyeon/chart-gantt
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state schedule chart — lanes that pack overlapping work into sub-rows, an axis that follows the span from minutes to years, progress-filled bars, finish-to-start arrows that flag the dependencies the dates do not honour, and a now line from an injected instant.

items.name: zyeon/chart-raincloud
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state raincloud that stacks a half-violin density, a Tukey box summary and the jittered raw readings in three lanes on one shared scale — id-hashed jitter, keyboard-walkable rows with landmark announcements, and an out-loud sampling notice.

items.name: zyeon/chart-dendrogram
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state hierarchical-clustering tree where every bracket sits at the height its two sides merged at, with a cut-height slider that colours and letters the resulting clusters, folded wedges instead of dropped tips, and counted refusals for loops, danglers and double-claimed joins.

items.name: zyeon/chart-tidy-tree
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state node-link hierarchy on a Reingold–Tilford tidy layout — contour-packed coordinates from a pure function, foldable branches, curved, elbow or straight links, either orientation, and a flat ARIA tree over the drawing.

items.name: zyeon/chart-circle-packing
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state zoomable circle packing in hand-rolled SVG — front-chain sibling packing with a verified smallest enclosing circle, area strictly proportional to value, zoom as a re-projection rather than a re-layout, keyboard-walkable circles and an sr-only breakdown table.

items.name: zyeon/chart-voronoi
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state Voronoi tessellation that derives territory from seed positions — half-plane clipping, an optional capacity-weighted power diagram, map colouring so no two neighbours share a fill, direct labels elided to the cell that holds them, and a lift on hover or focus.

items.name: zyeon/chart-adjacency-matrix
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A graph drawn as its adjacency matrix — one node set on both axes, cells carrying edge weight, reorderable by name, degree or cluster, with a row-and-column crosshair, directed or symmetric halves, and a foldable triangle.

items.name: zyeon/chart-spiral
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Time wound onto an Archimedean coil — one ring per period, so the same phase of every turn lands on one radial line — with bars or dots on the coil, a floating zero baseline, measured zeros told apart from windows the series never covered, and a single-ring series refused rather than drawn.

items.name: zyeon/chart-ternary
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state ternary plot in plain SVG — three-part compositions normalised to 100% on an equilateral triangle, with three gridline families, edge-rotated axis ticks, shaded classification zones and a keyboard-reachable mark per row.

items.name: zyeon/chart-market-depth
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state order-book depth chart: mirrored cumulative bid and ask staircases meeting at the spread, an exact step outline, a hover and keyboard readout of price, size and cumulative total at any level, and a refusal when the book crosses itself.

items.name: zyeon/chart-difference-area
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state difference area: two series with the gap between them shaded, the fill and hatch flipping wherever the lead changes hands, and every crossing marked, counted and keyboard-reachable.

items.name: zyeon/chart-pictogram
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state ISOTYPE unit chart: one row per category, icons repeated at a stated one-icon-equals-N scale, the last icon clipped to the leftover instead of shrunk, and unusable rows dropped and counted in view.

items.name: zyeon/chart-qq-plot
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state quantile-quantile plot that ranks the sample itself — ppoints plotting positions, a resistant quartile reference line, a pointwise order-statistic band, and tail departures named on the plot instead of left to the eye.

items.name: zyeon/chart-roc
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state ROC card — one curve per model with its AUC, the chance diagonal, and a draggable, keyboard-reachable threshold handle that reads TPR, FPR and the counts behind them at every cutoff.

items.name: zyeon/chart-confusion-matrix
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A predicted × actual grid that reads as raw counts or row/column normalized shares, with per-class recall and precision margins, a hatched off-diagonal, and undefined rates kept apart from zero.

items.name: zyeon/chart-calibration
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state reliability diagram — binned predicted probability against observed frequency, read off the diagonal, with Wilson intervals, a shared-axis count strip and every bin reachable from the keyboard.

items.name: zyeon/chart-upset
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state UpSet plot for set overlaps a Venn cannot draw — a dots-and-lines membership matrix under sorted size bars, per-set totals on the left, and disjoint columns that add up instead of double-counting.

items.name: zyeon/chart-ecdf
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state empirical CDF that bins nothing — one step curve per group on a shared percent axis, percentiles read off the steps themselves, named crossings between curves, a keyboard-driven scan line and a vertex cap that states its own error.

items.name: zyeon/chart-wind-rose
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A compass rose of directional frequencies, where each sampled direction owns its wedge, stacks its magnitude classes from the hub outward, and is read against labelled percent-of-total rings with calm counted in the hub.

items.name: zyeon/chart-correlogram
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A correlation matrix drawn half as coefficient-shaped glyphs and half as numbers, with non-significant pairs hatched instead of blanked and the axes reorderable by hierarchical clustering.

items.name: zyeon/chart-biplot
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state PCA biplot that draws observation scores and variable loading arrows on one equal-aspect plane, puts explained variance in the axis titles, and states the arrow scale factor instead of hiding it.

items.name: zyeon/chart-percentile-bands
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state percentile fan: nested p50/p90/p99 bands over time with the median line on top, an SLO rule whose breach stretches are interpolated, counted and keyboard-reachable, and an optional log axis for a tail that dwarfs the median.

items.name: zyeon/chart-trace-waterfall
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state request waterfall — nested spans on one shared relative clock, phase segments inside each bar, self-placing duration labels, an interval-attributed critical path ruled over exactly the stretch each span was blocking, and a collapsible tree the arrow keys can walk.

items.name: zyeon/chart-climate-stripes
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One stripe per period coloured by its distance from a baseline — a symmetric diverging ramp, a reference window that can be pinned so two strips compare, anchor labels, and unmeasured periods kept apart from average ones.

items.name: zyeon/chart-event-timeline
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state timeline of instants — one lane per track, a shape per kind, marks that crowd into one counted cluster instead of overlapping, brush-or-keyboard zoom into any window, and a now marker from an injected instant.

items.name: zyeon/chart-renko
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state renko chart: one brick per box of price on a zero-anchored grid, time compressed out of the axis, hollow-up and solid-down bricks, two-box reversals marked, a derived-or-given box size, and a refusal when the box is too small to draw.

items.name: zyeon/chart-word-tree
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state word tree that branches raw phrases out from a root term — ribbon width is that continuation's share, every word is a focusable button that re-roots the tree, and the breadcrumb walks back.

items.name: zyeon/chart-vector-field
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state quiver plot on a derived lattice: one centred arrow per node carrying direction, length and colour, evenly spaced streamlines traced through the same data, holes that stay holes, and a keyboard-reachable readout on every vector.

items.name: zyeon/scroll-shadow
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A scroll container whose edges dissolve wherever the content continues — all four sides judged independently, drawn as a mask on the scroller so nothing overlays the content or steals scrollbar width.

items.name: zyeon/stick-to-bottom
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A scroll container that follows its own bottom edge — appended content stays in view, a scroll up hands the position over for good, and a counted jump pill brings the reader back.

items.name: zyeon/lazy-render
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Defers mounting a subtree until it scrolls into view or the browser goes idle, holding its space with an explicitly reserved placeholder height.

items.name: zyeon/virtual-grid
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A hand-rolled two-dimensional window over a huge sparse matrix — only the cells near the viewport are in the DOM, with fixed or measured row heights and column widths.

items.name: zyeon/sticky-stack
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Multi-level sticky section headers that shove each other out or pile up, with every parking line accumulated from measured header heights.

items.name: zyeon/safe-area
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A CSS-only wrapper that keeps content clear of the notch, rounded corners, home indicator and landscape rails — per-edge opt-in, padding or margin, with a max() floor for devices that report no inset.

items.name: zyeon/client-only
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Renders its children only after mount — the server and the first hydration render emit an equal-size fallback instead, so browser-only values (local time, localStorage, window) can never cause a hydration mismatch.

items.name: zyeon/density-toggle
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A compact / comfortable / spacious switch that publishes seven --density-* CSS variables to a whole subtree, with a 24px target floor the compact step cannot cross.

items.name: zyeon/announcer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A screen-reader announcement centre — two always-mounted live regions, a queue that spaces messages out, an invisible marker that forces repeats to be read, and a timed clear.

items.name: zyeon/dismissible
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A close button for any content that remembers it was closed — for this tab, forever, or until the copy is versioned up — with an undo window before anything is written.

items.name: zyeon/overflow-tooltip
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Text that reveals itself in a tooltip only when it is really truncated — a width probe for single-line ellipsis, a height probe for line clamp, and nothing attached at all when it fits.

items.name: zyeon/char-counter
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A grapheme-accurate character budget for any input or textarea — a warning band, an explicit over-limit state, a caliber prop so the count matches the server, and a hard cap that trims the paste out loud instead of swallowing it.

items.name: zyeon/scroll-restoration
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Restores where each named scroll container was when a history entry was left, waiting for async content to come back before it lands.

items.name: zyeon/anchor-heading
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A heading that owns its anchor — a stable id de-duplicated against the live document, non-ASCII kept instead of stripped, a permanently focusable link that fades in on hover, and one click that deep-links, updates the hash and copies the absolute URL.

items.name: zyeon/external-link
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An anchor that works out whether an href leaves your site — origin declared as a prop so server and client agree — then adds an icon, the rel=noopener patch and a screen-reader new-window hint to the ones that do, and nothing at all to the ones that do not.

items.name: zyeon/chart-3d-bars
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An orbitable WebGL 3D bar grid — categories along X, series lanes along Z, height as value — with runtime chart-token materials, hover tooltips and four contract-driven states.

items.name: zyeon/chart-3d-scatter
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An orbitable four-state 3D scatter cloud on react-three-fiber — cluster-colored spheres inside axis grid planes, chart tokens resolved to WebGL at runtime and re-resolved on theme flips, with drei Html tooltips and an sr-only data table.

items.name: zyeon/chart-3d-surface
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state rotatable 3D surface from a z-value grid — vertex colors lerped between runtime-resolved chart tokens by height, a subtle wireframe overlay, orbit controls and hover tooltips, with SSR never touching WebGL.

items.name: zyeon/chart-3d-globe
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state 3D globe with a graticule, value-sized lat/lng markers and elevated great-circle arcs between origin/destination pairs, coloured at runtime from the live chart tokens.

items.name: zyeon/chart-3d-ribbon
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state multi-series 3D ribbon chart on react-three-fiber — one extruded lane per series, theme tokens resolved into WebGL materials at runtime, hover isolates a ribbon.

items.name: zyeon/chart-3d-donut
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state 3D extruded donut on react-three-fiber — hovered slices lift and slide outward with a drei Html tooltip, the compact total floats in the hole, and a keyboard-focusable DOM legend mirrors the hover, all themed by runtime-resolved chart tokens.

items.name: zyeon/chart-3d-network
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state 3D node-link graph on react-three-fiber — spheres sized by degree, one line-segment pass for all edges, a deterministic golden-angle layout, hover tooltips, and theme tokens resolved into WebGL materials at runtime.

items.name: zyeon/chart-3d-funnel
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state 3D funnel of stacked truncated cones whose radii track stage values, with orbit controls, per-stage conversion labels via Html, and theme tokens resolved into WebGL materials at runtime.

items.name: zyeon/chart-3d-heightmap
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state 3D lego-plot matrix — rows × columns of WebGL columns whose height and colour intensity both encode one value, with runtime-resolved theme tokens, orbit controls and hover tooltips.

items.name: zyeon/chart-3d-radial-bars
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state 3D radial bar chart on react-three-fiber — bars ring a center with height encoding value, orbit camera, hover tooltips and runtime-resolved theme tokens, driven by one zod contract.

items.name: zyeon/chart-shot-map
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state basketball half-court shot chart in hand-rolled SVG — NBA court lines in border/muted tokens, made shots filled with chart-1 and misses hollow, a per-shot hover tooltip with keyboard walk, and an FG% header derived from the same shots array.

items.name: zyeon/chart-pitch-heatmap
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state soccer pitch touch-density heatmap in hand-rolled SVG — full pitch markings in border tokens, a zone grid shaded with one chart token at stepped opacity, a printed intensity legend and a direction-of-play arrow.

items.name: zyeon/chart-pass-network
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state soccer pass network on a hand-rolled SVG pitch — players at their average positions sized by ball touches with jersey numbers inside, passing links drawn only above a count threshold, and hover or focus to light one player's connections while the rest dim.

items.name: zyeon/chart-xg-timeline
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state cumulative expected-goals step chart in plain SVG — two team staircase lines over 0–90+ minutes, emphasized goal dots with minute labels, a dashed half-time rule, and final xG totals in the header row.

items.name: zyeon/chart-win-probability
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state in-game win probability chart in plain SVG — one line around a 50% midline, the band shaded toward whichever side is favoured in that side's chart token, key events pinned to the path as diamonds, and every readout reachable by pointer and keyboard alike.

items.name: zyeon/chart-training-load
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state acute:chronic workload ratio chart — daily load bars with 7-day acute and 28-day chronic rolling-average lines, and the ACWR on a second axis banded into a 0.8–1.3 sweet spot and a >1.5 high-risk zone, all rolling math computed from raw days inside the component.

items.name: zyeon/chart-hr-zones
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state workout view that colors a session strip by heart-rate zone and totals time-in-zone into share-labelled bars, from bpm samples and zone floors.

items.name: zyeon/chart-race-splits
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state race-splits spaghetti chart in plain SVG — every athlete's cumulative gap to the split leader against a zero baseline, direct-labelled line ends, lead changes and DNFs disclosed, and every split keyboard-reachable.

items.name: zyeon/chart-form-guide
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state team form guide that ranks teams by points, with last-N W/D/L result chips, a hand-rolled rolling points-per-game sparkline on a fixed shared scale, and season totals per row.

items.name: zyeon/chart-player-pizza
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state scouting percentile pizza in hand-rolled SVG — one wedge per stat with radius as cohort percentile rank, wedges grouped and coloured by skill category, quartile guide rings, a rank badge at each tip, and keyboard-walkable slices with a shared readout.

items.name: zyeon/chart-power-curve
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state cycling mean-maximal power curve on a log time axis — current period vs all-time best in two chart tokens, an optional dashed critical-power asymptote, and a pointer/keyboard scan that reads watts at any duration.

items.name: zyeon/chart-elevation-profile
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state route elevation profile in plain SVG — the distance-vs-elevation area split into flat, moderate and steep runs by grade, labelled climb bands measured from the samples underneath them, and a hover or keyboard readout of km, elevation and grade.

items.name: zyeon/chart-sleep-stages
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state sleep hypnogram with stage-colored segments stepping across fixed Awake/REM/Light/Deep lanes, plus time-in-stage summary bars with percentages, driven by one zod contract.

items.name: zyeon/chart-fatigue-freshness
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state performance-management chart (CTL/ATL/TSB) in hand-rolled SVG — fitness and fatigue as slow and fast exponential averages of daily training stress, form shaded around zero with separate fresh and fatigued fills, race-day markers through both panes, and a full pointer-plus-keyboard day r

items.name: zyeon/chart-bland-altman
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state Bland-Altman agreement plot that computes bias and ±1.96 SD limits of agreement from raw measurement pairs, drawing a solid bias line, dashed labelled limit lines, and out-of-limits pairs in the destructive tone.

items.name: zyeon/chart-forest-plot
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state meta-analysis forest plot in hand-rolled SVG — weight-sized squares with CI whiskers per study against a vertical null line, a pooled summary diamond, log or linear axis, and disclosed repair of dirty extraction data.

items.name: zyeon/chart-funnel-plot
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state publication-bias funnel plot in plain SVG — effect size against inverted standard error, shaded 95%/99% pseudo confidence contours around the pooled effect, flagged outliers and Egger's test.

items.name: zyeon/chart-pr-curve
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state precision-recall card in plain SVG — one curve per model with AUC-PR in the legend, a dashed no-skill baseline at the prevalence, and optional muted iso-F1 guide arcs.

items.name: zyeon/chart-rolling-average
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state rolling-average smoother: the raw noisy series stays visible as faint dots over a hairline, the trailing-window mean is drawn on top, a ±1 SD band from the same window is shaded under it, and the window size is named in the legend.

items.name: zyeon/chart-anomaly-timeline
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state anomaly-detection timeline: one metric line with the detector's flagged readings marked as destructive diamonds, anomalous stretches hatched, ribboned and counted, and an optional expected-range band the line is judged against.

items.name: zyeon/chart-lactate-curve

items.name: zyeon/status-bar-mock
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A mocked OS status bar — clock, cellular, Wi-Fi, battery — that fills the safe-area band above a phone screen, with notch, Dynamic Island, punch-hole and flat glass.

items.name: zyeon/notch-inset-layout
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A screen shell that lays itself out from the insets the device actually reports — filling, passing under, or stepping away from the notch, island, corner arcs and home-indicator lane.

items.name: zyeon/screen-transition
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A push/pop screen stack with an interactive left-edge back swipe, a parallaxing under-layer and a drag that stays cancellable until you let go.

items.name: zyeon/thumb-toolbar
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A bottom action bar sized to the thumb-reach arc: a hand-side overflow key that opens its menu upward, press-and-slide selection, safe-area padding and a full keyboard path.

items.name: zyeon/reachability-pull
items.description: [Zyeon UI] One-handed mode as a wrapper: a pull on the home-indicator strip brings the whole screen down into the thumb arc — sliding, shrinking or leaning into a corner — with a button, arrow keys, Escape, a tap and a timeout that all send it back.

items.name: zyeon/list-index-bar
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An edge-hugging A–Z rail that jumps a sectioned list from one continuous thumb drag, with a magnified preview bubble, dot compression and a full keyboard path.

items.name: zyeon/action-sheet
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An OS-style sheet of grouped choices raised from the bottom edge, with a destructive tone, a detached Cancel, drag-to-dismiss and safe-area padding.

items.name: zyeon/context-peek
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The long-press peek: the held target lifts out of a blurred page and its actions resolve under the finger, as a menu, an icon toolbar or an expanded preview card.

items.name: zyeon/share-sheet
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The system share surface: a subject header you can pull down to dismiss, a swipeable recents rail, a 4-up app grid and an activity list, on one scrollable sheet with safe-area padding.

items.name: zyeon/permission-primer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A pre-permission sheet that spends the phone's one-shot system dialog on purpose — reasons first, a swipe or a button to refuse, and a Settings round trip that re-checks itself when the app comes back.

items.name: zyeon/rating-prompt
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An in-app review request that rises from the bottom edge, forks a happy answer to the store and an unhappy one into a private message box, and refuses to render once the remembered outcome says it has already asked.

items.name: zyeon/app-update-sheet
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A bottom-edge update prompt with release notes, an installed-versus-available comparison and a download state machine — postponable, or a required gate that refuses to be dismissed.

items.name: zyeon/paywall-sheet
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A subscription paywall that rises from the bottom edge — plan radio rows, trial framing, restore purchases and the auto-renew fine print under a pinned, safe-area action bar.

items.name: zyeon/filter-sheet
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A bottom-edge filter panel with grouped facets, a staged draft, a live result count and an Apply bar padded clear of the home indicator.

items.name: zyeon/long-press
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Press-and-hold on any row or tile — a ring, bar or swell charges under the finger, drift hands the gesture back to the scroller, and the completion fires exactly once, with a tap, a held key and a 44px button all reaching the same action.

items.name: zyeon/double-tap-heart
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A media surface that likes on double tap, bursting a mark where the thumb landed while the first tap is left to the control underneath.

items.name: zyeon/pinch-zoom
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A photo you pinch, drag and double-tap inside its own frame: fit is 100%, every edge is a rubber band, and the sideways swipe past an edge is reported to the host instead of performed.

items.name: zyeon/swipe-pager
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Full-width paged views under a horizontal drag — the deck tracks the finger 1:1, resists past the first and last page, commits on flick or distance, and reports position through a dot, bar or counter rail.

items.name: zyeon/drag-reorder-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A touch list where a press-and-hold lifts a row under the finger, the gap opens live, the edges auto-scroll, and space plus arrow keys do the identical job.

items.name: zyeon/swipe-to-reply
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A chat row whose sideways swipe arms a reply — the row tracks the thumb, a mark fills the gutter behind it, and past the threshold releasing commits and springs the row straight back.

items.name: zyeon/amount-keypad
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An in-app currency keypad that replaces the software keyboard — oversized live-grouped digits, decimal-point or cash-register entry, and a delete key that repeats on hold.

items.name: zyeon/keyboard-accessory
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The bar that rides on top of the software keyboard: previous / next field travel, quick-insert chips, and a Done key that hands focus back on purpose.

items.name: zyeon/keyboard-avoider
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A screen container that keeps its content and pinned footer clear of the software keyboard by the height the visual viewport actually reports — resize the frame, lift the frame, or ride only the bar.

items.name: zyeon/wheel-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An iOS-style drum picker: scroll-snap detents under the thumb, optional wrapping, unlandable rows, and the same turns from the keyboard and two chevrons.

items.name: zyeon/finger-draw-annotate
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Mark up a photo with a finger — pen, arrow and highlighter in a thumb-reachable dock, per-mark undo, a caret and arrow keys as the equal non-touch path, and a flattened PNG export.

items.name: zyeon/mobile-search-bar
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A phone search field that turns the screen into search mode — Cancel, a scope bar and recent searches — measured against the software keyboard and padded off the notch.

items.name: zyeon/chip-scroller
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A one-line filter chip rail that snaps under the thumb, fades at whichever edge still has chips behind it, and pins the off-screen count where it stays reachable.

items.name: zyeon/inline-picker-row
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A settings row that expands in place to reveal its picker — slide a thumb across the options and lift to choose, instead of pushing a whole screen.

items.name: zyeon/phone-number-input
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A mobile phone field that regroups digits as you type, picks the country from a bottom sheet, and normalises pasted international numbers into E.164.

items.name: zyeon/answer-metric-card
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An in-chat metric card for a phone — headline, delta chip and a thumb-scrubbed sparkline, bar row or intensity strip whose readout is hoisted into the header, out from under the finger.

items.name: zyeon/answer-highlight
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The conclusion of an AI answer stated first — four monochrome priority levels across plain, rule, KPI and icon compositions, plus a rail that pins the verdict below the notch once the reader has thumbed past the card.

items.name: zyeon/criteria-checklist
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A live rule-satisfaction panel for a field being typed on a phone: a row per rule, a two-column grid, or a one-line summary of the next thing to fix — chosen from the keyboard height the visual viewport actually reports.

items.name: zyeon/reasoning-timeline
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A thumb-scrubbed reasoning chain for phones — the running node is called out on an inverted card, resolved nodes fold into a count, and the window never becomes a nested scroller.

items.name: zyeon/chat-message-actions
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Hold one chat bubble and its quick reactions plus that message's actions come up against it — as an anchored menu, a compact toolbar or a sheet from the bottom edge.

items.name: zyeon/hold-to-talk
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A press-and-hold voice-message button: the strip takes over the composer with a live waveform, sliding up locks the recording hands-free, sliding toward the edge discards it, releasing sends it — and every one of those has a key or a button.

items.name: zyeon/prompt-rail
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A one-line rail of conversation starters that scrolls under the thumb and folds itself away — on a flick, on a key, or the moment the thread starts.

items.name: zyeon/attachment-tray
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The composer's + tray: a source panel that opens at the software keyboard's own height and pushes the composer up instead of covering it, driven by drag or button.

items.name: zyeon/source-sheet
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A citation opened as a bottom sheet instead of a popover — the passage in the thumb arc, the cited line lifted clear of the sheet, and a way back to where you were reading.

items.name: zyeon/stream-stop-bar
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A bottom-edge run bar for a streaming answer — it mints the AbortSignal, stops the run from the thumb arc, climbs above the soft keyboard, and flicks away to uncover the text it covers.

items.name: zyeon/snackbar
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A bottom-edge message bar with one action, swipe-to-dismiss and a single-slot queue that never lets two share the thumb arc.

items.name: zyeon/offline-banner
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A safe-area connectivity banner for phones that lists the changes waiting, sends them when the link returns, and can be swiped into a peek tab that keeps the count.

items.name: zyeon/mini-player
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A now-playing bar docked above the tab bar that a swipe up, a tap or a key morphs into a full-screen player, with safe-area padding and a read-only timeline when no seek handler is wired.

items.name: zyeon/download-row
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A per-transfer mobile row whose rate and ETA disappear the moment bytes stop arriving, with pause, resume, retry and a press-and-hold cancel that answers to the keyboard.

items.name: zyeon/sticky-section-list
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A grouped mobile list whose section headers pin to the safe-area line and push each other out, with a thumb-arc pager that walks the sections and reports the one being read.

items.name: zyeon/pull-menu
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An overscroll quick-action menu: pull a list past its top to reveal actions, the one under your thumb arms as you keep pulling or slide sideways, and releasing runs it.

items.name: zyeon/map-bottom-sheet
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A map with a draggable sheet over it: detents, velocity settling, and a map that lifts its focal point by half of whatever the sheet covers.

items.name: zyeon/passcode-lock
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An app lock screen with keypad passcode entry, biometric fallback, escalating attempt backoff and a terminal locked-out state.

items.name: zyeon/wallet-card-stack
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A phone-screen wallet: cards overlap so only a tappable strip of each shows, tapping one lifts it to the top safe-area edge and tucks the rest under the bottom, and a downward drag — or Escape — puts it back.

items.name: zyeon/chart-scaling-law
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state log-log scaling plot that fits L = E + A·C^(−α) to the runs it is given — one power law per model family, with the exponent, the irreducible loss and R² printed, the stretch past the largest run hatched and projected, and compute shares apportioned so every filter state totals exactly 1

items.name: zyeon/chart-token-usage

items.name: zyeon/chart-attention-heads

items.name: zyeon/chart-embedding-projection
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state 2-D embedding projection in plain SVG: clusters wrapped in trimmed convex-hull blobs with numbered centroid badges, a nearest-mark hover readout that prints the item's own text, a cluster-versus-label cross-tab apportioned to exactly 100, and a derived caveat naming the groups whose bet

items.name: zyeon/chart-eval-leaderboard
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A model × benchmark leaderboard: every column normalised in its own direction with the raw score printed and the per-column best marked, rank with movement arrows against the previous snapshot, and a weighted index whose whole-percent weights are apportioned by largest remainder and always total 100

items.name: zyeon/chart-training-runs
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state training-runs card: loss against optimiser step for several concurrent experiments, each drawn as a debiased EMA over its own faint raw trace, with divergence and restart markers that shade and count the steps a rollback cost, an optional learning-rate schedule on a secondary axis, and

items.name: zyeon/chart-token-latency
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state LLM serving-latency scatter: time to first token against time per output token for every request, nearest-rank p50/p95 crosshairs, an inclusive budget crosshair that cuts the plane into four filterable zones, and queue/prefill/decode phase bars for the median and p95 requests.

items.name: zyeon/chart-context-window
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state context-window budget bar: the assembled prompt packed part by part, the reply's reserve subtracted from the window instead of stacked on top of it, the overflow framed against the budget that actually applies, and the tokens the eviction order takes first cut out of the part that owns

items.name: zyeon/chart-cost-quality-frontier
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state price/quality plane for a model shortlist — the Pareto frontier drawn through the non-dominated models, dominated ones greyed and told which model beat them, and a movable iso-value line that names the best buy at the reader's own quality-per-dollar exchange rate.

items.name: zyeon/chart-elo-ratings
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state arena ratings card: one line per model with a confidence band derived from its battle count, releases annotated with the rating move they produced, a standings ladder that flags statistically tied neighbours, and a pairwise win-rate matrix that doubles as the keyboard-navigable control

items.name: zyeon/chart-retrieval-recall
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state RAG retrieval card: recall@k stacked over precision@k on one shared log-k axis, one line per retriever, with the shipped operating k marked and any measured k inspectable, an MRR@k readout, the per-query token spend of the cut, and a coverage bar whose percentages always total exactly 1

items.name: zyeon/chart-drift-monitor
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state feature-drift board: one threshold-banded strip per feature on a shared PSI/KL scale with the warn and alert rules drawn across every row, the prediction-drift lane on top, the worst offender named with its per-window trend, and a window tab-strip that re-reads the whole card.

items.name: zyeon/chart-agent-trajectory
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state agent-run timeline: every step a measured segment on the run's own clock coloured by kind, retries nested as attempts inside the step they re-attempt, generated tokens per step on a second track, and a wall-time-versus-generation mix apportioned by largest remainder so the shares add to

items.name: zyeon/chart-data-mixture
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state training-mixture card: one composition bar per training stage split by data domain, with per-domain epochs so upsampling reads as the gap between unique tokens and tokens seen.

items.name: zyeon/chart-gpu-utilization
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state cluster-utilisation card: a device-by-time SM occupancy strip, one memory line per device group read against the HBM ceiling, and idle stalls drawn as selectable bubbles sized by their duration, with the idle share, the longest stall and a wall-clock budget totalling exactly 100% all de

items.name: zyeon/chart-tournament-schedule
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state order-of-play sheet in CSS grid — courts as columns down a vertical time axis, every match a block as long as its estimate, not-before slots floating dashed at the earliest minute they can start, live matches filling against their estimate, and the double bookings, rest gaps and court-t

items.name: zyeon/chart-draw-path
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state draw path — one seed's route round by round with each projected opponent's rating, head-to-head and arrival odds that add to exactly 100, faint branches for whoever could arrive instead, and Elo win chances compounded into a survival bar.

items.name: zyeon/chart-serve-plus-one
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state tennis serve +1 chart in hand-rolled SVG — serve target, then the +1 wing and direction, then won or lost, as three stacked node rows joined by bands whose width is points and whose colour is win rate against a benchmark, with a deuce/ad radiogroup, largest-remainder shares and the most

items.name: zyeon/chart-rally-pattern-tree
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state rally pattern tree drawn as an icicle from the serve down — each row is the next shot, each branch is as wide as the rallies that took it and tinted by the win rate down it, with everything under the sample cut pruned and its share stated.

items.name: zyeon/chart-surface-splits
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state surface-by-surface record card — one win-loss bar per surface with paired service and return sub-bars, every lane on a 0-100% track carrying a tick at the player's own overall level, largest-remainder shares, and the strongest and weakest surfaces called out above a match floor.

items.name: zyeon/chart-stamina-decay
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state stamina card in hand-rolled SVG — several match metrics stacked as small multiples over one shared elapsed-minute axis, each read against its own opening-window baseline, with a reader-chosen cut (end of set 1, 2, …) quantifying the drop-off in the metric's own unit and as a share of th

items.name: zyeon/chart-doubles-formation
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state doubles serve-formation card in hand-rolled SVG — a real tennis, badminton or pickleball court drawn in metres from the rulebook, a vertical tab list where each formation's row carries its usage share and win rate on one bar, and four role-coloured player markers that glide to the new s

items.name: zyeon/chart-shuttle-speed-decay
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state badminton speed-decay chart in hand-rolled SVG — one speed-against-distance curve per shot type on an axis that follows the longest flight, each curve marked where the receiver's racket meets it (or where it dies short of the rule), with flight time integrated from the curve itself, a d

items.name: zyeon/chart-deuce-ad-split
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state deuce-versus-ad court split for one server — the same metrics mirrored around the centre mark, every row drawn as a rate of its own side's whole so two unequal samples compare fairly, mix members apportioned by largest remainder into exactly-filled 100% strips, wide gaps flagged toward

items.name: zyeon/chart-tiebreak-ledger
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state tiebreak ledger — every tiebreak as a point-by-point strip with the serve above or below a hairline and mini-breaks hatched, plus a selectable scope driving the tiebreak record, serve-hold rates and a largest-remainder split of where the points went.

items.name: zyeon/chart-shot-tempo
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state rally-rhythm strip: the time between consecutive contacts mirrored around a centre line with one player per side, a rolling tempo band, flagged tempo breaks credited to the ball that bought the time, and a per-player tempo distribution across every rally.

items.name: zyeon/chart-line-call-review
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A challenge ledger that plots every line-call review by the millimetres between ball and paint — both drawn at real scale — emphasising overturned calls, and tracking each player's per-set allowance spent against what is still in hand.

items.name: zyeon/chart-match-workload
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state card for the physical cost of one match: distance and direction changes per set as paired bars on independent scales, a cumulative distance lane, and a tabbed per-set panel with work-to-rest and the average-to-peak movement speed range.

items.name: zyeon/chart-partner-chemistry
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state doubles pairing grid — one roster on both axes, the lower triangle carrying each partnership's win rate over its match count, samples under the minimum-match bar hatched out of the colour ramp and the verdict, each player's own average on the diagonal to read chemistry against, a per-pl

items.name: zyeon/chart-point-leverage
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state point-leverage scatter in hand-rolled SVG — every point of a match plotted by the win-probability swing it could produce against match time, priced either by a supplied win-probability model or by a standard table keyed by game and set score, with a draggable high-leverage line, the big

items.name: zyeon/account-danger-zone
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A settings-page danger zone — one row per irreversible action with its consequences itemised before the confirm, a type-the-resource-name gate, grace windows dated from the payload's own clock, and blocked actions that name their blocker instead of rendering a dead button.

items.name: zyeon/webhooks-manager
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state webhook endpoint manager — an event multi-select editor that refuses unreachable URLs with the reason, reveal-on-demand signing secrets rotated behind a stated overlap window, a test sender that names its blocker, and per-endpoint deliveries with outcome mix and retry.

items.name: zyeon/data-export-request
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A GDPR-style data export block — scope picker with live size estimates split by largest remainder, a confirmation that states what the archive contains and who can open it, a build read that never dresses a queue position up as progress, and a download link that visibly counts down to its own expiry

items.name: zyeon/sso-setup
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state SAML/OIDC connection panel: copy-per-field values in both directions, DNS TXT domain proof, claim mapping, a test verdict that names the broken setting, and an enforcement switch that refuses with its reasons and spells out who would be locked out.

items.name: zyeon/trust-center
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A public trust page that measures every audit report against the refresh cycle its own data states, filters subprocessors by processing region with shares apportioned to exactly 100, and turns each gap — no report link, no DPA, no uptime data, no subscribe route — into a sentence with the next step

items.name: zyeon/legal-consent
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A versioned terms-and-privacy acceptance panel — the clause-level delta since the version the user last accepted, full text that must actually be scrolled to its end before its checkbox unlocks, separable consents for terms/privacy/marketing, and the record it hands back.

items.name: zyeon/seat-management
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A seat ledger crossed with the member roster: who holds a billable, free-viewer, invited or deactivated seat, the assignment count against the plan, the cost of adding or removing a seat previewed before it is committed, an overage warning carrying both of its exits, and a bulk deactivation of idle

items.name: zyeon/retry-countdown

items.name: zyeon/impersonation-banner
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The bar support staff sees while acting as a customer — whose account this is, who is inside it, whether the grant may write, a live countdown to the automatic cut-off, and an exit that is never blocked.

items.name: zyeon/partial-failure-summary
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The receipt for one bulk action that half worked — the counts as a single actionable sentence, failures grouped by cause and expandable to the affected rows, an RFC 4180 failure report, and a retry whose scope follows whether the successes were committed or rolled back.

items.name: zyeon/country-picker
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A country field whose value is always the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code — 243 countries searchable by name, either ISO code or calling code, pinned rows on top, UN M49 region groups, localised names via Intl.DisplayNames, and a flag emoji that falls back to a code chip on platforms that have none.

items.name: zyeon/tax-id-input
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A tax identifier field where the country picks the format — local label, printed prefix, mask and that jurisdiction's real checksum (EU VAT, UK VAT, EIN, ABN, GSTIN, CNPJ) — with an optional register-verification state on top.

items.name: zyeon/bank-details-form
items.description: [Zyeon UI] Payout details whose fields follow the country — IBAN and BIC for SEPA, sort code and account number for the UK, routing and account number for the US — with a real IBAN mod-97 check, the ABA weighted checksum, entered values carried across a country switch, and the account masked to its last four a

items.name: zyeon/math-formula
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A documented LaTeX subset rendered as native MathML with a styled CSS fallback — inline and block display, an accessible sentence derived from the source, copy-as-LaTeX, and an explicit caret-marked refusal for anything outside the subset.

items.name: zyeon/api-changelog-diff
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An endpoint-level diff between two API versions — routes grouped as removed, changed, deprecated and added, each expandable to the field-level story, with breaking changes counted apart from additive ones and every deprecation shown with its sunset date and whole days remaining.

items.name: zyeon/composer-attachments
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An attachment strip for a prompt composer — one list rendered as compact chips on the input's top edge or rich preview cards under it, with per-kind statistics, keyboard removal that hands focus to the neighbour, overflow collapse and four data states.

items.name: zyeon/add-to-calendar
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A split button that hands one event to Google, Outlook, Office 365 or Yahoo and writes a spec-correct .ics in the browser — real IANA zones with a generated VTIMEZONE, exclusive all-day ends, 75-octet folding and a validated RRULE.

items.name: zyeon/environment-switcher

items.name: zyeon/video-chapters
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The chapter list beside a player: chapters supply only a start time, the component derives every boundary, length and share of the runtime, marks the chapter holding the playhead, keeps it scrolled into view with an in-chapter progress sliver, and seeks on click or Enter.

items.name: zyeon/spin-viewer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A turntable image sequence scrubbed by horizontal drag, touch and arrow keys — one wrapping frame index, a preload gate that shows its progress before interaction is allowed, dead frames skipped instead of blanking the stage, and auto-spin that yields at the first interaction.

items.name: zyeon/reading-meta
items.description: [Zyeon UI] An article byline strip that derives reading time in-component from the word count at a stated pace, switches from the total to how much is left once reading starts, collapses long author lists into "and N others", and renders every date from an ISO string with an explicit locale and time zone.

items.name: zyeon/incident-composer
items.description: [Zyeon UI] The write side of a status page — pick the update state, set each affected component's impact, and see exactly what the email, SMS and webhook subscribers receive plus how many destinations they reach, with resolve forcing every component back to operational behind a confirm.

items.name: zyeon/chart-project-progress
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state rail of projects — one segmented bar per project split into done, in progress, blocked and not started with largest-remainder shares that add to exactly 100, an owner, a due date counted in whole calendar days, a schedule-line tick and a health chip derived from all of it.

items.name: zyeon/chart-sprint-velocity
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state sprint velocity chart — commitment against delivered as paired bars, scope pulled in mid-sprint hatched as its own segment, and a rolling-window band projected over the sprints still to come.

items.name: zyeon/chart-workload-balance
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state diverging load chart — every person measured out from their own capacity line, over-allocation running one way and idle headroom the other on one shared scale, with a tolerance band, an aggregate meter that the per-person picture argues against, and a greedy plan naming who to move work

items.name: zyeon/chart-cycle-time-scatter
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state cycle time scatter that derives its own p50, p85 and p95 by nearest rank, spends its single accent on the focus percentile and the items that broke it, and measures a stated service level against the number the data actually supports.

items.name: zyeon/chart-aging-wip
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state aging chart for a team board — every item still in progress plotted by column against how many days it has been in flight, read against the percentile bands this board's own finished work actually hit.

items.name: zyeon/chart-wip-limits
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state work-in-progress card: every board column read against its own limit, with a breach as an explicit state and a column that was never capped kept out of the verdict entirely.

items.name: zyeon/chart-critical-path
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state task dependency board that derives the schedule from durations and links alone — a forward and backward pass, total and free float per task, the zero-float route drawn in the one accent colour, and a cyclic plan named rather than walked forever.

items.name: zyeon/chart-roadmap-swimlanes
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state roadmap board — epics as bars across coarse time buckets in per-team lanes, deliberately without dates or dependency arrows, leading on how loaded one quarter is and flagging the lanes that are over the capacity they stated.

items.name: zyeon/chart-okr-tree
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state objective tree whose parents are the weighted rollup of their children, with sibling weights that do not sum to 1 either normalised out loud or drawn at the scale they actually describe.

items.name: zyeon/chart-review-turnaround
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state review-turnaround card — one lane per reviewer on one shared time axis, the wait for a first look nested inside the wait to merge, a p90 tail whisker, the pooled team median as a dashed rule, and an oversized headline that retargets to whichever reviewer you pick.

items.name: zyeon/chart-focus-time
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state per-person day timeline that derives focus blocks from the gaps a calendar leaves, splits them into usable time and scraps at a stated minimum, and leads with the fragmentation score that falls out of the split.

items.name: zyeon/chart-blocker-impact
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state blocker ranking whose bar is a transitive blast radius counted once per task, split into what only that blocker holds versus what is also stuck behind someone else, with the board's held-up share apportioned to exactly 100 percent.

items.name: zyeon/chart-release-readiness
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state go/no-go board that rolls per-workstream checks, sign-offs and open blockers into one derived verdict, leads with the single number that reaches zero exactly when the release is clear, and refuses to call an unread board.

items.name: zyeon/chart-team-availability
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state week-by-week coverage card — one oversized coverage number for the week you picked, a rail of week bars against a target line, and a per-person day grid where partial days stay fractions instead of being rounded to whole days off.

items.name: zyeon/chart-milestone-health
items.description: [Zyeon UI] A four-state milestone slip chart — every row runs from the committed baseline to today's forecast on one shared date axis, with earlier forecasts left behind as a faded trail, a recorded RAG status, per-milestone confidence, and the worst open slip printed as the one number the card leads with.
