items.name: nikolas-sapa/sorter-pocket-route
items.description: [ns-ui] An ambient processing/organizing loader modeled on a Hollerith tabulating-machine card sorter's chute: cards drop single-file down a center track, a gate flap swings to a heading and each card curves off with it into one of five numbered pockets below, the pockets filling unevenly forever as a rolli

items.name: nikolas-sapa/spall-face
items.description: [ns-ui] A card-scale background texture panel modelling frost (freeze-thaw) weathering of a porous rock face: the sampled field conveys slowly upward, and every second or two a flake somewhere lifts, tips outward, and falls off, exposing a fresh patch that brightens then weathers back into the surrounding s

items.name: nikolas-sapa/sparkline-ascii
items.description: [ns-ui] A production-usable sparkline chart drawn entirely in characters: block-fraction bars, keyboard-navigable column by column.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/sparkline-automaton
items.description: [ns-ui] Inline KPI sparkline grown over an elementary cellular-automaton texture: the Wolfram rule is picked by the series' volatility, one generation column per data point.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/specie-clip
items.description: [ns-ui] A partial-refund control drawn as a struck coin with a reeded edge: dragging a chord across the disc clips off a sector whose true circular-segment area, not the chord's linear position, is the refund amount, so the coin visibly diminishes by exactly what it pays out.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/spectrogram-ascii-bands
items.description: [ns-ui] A scrolling spectrogram in monospace ink: a real 512-point FFT grouped into log-spaced bands, each with its own adaptive noise floor so quiet bands stay dark and only the actual harmonic structure prints as bright glyph runs.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/spindle-strike
items.description: [ns-ui] Payment history as a diner-receipt spindle: settled transactions pile up impaled on a shared 1px spine, and a refund doesn't remove the card. It pulls the same pierced node a few px back up the spine with its puncture elongated into a slot.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/split-flap-board
items.description: [ns-ui] A split-flap departure-board display for short status strings: each character cell hinges its top half down over the bottom on a hard-creased 3D flip, cycling through a short burst of glyphs with per-cell stagger so a text change ripples left-to-right like clattering airport signage.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/split-pane-weighted
items.description: [ns-ui] Split-pane divider that carries real weight: drag it and the boundary trails the pointer like a counterweighted window sash, release with speed and it coasts into the nearest detent on a critically-damped spring; released slow and far from a stop, it just stays put.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/starch-shear
items.description: [ns-ui] Film-strip thumbnail scrubber made of a shear-thickening material: drag slowly and each thumbnail visibly lags the one before it down the chain like a liquid; flick fast and the strip instantly locks into one rigid slab that moves and stops as a single piece.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/stat-row-baseline-spark
items.description: [ns-ui] A KPI row implementing the stat-tile figure contract (value, delta, sparkline) honestly: the sparkline behind each number is the same series the delta is computed from, hovering or focusing surfaces exactly which point that delta is measured against, and color only ever means 'this is good news for

items.name: nikolas-sapa/stat-tile-ascii-arrive
items.description: [ns-ui] A KPI number whose arrival is ink condensing into a glyph: every dot of a 5x7 ASCII dot-matrix digit starts at a random density-ramp step and eases independently toward its true value, so the numeral visibly resolves out of noise instead of sliding or flipping into place.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/stats-radar-sweep
items.description: [ns-ui] Dashboard KPI grid under an observatory radar: a 1px accent arm sweeps the panel once per 12s with sonar rings, and each stat card counts up and lights its border only the instant the wedge crosses its bearing, then settles back to muted until the next revolution.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/status-glyph-cadence
items.description: [ns-ui] A 20-64px inline status glyph for agent work where the motion pattern itself is the signal: five states, five distinct cadences, no color and no swapped icon.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/status-metaball-merge
items.description: [ns-ui] Group membership drawn as an implicit surface: each item is a charge in an inverse-square field, and a marching-squares isoline at F = 1 is stroked as a bare outline, so items in the same group share one necked contour and an item that leaves visibly pinches off into its own closed loop.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/status-sphere-dots
items.description: [ns-ui] A canvas-free AI thinking indicator: a rotating sphere of depth-cued SVG dots. Four states (thinking, searching, done, idle), distinct by motion, not color, legible from 24px inline to a 200px showpiece.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/steam-trap-batch-flush
items.description: [ns-ui] An inline sync-status glyph modelled on a float-and-thermostatic steam trap: condensate (pending events) fills a small chamber, a float trips a discharge valve at 88% height, the chamber blows down fast on an eased-out curve, and refill starts immediately, forever.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/stem-and-leaf-live
items.description: [ns-ui] A live stem-and-leaf plot: every arriving value flies in from a staging slot and drops into its tens-stem row, existing leaves shoulder-nudging aside to insert it in sorted order, so the distribution is built entirely from the digits of the data and every leaf is still an individually focusable reco

items.name: nikolas-sapa/stencil-fill
items.description: [ns-ui] A reusable pattern-masked input: the full template renders at rest as a muted stencil with literal separators already in place, each typed character inks its own cell, and a refused character prints faint, shakes, and falls away instead of vanishing silently.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/stepper-needle
items.description: [ns-ui] Bounded numeric stepper with a large mono value readout, prominent -/+ buttons, and a labeled history strip: an inertial needle swings to each committed value while the strip advances, etching the last 20 adjustments with the newest mark highlighted.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/stepper-ratchet
items.description: [ns-ui] Numeric spinbutton built as a ratchet and pawl: incrementing is free and clicky and a hold repeats and accelerates, but decrementing requires holding ~250ms while the pawl visibly swings 35 degrees clear before a hold starts stepping back, also accelerating.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/storey-pole
items.description: [ns-ui] Indoor level switcher drawn as a true architectural cross-section: floors are horizontal slabs at their real relative heights (a double-height lobby is visibly taller than a mezzanine), a spring-loaded datum line points at the selected slab's elevation, below-grade floors carry a 45-degree hatch fil

items.name: nikolas-sapa/streaming-ink-dry
items.description: [ns-ui] Streaming LLM text where the newest tokens arrive light and translucent, then dry to full opacity a beat behind the stream head. Width-stable, so committed text never reflows.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/streaming-markdown-caret
items.description: [ns-ui] Streaming-text renderer where already-arrived content never re-animates: only the trailing, unterminated edge carries a muted caret and settles when its markdown span closes.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/streaming-retraction
items.description: [ns-ui] Streaming-text renderer for models that take words back: a retraction strikes through mid-sentence, evaporates, and leaves a notched scar tick that reopens the revision inline.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/streaming-token-settle
items.description: [ns-ui] Streaming text where provisional tokens sit off-baseline and a hair rotated like loose letterpress type, then snap into the chase with a stiff spring the instant they're confirmed. A correction slides the old word out sideways as its replacement slides in.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/strip-station
items.description: [ns-ui] Turn-by-turn directions unbent into one vertical straight-line diagram: row spacing is proportional to real ground distance, not step count, with a 44px floor that visibly breaks (equation-station zigzag, skipped chainage) rather than silently lying about distance.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/surface-glass
items.description: [ns-ui] Container-level liquid glass: blur, saturation, noise grain, specular rim, graduated shadow ramp.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/swipe-row-detent
items.description: [ns-ui] A swipeable list row that clicks through machined detent stops (archive, then flag) and strains against a hard stop before overtravel arms delete, with a 3-second undo bar before it commits.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/switch-ascii-knife
items.description: [ns-ui] An accessible switch drawn entirely in box-drawing and block characters, in the register of a physical knife switch: the blade fills one cell at a time and the handle glyph spins through the throw.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/switch-eclipse
items.description: [ns-ui] A binary switch drawn as an eclipse: a dark occluding disc slides across a bright sun disc inside a 56x28 track, forming a computed crescent at the midpoint and a thin corona ring once fully on, while the track's ambient tint darkens smoothly with occlusion.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/switch-frost
items.description: [ns-ui] iOS-style switch whose OFF state freezes over: seeded dendritic frost feathers creep in from the track edges over a frosted-glass film, with sparkle grain that glistens at idle; switching ON drives a melt front ahead of the sliding thumb with droplet run-off.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/switch-solder-bead
items.description: [ns-ui] A boolean switch rendered as two liquid solder beads on a hairline rail, trading mass through a gooey neck that bulges, stretches and pinches off on toggle, with a ratio prop for rendering any partial allocation, not just on/off.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/table-heat-shimmer
items.description: [ns-ui] Dense ops table where rows above a heat threshold shimmer like air over asphalt: live DOM text refracts through an animated SVG displacement filter while cold rows sit dead-still behind hairline borders.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tabs-carriage
items.description: [ns-ui] Tabs whose underline is a typewriter carriage on a rail: forward moves glide on a spring and stretch with speed, backward moves snap home faster with a ding-bounce, and the panel line-feeds in from the travel direction.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tabs-notch-tenon
items.description: [ns-ui] Tabs whose bottom rule is a single SVG path with a notch missing under the active tab, and whose panel carries a matching raised tenon that slots into that gap. The strip and panel read as one interrupted border, legible at rest with zero motion.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tabs-rail-points
items.description: [ns-ui] Tabs whose active indicator is one continuous SVG rail running under the entire row like railway track: selecting a tab throws the points, bending a raised siding segment off the base line so it travels to the new tab instead of a puck jumping between slots.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tabs-slack-cable
items.description: [ns-ui] Classic tabs whose active-indicator is a single SVG path drawn as a slack cable instead of a rigid bar: it sags mid-jump proportional to distance, tautens flat with a small spring snap, and previews the destination with a 3px tug when you hover a neighboring tab.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tacho-disc
items.description: [ns-ui] Today's security activity as one rotating polar disc under a fixed stylus: sign-ins, permission grants and revocations scribed at their true time-of-day angle, radius by category, older days stacked behind as dimmer discs. Dragging or arrowing it scrubs a real, bound event list.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tag-input-backspace
items.description: [ns-ui] Tag input where Backspace on an empty field arms the last tag with a depleting bar instead of deleting it: a second Backspace inside the window removes it.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tag-input-cord
items.description: [ns-ui] Tag input as beads threaded onto a cord: committing a tag cinches a bead into place with one overshoot squeeze while its knot draws on; Backspace on an empty input unravels the last bead with a drop-and-twist. Duplicate commits shudder the existing bead instead of re-threading it.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tag-input-pull
items.description: [ns-ui] A tag/token input whose chips attach like burrs: hooked, not glued. Removing one takes a deliberate pull: it stretches at the trailing edge, pops free, and the row exhales closed behind it with a staggered ripple toward the caret.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tag-input-tear
items.description: [ns-ui] Tag input whose chips hang from a perforated edge instead of an x icon: dragging a chip down snaps its dashes into torn stubs top-to-bottom as a 0-1 tear progress crosses each one, and past 80% releasing drops the chip with a 4deg rotate and gravity while siblings close the gap via FLIP; releasing e

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tally-cleave
items.description: [ns-ui] An org invite list where each invite is a split wooden tally: a jagged seam cut from the invite's own token, the org keeps a solid stock, and accepting slides the matching foil home so the grain lines cross the seam and prove the match.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tamper-tine-squeeze
items.description: [ns-ui] An indeterminate 'still working' loader modeled on mechanised ballast tamping: a satellite plunges a paired tine either side of a rail sleeper, squeezes it shut to pack the ballast beneath, lifts, and steps to the next sleeper along an infinite treadmill row.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/team-grid-timezone-rail
items.description: [ns-ui] A team grid that answers the question a team grid is actually asked (who is reachable right now) by running a 24-hour UTC rail above the cards with the team's shared working-hours overlap inked into it, while each card shows that person's live local time and dims when they're outside their own hours

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tendril-cast
items.description: [ns-ui] Two or three climbing-tendril shoots circumnutate out from the pane's bottom edge in live SVG, searching a widening helix until a growing tip actually touches a measured support rect, then switch to a tightening spiral coil with a chirality-flipping perversion kink before stiffening and budding agai

items.name: nikolas-sapa/testimonial-wall-reflow
items.description: [ns-ui] A masonry testimonial wall that physically reflows as you read: expanding one card's quote via 'read more' re-packs every other card into its new shortest-column slot, animated with a FLIP transform so only the cards that actually move ever animate.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/text-card-flick
items.description: [ns-ui] A hover or click flourish where every letter is an index card on a spindle: the face flicks back over its top edge and out of view while a duplicate flicks up from underneath into its place, staggered across the word from a configurable origin on a numerically integrated spring.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/text-decrypt
items.description: [ns-ui] Scramble-to-decode text reveal with left-to-right character locking.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/text-ekg-baseline
items.description: [ns-ui] Text whose baseline is a live EKG trace: each beat fires a QRS spike that travels under the letters, throwing every glyph up the waveform before it spring-settles flat.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/text-ligature-melt
items.description: [ns-ui] Headline whose glyphs liquefy near the cursor: an SVG gooey filter fuses neighbors into temporary ligatures that spring apart on leave, with a faint field drifting the melt on its own at rest.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/text-slot-rotate
items.description: [ns-ui] A rotating-word slot: each character column spins through a slot-machine reel of glyphs before landing on the next word, with the slot's own pixel width carried between words of different lengths so the layout never jump-cuts.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/text-variable-weight
items.description: [ns-ui] Letters morph variable-font weight by cursor proximity. Pure typography interaction.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/textarea-autosize-swell
items.description: [ns-ui] An autosize textarea that grows like dough proofing instead of reflowing like a spreadsheet cell: ordinary typing raises it line by line with a soft 180ms swell, a large paste breathes open over 400ms in one continuous motion instead of popping, and deleting text back down is slower still (320ms) so

items.name: nikolas-sapa/ticker-tape-splice
items.description: [ns-ui] Horizontal ticker tape with mechanical feed physics: quotes stream right-to-left at constant speed, new data visibly splices in with a 1px seam that travels with the strip, and hover or keyboard focus brakes the feed with inertia instead of stopping it dead.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/ticker-teleprinter
items.description: [ns-ui] Character-quantised teleprinter crawl: a fixed row of monospace cells advances one full cell per beat via content substitution, never a subpixel slide.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/time-ago-drift
items.description: [ns-ui] A relative timestamp whose type visibly ages: variable-font weight, letter-spacing and ink drift from --foreground toward --ns-muted as the moment recedes; hover or focus crossfades to the exact ISO instant.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/time-picker-sundial
items.description: [ns-ui] A time-of-day picker as a flat sundial: drag the outer ring to set the hour and the inner ring for 5-minute detents, while a soft blurred gnomon shadow points at the hour and lengthens from a short AM wedge into a long PM one as you keep dragging past noon.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/timeline-agent-lanes
items.description: [ns-ui] Live multi-agent turn tracker: one hairline lane per agent, the lane holding the turn brightened to foreground, handoffs drawn as stepped connectors with mono duration labels.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/timeline-changelog-wave
items.description: [ns-ui] Changelog timeline drawn as a beach strand: each release arrives as a foam crest sweeping an arc in from the now edge, breaks at its chronological position, pops a marker in with a spring, and recedes leaving an etched tide-ring. Later waves wash past older marks so ring density reads as event histo

items.name: nikolas-sapa/timeline-reasoning-rail
items.description: [ns-ui] Collapsible agent-reasoning timeline: status lives entirely in the node glyph on a 1px vertical rail, steps stream in over time, and completed steps fold to a single line so a long run stays readable.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/toast-gravity-stack
items.description: [ns-ui] Toast stack with real gravity: notifications thud into a jostling heap, errors sink under their own mass, and the pile resettles when one is dismissed.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/toast-undo-fuse
items.description: [ns-ui] Undo toast whose remaining lifetime is a literal fuse: a hairline along the bottom edge burns right-to-left with an ember at the front, answering "when does this go away" without a numeric countdown.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/toc-minimap-mercury
items.description: [ns-ui] TOC minimap where scroll progress is a column of liquid mercury: a gooey SVG blob climbs the rail, absorbs section ticks, teardrops under fast scroll, and bulges toward hovered ticks.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/toggle-theme-ascii
items.description: [ns-ui] A light/dark toggle whose chip reads the real resolved --background/--foreground values at mount and on every theme change and paints itself in their negative, so it previews almost exactly what the page will look like the instant you click it.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tonearm-skate
items.description: [ns-ui] A read-only tracking-quality gauge built from real pivoted-tonearm geometry: a headshell sweeps a 215mm-pivot arm across a spinning record from lead-in to run-out while a small error needle reads the actual geometric tracking-error function, centering exactly at the two Baerwald null radii (66mm, 12

items.name: nikolas-sapa/toner-fuse-streak
items.description: [ns-ui] A loader / progress surface that prints its content in the way a laser printer images a page: a top-to-bottom expose/develop wipe with toner visibly catching behind it, fine edges thinning for 400ms before filling to full density, and a persistent starvation streak on any large fill area, locked dow

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tool-call-board
items.description: [ns-ui] An agent's tools hung on a board like fishing tackle: slim capability chips at rest, each lifting and paying out a streaming-argument strip the instant its tool is called, with a recency underline that fades over 60 seconds.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tooltip-delay-group
items.description: [ns-ui] A tooltip whose 1px border traces itself outward from the trigger's own edge and whose delay-group lets adjacent triggers hand off instantly with no re-animation, like a real menu bar.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tour-spotlight
items.description: [ns-ui] An onboarding tour rendered as a lighthouse: the current target gets a light ring and halo while the rest of the page drops to penumbra behind a single SVG-masked scrim, and advancing sweeps a feathered beam along the path from the old target to the new one as the hole morphs to match.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/transfer-list-siphon
items.description: [ns-ui] Multi-select a source list, drag just one selected item into the destination to prime the siphon, and the rest of the selection flows through a live SVG tube one bead at a time until it drains or you break the seal.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tree-box-drawing
items.description: [ns-ui] File/directory tree drawn with real box-drawing connectors, whose glyphs redraw themselves as folders expand and collapse instead of static per-level guides.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tree-hinge-fold
items.description: [ns-ui] Tree view whose branches unfold like a carpenter's folding rule: each child group is a hinged segment that swings open around a visible pivot, rows unfolding in sequence, and snaps shut faster than it opens.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tree-root-trace
items.description: [ns-ui] File/nav tree whose indent guides are a single living root system: an SVG path draws itself down from a parent's junction and elbows into each child row as it expands, retracting on collapse instead of toggling static border-left lines.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/treemap-ascii-partition
items.description: [ns-ui] A recursive slice-and-dice treemap where every rectangle's interior is filled with an ASCII density ramp keyed to its value instead of a colour scale. Clicking a rectangle with children descends into it, recomputing the partition over just its children; a breadcrumb (or Escape) climbs back out to an

items.name: nikolas-sapa/truncation-taper-fade
items.description: [ns-ui] Truncation without the ellipsis: an overflowing line's trailing characters crowd tighter and dissolve toward the clip edge instead of getting cut to '...'; hover or focus decompresses it to read the tail.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/truncation-word-count
items.description: [ns-ui] Line-clamp that tells the truth: the fold control states the exact measured word count it hides ('+ 42 words'), the cut edge is a dashed selvage rule with a soft fade, and unfolding is an in-place height ease.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/tufting-gun-loop-pile
items.description: [ns-ui] A card whose backing texture is a genuine tufting-gun loop-pile build: a carriage sweeping row by row across a backing grid, plunging a loop of pile at each cell just behind it, the finished field feeding continuously off the top edge as new rows tuft in below.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/turbidite-graded-bed
items.description: [ns-ui] A card-scale ambient timeline where each irregular flow-pulse event deposits one new sedimentary bed at the top of a growing stratigraphic column: coarse grains settling first at a sharp, erosively-scoured base and fining continuously upward to a fine cap, stacking pulse by pulse forever with the ol

items.name: nikolas-sapa/turntable-stall
items.description: [ns-ui] Org/tenant switcher as a locomotive roundhouse turntable: the bridge slews on a real spring, and org-scoped nav stays visibly disconnected through the entire unaligned middle, reconnecting only when the bridge is exactly on the stall angle AND the server has confirmed.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/typing-indicator-trace
items.description: [ns-ui] Multi-user typing/presence as a live seismograph strip: one hairline trace per participant, scrolling leftward and spiking with their real keystroke cadence, never a looping three-dot bubble.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/undo-drift-bar
items.description: [ns-ui] Deleted list row collapses in place to a thin labeled bar that drifts toward the trailing edge over the grace window. Distance traveled is the only clock, and pressing the bar pulls it back.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/undo-ghost-row
items.description: [ns-ui] A deleted list row leaves a dashed retinal ghost in its exact place that slowly closes over 8 seconds. Remaining height is remaining time, and clicking it any time before it vanishes restores the row with a spring.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/validation-error-summary
items.description: [ns-ui] Failed-submit error handling as a contractor's punch list: a numbered defect summary pins to the top of the form, a hairline SVG leader line links each entry to its field on selection, and fixing a field strikes it through and counts down to self-dismissal.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/validation-inline-wick
items.description: [ns-ui] Inline per-field validation where the bottom border diffuses an error tint in from the exact offending character, like litmus paper: slow and pale while an async check is still pending, fast and decisive once it's definitely wrong, and it wicks back out the moment the field is fixed.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/vellum-scrape
items.description: [ns-ui] A version-history rail styled as scraping vellum: dragging a vertical depth slider reveals each paragraph's overwritten text exactly where it lived, in real selectable DOM, with a per-run restore control to re-ink an old passage as the document's true content.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/venturi-ejector-draw
items.description: [ns-ui] A processing/analyzing loader shaped as an industrial Venturi vacuum ejector: a particle stream necks through a 22%-of-inlet throat and visibly speeds up there, a second entrainment stream merges in from a side port just before the constriction, and one marked tracer crosses the whole nozzle every 2

items.name: nikolas-sapa/view-toggle-rails
items.description: [ns-ui] List/grid/board view switcher that draws a faint curved rail from every item's old slot to its new one and lets it ride that exact rail, releasing cards in reading order like cars cut loose over a classification-yard hump.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/voice-recorder-meter
items.description: [ns-ui] Voice-capture chip whose amplitude strip is real Web Audio, not Math.random() bars: flat at rest, live spectrum while listening, an honest error if the mic is denied.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/warp-knit-tricot-lapping
items.description: [ns-ui] An ambient divider/background texture whose guide bar shogs a short lateral distance every course, lapping each needle's thread diagonally across its neighbours to build a continuously-scrolling zigzag chevron field. The diagonal wale structure of warp knitting, distinct from a weft shuttle's full-w

items.name: nikolas-sapa/waveform-ascii-scrub
items.description: [ns-ui] An audio-style waveform rendered as columns of ASCII density glyphs with a draggable playhead: dragging (or hovering, or holding keyboard focus) subdivides the glyph columns nearest the cursor into finer sub-columns that re-ink the region at higher resolution, while the rest of the strip stays coars

items.name: nikolas-sapa/welt-channel-close
items.description: [ns-ui] A full-width section divider modeled on Goodyear-welted shoe construction: a needle locks one welt stitch at a time at a single working point while, a few stitches behind it, the channel flap that exposed the last batch of stitches folds shut on a real CSS 3D hinge and hides them for good. The locks

items.name: nikolas-sapa/wind-regulator-bellows
items.description: [ns-ui] A streaming media buffer-ahead strip modelled on a pipe organ's wind supply: a feeder bellows pumps discrete strokes into a reservoir whose weighted lid smooths that into a steady reading, and a spring-loaded spill valve bleeds off the excess whenever the lid threatens to overshoot, replacing the fl

items.name: nikolas-sapa/wizard-canal-lock
items.description: [ns-ui] A wizard stepper built as a flight of canal locks: the next chamber's water level climbs to meet the current one, and only once they equalize does the shared gate split open for the active highlight to glide through. An invalid step's level visibly stalls short of the gate line instead of popping a

items.name: nikolas-sapa/wizard-dovetail
items.description: [ns-ui] A multi-step form whose completed steps physically interlock: each step contributes an SVG dovetail chip to a rail, sliding in to mate on a spring when valid, or bouncing off the joint and returning when it isn't.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/zipper-stall
items.description: [ns-ui] Merge resolution staged as closing a zipper: two columns of timestamped edit ops, meshed by dragging a handle down the spine that physically jams at the first same-offset conflict until you pick a side.

items.name: nikolas-sapa/agar-starve

items.name: vijetbhat6/hoverlab
items.description: [Hoverlab] The Hoverlab design system: light and dark CSS variables, radius scale and icon library. Install this first and every Hoverlab block and page inherits it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/preset-hoverlab
items.description: [Hoverlab] What this site wears — a green brand over faintly warm neutrals, 12px corners, standard gutters. The catalog as it ships. Start here if you like how the blocks look on this site.

items.name: vijetbhat6/preset-console
items.description: [Hoverlab] Almost no chroma anywhere, square corners, tighter gutters and slightly smaller type. Developer tools and anything data-heavy, where colour should mean something rather than decorate.

items.name: vijetbhat6/preset-studio
items.description: [Hoverlab] A warm brand over warm neutrals with large corners and generous spacing. Marketing sites and consumer products — the shape that reads as calm rather than capable.

items.name: vijetbhat6/preset-cockpit
items.description: [Hoverlab] Cool violet accent, small corners, tight gutters, smaller type throughout. Dashboards and admin panels that have to show a lot at once without shouting.

items.name: vijetbhat6/preset-signal
items.description: [Hoverlab] High-chroma amber on lightly tinted neutrals, at the catalog’s own proportions. Consumer apps and launches — the one that looks least like a developer tool.

items.name: vijetbhat6/kit-saas-launch
items.description: [Hoverlab] Marketing site, auth, dashboard and billing — the whole first release. One install writes 25 of its 26 pieces; the template is a separate scaffold.

items.name: vijetbhat6/kit-ai-product
items.description: [Hoverlab] Thread, reasoning trace, approvals, citations — and the meter that bills them. One install writes 22 of its 23 pieces; the template is a separate scaffold.

items.name: vijetbhat6/kit-storefront
items.description: [Hoverlab] Browse, filter, buy, pay, and the receipt afterwards. One install writes 25 of its 26 pieces; the template is a separate scaffold.

items.name: vijetbhat6/kit-internal-tools
items.description: [Hoverlab] Tables that sort, filter, bulk-edit and page — plus the shell around them. One install writes 22 of its 23 pieces; the template is a separate scaffold.

items.name: vijetbhat6/kit-waitlist
items.description: [Hoverlab] One page, one form, one evening. One install writes 13 of its 14 pieces; the template is a separate scaffold.

items.name: vijetbhat6/kit-content-and-docs
items.description: [Hoverlab] A blog, a documentation site, a changelog and a careers page. One install writes 19 of its 21 pieces; the templates are a separate scaffold.

items.name: vijetbhat6/path-landing-page
items.description: [Hoverlab] Eight blocks, in the order that converts. One install writes all 8 blocks.

items.name: vijetbhat6/path-waitlist
items.description: [Hoverlab] One screen, one field, live in an evening. One install writes all 6 blocks.

items.name: vijetbhat6/path-auth-flow
items.description: [Hoverlab] Every screen a real sign-in needs, including the ones people forget. One install writes all 6 blocks.

items.name: vijetbhat6/path-onboarding
items.description: [Hoverlab] The first ten minutes, from sign-up to first real action. One install writes all 6 blocks.

items.name: vijetbhat6/path-states
items.description: [Hoverlab] Loading, empty, error, missing — the four screens that decide whether it feels finished. One install writes all 6 blocks.

items.name: vijetbhat6/path-settings
items.description: [Hoverlab] Five screens, in the order people go looking for them. One install writes all 5 blocks.

items.name: vijetbhat6/path-product-updates
items.description: [Hoverlab] A changelog, a roadmap, and a way to hear about both. One install writes all 5 blocks.

items.name: vijetbhat6/path-dashboard
items.description: [Hoverlab] The shell, the numbers, and the table underneath. One install writes all 7 blocks.

items.name: vijetbhat6/path-billing
items.description: [Hoverlab] From the price on the marketing page to the invoice in the account. One install writes all 5 blocks.

items.name: vijetbhat6/path-storefront
items.description: [Hoverlab] Browse, choose, buy — the whole commerce path. One install writes all 8 blocks.

items.name: vijetbhat6/path-ai-assistant
items.description: [Hoverlab] From the blank thread to an action the user actually approved. One install writes all 10 blocks.

items.name: vijetbhat6/hero-split
items.description: [Hoverlab] Copy on the left, a drawn product panel on the right — the default hero for anything with an interface to show, with no image asset to host and no layout shift while it loads.

items.name: vijetbhat6/hero-centered
items.description: [Hoverlab] A linked announcement pill over a large centered headline, dual CTAs and a wordmark strip — the hero for a product with nothing to screenshot yet.

items.name: vijetbhat6/hero-screenshot
items.description: [Hoverlab] Centered copy above a screenshot in window chrome, masked at the bottom so a tall image never dictates the height of the fold. Wraps your own img or video.

items.name: vijetbhat6/hero-waitlist
items.description: [Hoverlab] A pre-launch hero whose only ask is an email address, with pending and success states and a signup count that argues for finishing rather than starting.

items.name: vijetbhat6/hero-search
items.description: [Hoverlab] A hero whose primary action is a real search form with prefilling suggestion chips — for marketplaces and directories, where sending the visitor below the fold to find the search box is the whole failure.

items.name: vijetbhat6/hero-terminal
items.description: [Hoverlab] A drawn terminal whose install line is real, selectable text with a working copy button and a feature-detected clipboard call — the hero for anything adopted by typing rather than signing up.

items.name: vijetbhat6/hero-app-download
items.description: [Hoverlab] A drawn phone beside two store links built as real anchors rather than badge images, so they inherit the theme, need no hosted asset and carry an accessible name that is not a filename.

items.name: vijetbhat6/hero-testimonial
items.description: [Hoverlab] Pitch on the left, a marked-up figure and blockquote on the right, so the claim and the evidence for it share the fold instead of sitting a scroll apart.

items.name: vijetbhat6/hero-metrics
items.description: [Hoverlab] A centered hero closing on a definition list of scale numbers, with a masked grid wash behind it — for infrastructure and payments, where "how many" is the second question a buyer asks.

items.name: vijetbhat6/hero-editorial
items.description: [Hoverlab] A serif display headline over a 60-character standfirst and a real byline, with one text link and no competing CTAs — the hero for publications and essays, where the writing is the product.

items.name: vijetbhat6/hero-media-overlay
items.description: [Hoverlab] Copy over your own image or video, with a graded scrim and deliberately fixed light-on-dark text — because the background is a photograph in both themes, so flipping the copy would break it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/hero-integrations
items.description: [Hoverlab] A hero whose visual is the connector list itself, marked up as a real list so a visitor can skim it for their own stack — asset-free initials tiles, no third-party marks to license.

items.name: vijetbhat6/hero-booking
items.description: [Hoverlab] A day strip built as a radio group rather than buttons, so arrow keys move between dates and sold-out days disable properly — the fold for anything sold by the appointment.

items.name: vijetbhat6/hero-price-anchor
items.description: [Hoverlab] Names the price above the fold for single-plan and one-time products, with the former price in a real strikethrough element so it is never announced as the current one.

items.name: vijetbhat6/navbar-simple
items.description: [Hoverlab] Brand, links and CTAs with a mobile panel that unmounts when closed — so its links are never tabbable while invisible — plus escape-to-close and focus return.

items.name: vijetbhat6/announcement-bar
items.description: [Hoverlab] The strip above the navbar, with the three things it usually gets wrong fixed: a named region, a live role only when it earns one, and a dismissal that persists.

items.name: vijetbhat6/navbar-mega-menu
items.description: [Hoverlab] Top-level items that open a described-link panel, opening on hover and focus, closing on escape, outside click and focus leaving the group — and collapsing to an accordion on mobile.

items.name: vijetbhat6/nav-mobile-drawer
items.description: [Hoverlab] A slide-in site menu that behaves like a dialog: focus trap, focus restoration, body scroll lock and a transition that drops under prefers-reduced-motion.

items.name: vijetbhat6/navbar-authenticated
items.description: [Hoverlab] The bar above an app rather than a site: workspace and environment named in the open, a bell that counts in words, and an impersonation strip that cannot be dismissed.

items.name: vijetbhat6/footer-mega
items.description: [Hoverlab] Brand column, four labelled nav columns, socials and a legal bar — the one place every page links to every section. Ships no client JavaScript.

items.name: vijetbhat6/footer-minimal
items.description: [Hoverlab] One row — brand, a handful of links, socials, copyright — for a site where a five-column footer would be whitespace pretending to be structure.

items.name: vijetbhat6/footer-newsletter
items.description: [Hoverlab] A raised email-capture band overlapping a three-column link footer, with the confirmation replacing the field in place rather than navigating away.

items.name: vijetbhat6/footer-status-locale
items.description: [Hoverlab] The footer of a signed-in product rather than a marketing site: a live status line with words as well as colour, plus locale and theme as native selects.

items.name: vijetbhat6/footer-compliance
items.description: [Hoverlab] Legal entity, company number, registered address, VAT and the consumer links an EU or UK seller has to publish — with a region control that changes the terms, not just the currency.

items.name: vijetbhat6/contact-form-split
items.description: [Hoverlab] A contact form beside the channels that bypass it — a real address, a support link and a response-time promise, which is what makes a form people cannot see into feel worth filling.

items.name: vijetbhat6/multi-step-form
items.description: [Hoverlab] A three-step form where each step validates only its own fields, errors are wired to inputs with aria-describedby, and advancing moves focus to the new heading.

items.name: vijetbhat6/booking-scheduler
items.description: [Hoverlab] Day strip, slot grid and a time zone the visitor can change — because a slot list with no zone on it is how this pattern wastes an hour of everyone involved.

items.name: vijetbhat6/feedback-widget
items.description: [Hoverlab] One click to rate, everything after it optional — the shape that collects a complaint from someone mid-task who would never open a contact page.

items.name: vijetbhat6/form-error-summary
items.description: [Hoverlab] The state every form reaches and none of them illustrate: a focused summary at the top linking to each bad field, validation that waits for submit, and somewhere for the failure that belongs to no field.

items.name: vijetbhat6/contact-sales-form
items.description: [Hoverlab] A qualifying contact form that asks the three things a first reply needs, and says what happens next before you send it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/support-ticket-form
items.description: [Hoverlab] A support form that asks for the one thing that halves resolution time — what you already tried — and says when a human will read it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/confirm-dialog
items.description: [Hoverlab] A type-to-confirm dialog built on native <dialog>, so the focus trap, top layer and escape handling come from the browser. Focus lands on Cancel, and the button says the verb.

items.name: vijetbhat6/cookie-consent
items.description: [Hoverlab] Per-category consent where refusing is exactly as easy as accepting, nothing non-essential is pre-ticked, and the page behind it stays readable — the shape the law expects, wired to your own script gating.

items.name: vijetbhat6/slide-over-panel
items.description: [Hoverlab] A side sheet for editing a record without losing the list behind it — native <dialog> for the trapping, a data attribute for the slide, and a sticky footer so Save never scrolls away.

items.name: vijetbhat6/filter-drawer-facets
items.description: [Hoverlab] Facets with per-option counts, zero-result options disabled rather than hidden so the list never jumps, and a pending selection applied on a button that says how many choices changed.

items.name: vijetbhat6/share-access-dialog
items.description: [Hoverlab] The share modal where a design mistake is a data leak: general access stated as its consequence rather than its setting, and a copy button that never silently widens access.

items.name: vijetbhat6/bottom-sheet-mobile
items.description: [Hoverlab] Half and full snap points where the content owns the scroll and overscroll-contain keeps the page behind still. The drag handle is a real button, Escape and the backdrop close it, and safe-area padding keeps the last row pressable.

items.name: vijetbhat6/modal-unsaved-changes
items.description: [Hoverlab] The interception that keeps work: three answers rather than two, the changed fields listed by name, a destructive-styled discard, and Escape resolving to cancel.

items.name: vijetbhat6/drawer-record-detail
items.description: [Hoverlab] A non-modal drawer that keeps the list on screen, with previous and next controls for moving between records and an activity tab beside the fields.

items.name: vijetbhat6/onboarding-checklist
items.description: [Hoverlab] The get-started card that ships with its first item already ticked, a native <progress> element rather than a div bar, and a dismiss control that appears only once there is nothing left to abandon.

items.name: vijetbhat6/setup-wizard
items.description: [Hoverlab] A choice-driven wizard with a persistent side rail, real radio groups in a fieldset so arrow keys work, and visited steps navigable while steps ahead stay out of the tab order.

items.name: vijetbhat6/team-invite-step
items.description: [Hoverlab] The onboarding step where a product becomes multiplayer: pasted addresses split into chips, typos marked rather than dropped, and an honest way to skip.

items.name: vijetbhat6/product-tour-coachmark
items.description: [Hoverlab] A tour step anchored to the control it explains, with a spotlight cut by one spread shadow, a visible step count and focus that follows the step.

items.name: vijetbhat6/onboarding-role-picker
items.description: [Hoverlab] The "what best describes you" step, asked honestly — every option states what it actually changes, the skip is visible and names what you get instead, and the choice is reversible.

items.name: vijetbhat6/onboarding-import-data
items.description: [Hoverlab] The empty product’s real first question. Sample data is offered with equal weight rather than as grey small print, every connector names its scope before the redirect, and each option carries the honest duration.

items.name: vijetbhat6/workspace-setup-form
items.description: [Hoverlab] The first screen after signup, asking only the two things that cannot be changed silently later.

items.name: vijetbhat6/data-migration-split
items.description: [Hoverlab] What a migration actually moves and what it cannot, stated before the switch rather than discovered after it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/toast-stack
items.description: [Hoverlab] A corner stack whose live region is mounted before any message exists, errors announce assertively, and the auto-dismiss timer pauses on hover and on focus.

items.name: vijetbhat6/notification-inbox
items.description: [Hoverlab] The bell panel: filterable list with read state, the unread count in the accessible name rather than only in a badge, and machine-readable timestamps beside the human ones.

items.name: vijetbhat6/notification-preferences
items.description: [Hoverlab] Per-event, per-channel switches as a real table, with required notifications locked and explained, and column headers that toggle a whole channel and report a mixed state honestly.

items.name: vijetbhat6/push-permission-prompt
items.description: [Hoverlab] The soft ask before the browser dialog you only get one shot at — what will be sent, what will not, and a decline of the same weight as the yes.

items.name: vijetbhat6/notification-digest-list
items.description: [Hoverlab] A day's notifications collapsed into one digest, grouped by what they are rather than when they arrived.

items.name: vijetbhat6/digest-schedule-form
items.description: [Hoverlab] The control that turns notification volume down instead of off, which is the choice most people actually want.

items.name: vijetbhat6/notification-channel-list
items.description: [Hoverlab] Which channel carries which event, so the loud ones can be moved rather than muted entirely.

items.name: vijetbhat6/stats-band
items.description: [Hoverlab] A four-up metrics strip with 1px hairline dividers, built from a single gap-px grid so the rules stay crisp on any display.

items.name: vijetbhat6/stats-cards
items.description: [Hoverlab] Metrics carrying the direction they moved, with the good direction declared per stat so a falling churn rate reads as a win — arrow and text, never colour alone.

items.name: vijetbhat6/stats-narrative
items.description: [Hoverlab] Four figures in a hairline card next to the paragraph making the claim, each carrying an optional source line — for numbers that mean nothing without knowing lower than what, over how long, across how many.

items.name: vijetbhat6/stats-comparison
items.description: [Hoverlab] The buyer’s current situation in one column and yours in the next, as a real table with scoped headers — the comparison they are actually making, which a delta against your own past cannot express.

items.name: vijetbhat6/stats-timeline
items.description: [Hoverlab] The same measurement taken year after year down a vertical rail, each with the event that explains it — the shape for trajectory, which no snapshot of four numbers can claim.

items.name: vijetbhat6/stats-benchmark-band
items.description: [Hoverlab] Performance figures with the measurement method printed beside each one, so a sceptical reader can check rather than take them.

items.name: vijetbhat6/security-posture-band
items.description: [Hoverlab] The compliance and security facts a procurement reviewer asks for, stated as figures with their scope rather than as badges.

items.name: vijetbhat6/logo-cloud
items.description: [Hoverlab] An infinite horizontal logo scroll with masked edges, a pause-on-hover affordance and a reduced-motion fallback that wraps instead of moving.

items.name: vijetbhat6/logo-grid
items.description: [Hoverlab] Hairline-separated cells that hold still and show the whole set at once — the logo wall for a footer, a customers page, or anywhere the count is the claim.

items.name: vijetbhat6/logo-strip
items.description: [Hoverlab] One unbordered line of wordmarks beside a claim you can actually be wrong about, sized to sit under a hero without pushing the CTA down or moving while the headline is being read.

items.name: vijetbhat6/logo-segments
items.description: [Hoverlab] Customer logos under segment headings as a description list, with an “and 40 more” count for the ones under NDA — answers whether you have done this for someone like the reader, which a flat wall cannot.

items.name: vijetbhat6/bento-features
items.description: [Hoverlab] Six tiles on an asymmetric 4x3 grid with per-tile spans, a hover glow and a mobile collapse that follows source order.

items.name: vijetbhat6/feature-rows
items.description: [Hoverlab] A full row per feature with the media side flipping each time, so the eye re-enters the page instead of skimming a stack of identical blocks.

items.name: vijetbhat6/feature-icon-grid
items.description: [Hoverlab] Uniform cells, no spans, no state — the grid for nine things that matter equally, where a bento would be a wall and tabs would be a filing cabinet.

items.name: vijetbhat6/integration-grid
items.description: [Hoverlab] What each integration actually does, not a wall of logos — with availability as a text pill rather than a tinted border, and the name as the link so the card is not one enormous one.

items.name: vijetbhat6/persona-cards
items.description: [Hoverlab] A "who this is for" grid: four cards naming an audience, the outcome they want and the bullets that get them there.

items.name: vijetbhat6/code-showcase
items.description: [Hoverlab] A feature section paired with a tabbed fake editor — real selectable code, generated line numbers and a copy button.

items.name: vijetbhat6/feature-tabs
items.description: [Hoverlab] Features as a real tablist — arrow keys, roving focus and a drawn product panel per tab — for the section where four features would otherwise fight for one scroll.

items.name: vijetbhat6/integration-depth-split
items.description: [Hoverlab] An integrations section that says how deep each one goes, instead of a wall of logos that all imply the same thing.

items.name: vijetbhat6/pricing-tiers
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three plans with a monthly/yearly switch, yearly prices derived from the monthly figure so the two can never disagree.

items.name: vijetbhat6/pricing-single
items.description: [Hoverlab] One price given a whole card, with the objection a one-time price raises answered under the button rather than in a FAQ further down.

items.name: vijetbhat6/pricing-usage-calculator
items.description: [Hoverlab] A slider that turns a rate card into the number a buyer actually cares about, with a per-tier breakdown so the total can be checked rather than taken on trust.

items.name: vijetbhat6/comparison-table
items.description: [Hoverlab] A real table with scoped headers, a sticky first column and screen-reader text behind every check and dash.

items.name: vijetbhat6/pricing-credits
items.description: [Hoverlab] One-time packs with the per-credit price worked out for the reader and the saving stated rather than implied — the pricing shape for a product that sells quantity, not a subscription.

items.name: vijetbhat6/pricing-plan-picker
items.description: [Hoverlab] A native radiogroup of plans with the current one disabled and the prorated charge announced as it changes — the upgrade dialog, not the marketing table.

items.name: vijetbhat6/pricing-value-split
items.description: [Hoverlab] The case for the price, made beside the price — what the alternative costs, in the units a buyer already measures.

items.name: vijetbhat6/plan-limits-list
items.description: [Hoverlab] What actually runs out on each plan, including what happens when it does — the row a pricing table leaves off.

items.name: vijetbhat6/testimonial-grid
items.description: [Hoverlab] Quotes packed by height using CSS multi-column, with star ratings, initial avatars and no ragged bottom edge.

items.name: vijetbhat6/testimonial-spotlight
items.description: [Hoverlab] One customer, quoted at length and backed by a stat row — the section for when a single believable story argues better than a wall of five-star fragments.

items.name: vijetbhat6/testimonial-ratings
items.description: [Hoverlab] A mean score over a stated sample with all five rating bands left visible, including the one-star row — proof that survives the objection every hand-picked quote wall invites.

items.name: vijetbhat6/testimonial-carousel
items.description: [Hoverlab] Twenty quotes in the height of six, scrolled by CSS snap points with arrows that disable at the ends — no auto-advance, and every quote stays in the DOM for search and Cmd-F.

items.name: vijetbhat6/testimonial-video
items.description: [Hoverlab] Poster tiles linking out to recordings, each with a pull-quote that has to land for the majority who never press play, and a drawn placeholder until you supply a still.

items.name: vijetbhat6/customer-outcome-band
items.description: [Hoverlab] Testimonials reduced to the measured outcome and the conditions it happened under, for readers who skip the quotes.

items.name: vijetbhat6/faq-accordion
items.description: [Hoverlab] Exclusive accordion behaviour from named <details> elements — no state, no hooks, no JavaScript, full keyboard support for free.

items.name: vijetbhat6/faq-two-column
items.description: [Hoverlab] Questions on the right against a sticky rail that keeps a route to a human in view — for the visitor whose objection is not on the list.

items.name: vijetbhat6/faq-grid
items.description: [Hoverlab] Every answer rendered and visible in a two-column description list — the FAQ shape for a marketing page, where collapsed text is text a search engine will not quote.

items.name: vijetbhat6/faq-categorized
items.description: [Hoverlab] Anchor-linked topic pills over per-topic details groups with the first answer open — for the FAQ that outgrew a single list, working with JavaScript disabled.

items.name: vijetbhat6/faq-search
items.description: [Hoverlab] A search that narrows the list across answers and keywords, announces the count, and turns an empty result into the contact route it should always have been.

items.name: vijetbhat6/faq-objection-list
items.description: [Hoverlab] An FAQ written from the objections that stop a sale rather than from the questions that are comfortable to answer.

items.name: vijetbhat6/security-faq-list
items.description: [Hoverlab] The security questions a buyer's IT reviewer asks, answered with scope and dates rather than with the word "enterprise-grade".

items.name: vijetbhat6/changelog-timeline
items.description: [Hoverlab] A dated changelog on a vertical rail with added/changed/fixed tags and machine-readable <time> values.

items.name: vijetbhat6/roadmap-columns
items.description: [Hoverlab] Shipped / in progress / planned in three columns, with status carried by icon as well as colour.

items.name: vijetbhat6/blog-post-grid
items.description: [Hoverlab] A featured post at full width above a card grid, with drawn covers built from tokens — a blog index with no image pipeline and no broken-thumbnail state.

items.name: vijetbhat6/article-header
items.description: [Hoverlab] Kicker, headline, standfirst, byline and share row, with the opening prose and a pull quote included — the type scale of a post, decided once instead of per-article.

items.name: vijetbhat6/team-grid
items.description: [Hoverlab] An about-page team section on initials avatars rather than photos, so shipping it never waits on headshots and there is no broken-image state to design.

items.name: vijetbhat6/job-listing-board
items.description: [Hoverlab] Openings grouped by department with location, type and salary on every row — candidates self-select by craft first, and a flat list makes them scan for it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/docs-layout
items.description: [Hoverlab] Sidebar, article and on-this-page rail — each column answers a different question, and they collapse on mobile in the order that keeps the article alive.

items.name: vijetbhat6/api-endpoint-card
items.description: [Hoverlab] Method badge, path, parameter table and a request/response pair kept side by side — an example request whose response is a scroll away gets pasted blind.

items.name: vijetbhat6/code-tabs-panel
items.description: [Hoverlab] One install command behind npm/pnpm/yarn/bun tabs with a working copy button — every reader uses exactly one package manager, so showing all four wastes three lines.

items.name: vijetbhat6/newsletter-signup
items.description: [Hoverlab] Email capture with a four-state submission machine and an aria-live status line, so the outcome is announced and not just shown.

items.name: vijetbhat6/community-band
items.description: [Hoverlab] A closing CTA of three link cards pointing at GitHub, chat and social — somewhere to go for the visitor who is not ready to convert.

items.name: vijetbhat6/cta-split-panel
items.description: [Hoverlab] A rounded gradient panel that restates the offer for the reader who scrolled past everything — heading left, both CTAs right, reassurance points underneath.

items.name: vijetbhat6/cta-sticky-bar
items.description: [Hoverlab] The call to action that follows a long page down — held back until the reader is past a scroll threshold, dismissible, and spaced so it never covers the content it is selling.

items.name: vijetbhat6/cta-inline-card
items.description: [Hoverlab] The offer that sits inside the column instead of interrupting it — a labelled aside a screen reader can skip in one keystroke, tied to the paragraph above it, with the friction admitted before the click.

items.name: vijetbhat6/referral-waitlist-form
items.description: [Hoverlab] A waitlist capture that shows position and referral credit, turning a dead-end confirmation into the one action that moves the queue.

items.name: vijetbhat6/demo-request-form
items.description: [Hoverlab] A demo request that offers the self-serve escape first, so the people who did not want a call do not book one.

items.name: vijetbhat6/auth-login-card
items.description: [Hoverlab] Centred sign-in card with social providers, a password reveal toggle and the autoComplete values password managers actually need.

items.name: vijetbhat6/auth-signup-split
items.description: [Hoverlab] Registration form beside a testimonial panel, with live password rules and a proof column that drops rather than stacks on mobile.

items.name: vijetbhat6/auth-otp-verify
items.description: [Hoverlab] Six-box OTP entry that handles paste, backspace, arrow keys and iOS SMS autofill — the parts hand-rolled versions always miss.

items.name: vijetbhat6/auth-forgot-password
items.description: [Hoverlab] Reset-link request with a sent state worded to avoid leaking whether an account exists.

items.name: vijetbhat6/auth-reset-password
items.description: [Hoverlab] Set-a-new-password form with a four-step strength meter, confirm matching and errors announced rather than only coloured.

items.name: vijetbhat6/auth-two-factor
items.description: [Hoverlab] Authenticator-code prompt with a backup-code escape hatch and an opt-in trusted-device checkbox that is off by default.

items.name: vijetbhat6/auth-sso-domain
items.description: [Hoverlab] Email first, then whatever that domain uses. The password field is absent rather than disabled when SSO is enforced, the button names the company it redirects to, and a personal address is a normal answer instead of an error.

items.name: vijetbhat6/auth-magic-link-form
items.description: [Hoverlab] Passwordless sign-in that says what will land in the inbox and how long it lasts, before the address is typed.

items.name: vijetbhat6/sso-enterprise-split
items.description: [Hoverlab] What SSO actually covers, written for the person who has to configure it rather than the person who asked for it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/dashboard-shell
items.description: [Hoverlab] Sidebar, top bar and scrollable content slot, with a mobile drawer that closes on Escape and marks the active route.

items.name: vijetbhat6/dashboard-stat-cards
items.description: [Hoverlab] Metric row where each card knows whether a rise is good news, so churn going up is red while revenue going up is green.

items.name: vijetbhat6/dashboard-activity-feed
items.description: [Hoverlab] Recent-events list with typed icons and relative timestamps that keep the absolute value in a <time> element.

items.name: vijetbhat6/dashboard-page-header
items.description: [Hoverlab] Breadcrumb, title, action buttons and a counted tab row that sits flush with the bottom rule.

items.name: vijetbhat6/kanban-board
items.description: [Hoverlab] Four columns of prioritised, tagged, assigned task cards with a blocked state — the board as a layout contract, leaving drag behaviour to your own state and library.

items.name: vijetbhat6/activity-timeline
items.description: [Hoverlab] Events grouped by day on a vertical rail, icons varying by type and one entry expanded into a detail card — what keeps forty events scannable instead of forty gray dots.

items.name: vijetbhat6/calendar-month
items.description: [Hoverlab] A month view where event chips truncate and overflow becomes "+n more", so a busy Tuesday never changes the height of the row it sits in.

items.name: vijetbhat6/dashboard-saved-views
items.description: [Hoverlab] Saved views with the third state most implementations drop: a shared view with unsaved edits, where Save changes what a colleague sees tomorrow. Two honest buttons instead of one, ownership on the tab, and dirty said in words.

items.name: vijetbhat6/dashboard-comparison-period
items.description: [Hoverlab] A reporting window with the comparison window spelled out beside it — resolved dates, UTC arithmetic, and an option to align weekdays so a weekend is never compared against a Tuesday.

items.name: vijetbhat6/dashboard-alert-rules
items.description: [Hoverlab] Threshold alerts with the two facts most rule lists omit: how often each has fired, and whether its channel is muted — so a rule that is on but delivering nowhere reads as its own state.

items.name: vijetbhat6/data-table-sortable
items.description: [Hoverlab] Type-aware sorting with aria-sort, a header checkbox that goes properly indeterminate, and selection that survives a re-sort.

items.name: vijetbhat6/data-table-toolbar
items.description: [Hoverlab] Search, filter count and view switch, with active filters shown as removable chips so a filtered table never looks unfiltered.

items.name: vijetbhat6/data-table-pagination
items.description: [Hoverlab] Page size, range summary and a fixed-width number window that stays the same size from page 1 to page 200.

items.name: vijetbhat6/data-table-expandable
items.description: [Hoverlab] Rows that open into a full-width detail panel via colSpan, with aria-expanded and aria-controls wired to the detail row.

items.name: vijetbhat6/data-table-column-manager
items.description: [Hoverlab] Reordering that works from the keyboard rather than by drag alone, pinned columns that cannot be hidden or moved, and a guard so the last visible column cannot be unchecked into a blank table.

items.name: vijetbhat6/data-table-bulk-actions
items.description: [Hoverlab] The selection bar that asks the question most tables skip: this page, or all 1,284 rows the filter matches. Typed confirmation above a threshold, an undo with the window counting down, and a select-all that names its own scope.

items.name: vijetbhat6/data-table-inline-edit
items.description: [Hoverlab] Edit cells in the grid with staged changes, per-cell validation, the original value kept beside the attempt, and a save that counts what is still pending.

items.name: vijetbhat6/data-table-grouped-rows
items.description: [Hoverlab] Collapsible group headers that carry their own subtotals while collapsed, with a grand total that sums every row rather than only the visible ones.

items.name: vijetbhat6/crud-create-form
items.description: [Hoverlab] A full-page create form with a guidance rail and a Save-and-create-another that keeps the shared fields - the shape a record with more than six fields actually needs.

items.name: vijetbhat6/crud-create-modal
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three fields over the list they add to, with the new row appearing behind the dialog rather than after it closes.

items.name: vijetbhat6/crud-create-drawer
items.description: [Hoverlab] A long create form in a side drawer: the fields scroll, the header and the action bar do not, and the list stays legible beside it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/crud-read-page
items.description: [Hoverlab] The read view arranged by what a reader came for - a verdict band of four facts, then details, then the related records a field dump can never show.

items.name: vijetbhat6/crud-read-modal
items.description: [Hoverlab] The verification modal from a table row: copyable identifiers, no editing, nothing scrolling, and the row still marked behind it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/crud-update-form
items.description: [Hoverlab] An edit page that shows the diff - per-field change markers carrying the previous value, a per-field revert, and a Save button that counts what it will write.

items.name: vijetbhat6/crud-update-modal
items.description: [Hoverlab] The edit modal including the parts nobody draws: the in-flight state, the rejected save that keeps your typing, and the conflict when someone else got there first.

items.name: vijetbhat6/crud-update-drawer
items.description: [Hoverlab] The save-on-blur model, with per-field confirmation, per-field failure and a written-in-this-session log - the only honest answer to what did I just change.

items.name: vijetbhat6/crud-delete-cascade
items.description: [Hoverlab] Deleting a record other records depend on: dependents counted and grouped by fate - deleted, orphaned, retained - with a guard that scales to the blast radius.

items.name: vijetbhat6/crud-success-state
items.description: [Hoverlab] The screen after the write: the reference copyable, next actions ranked rather than listed, and an undo window that counts down honestly and then says why it is gone.

items.name: vijetbhat6/crud-bulk-edit-drawer
items.description: [Hoverlab] One change applied to many records that disagree - mixed values shown as mixed, untouched fields never written, and skipped rows counted before you commit.

items.name: vijetbhat6/crud-archive-restore
items.description: [Hoverlab] The bin with the clock on it: days until purge per row, who archived it, and a restore disabled with a reason when the parent has already gone.

items.name: vijetbhat6/settings-nav-layout
items.description: [Hoverlab] Sidebar-and-panel settings shell that becomes a horizontal scroller on mobile instead of collapsing into a select.

items.name: vijetbhat6/settings-profile-form
items.description: [Hoverlab] Avatar, fields and a character counter, with a sticky save bar that only appears once something has genuinely changed.

items.name: vijetbhat6/settings-team-members
items.description: [Hoverlab] Member list with role selects, pending invites shown inline, and the last owner locked so a workspace cannot be orphaned.

items.name: vijetbhat6/settings-api-keys
items.description: [Hoverlab] Masked keys, a create flow that reveals the secret exactly once, and a revoke that confirms before it fires.

items.name: vijetbhat6/settings-danger-zone
items.description: [Hoverlab] Destructive actions gated by typing the resource name exactly — the pattern GitHub and Stripe use, and for good reason.

items.name: vijetbhat6/settings-sessions
items.description: [Hoverlab] The screen people go looking for after losing a laptop. Sign out everywhere states what it does not reach — API keys keep working — locations are written as estimates, and this device is labelled rather than revocable by misclick.

items.name: vijetbhat6/settings-notification-matrix
items.description: [Hoverlab] Every event against every delivery channel in one grid, with column toggles and required rows that show the policy instead of a disabled checkbox.

items.name: vijetbhat6/settings-audit-log
items.description: [Hoverlab] A compliance-grade trail with named actors, before and after values, IP addresses, and a stated retention window — plus a count of what the active filter is hiding.

items.name: vijetbhat6/empty-state-cta
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two variants — nothing created yet, versus filters excluded everything — because offering "create your first" to a bad filter is the classic bug.

items.name: vijetbhat6/error-state-retry
items.description: [Hoverlab] Failed-to-load panel with a visible retry, a copyable error reference and the stack tucked behind a disclosure.

items.name: vijetbhat6/not-found-404
items.description: [Hoverlab] A 404 that helps: a real GET search form that works without JavaScript, likely destinations, and home as the fallback rather than the headline.

items.name: vijetbhat6/skeleton-list
items.description: [Hoverlab] Loading placeholders with varied row widths and a sweep that is motion-safe only, falling back to a flat tint under reduced motion.

items.name: vijetbhat6/permission-denied-state
items.description: [Hoverlab] The state where the page exists and the account is not on the list: names who can grant access, sends the request, and leaks nothing about what is inside.

items.name: vijetbhat6/offline-state-banner
items.description: [Hoverlab] Leads with what still works — three edits saved on this device — instead of with the failure. The retry backoff counts down in the open, and the three things that genuinely cannot work offline are named rather than discovered.

items.name: vijetbhat6/empty-filtered-results
items.description: [Hoverlab] The empty state for a list emptied by its own filters: every active filter shown as a removable chip ordered by how many results it would restore, with clear-all deliberately second.

items.name: vijetbhat6/maintenance-window-state
items.description: [Hoverlab] Planned downtime with a live countdown, an end time in the reader’s timezone, what still works — and a different sentence once the window overruns rather than a negative timer.

items.name: vijetbhat6/metric-sparkline-cards
items.description: [Hoverlab] KPI cards with a hand-built SVG trend line — no charting dependency for a path this file computes in twelve lines.

items.name: vijetbhat6/bar-chart-panel
items.description: [Hoverlab] Categorical bars in plain CSS with gridlines, hover values and a screen-reader table carrying the real numbers.

items.name: vijetbhat6/usage-meter-panel
items.description: [Hoverlab] Consumption against plan limits, with warning thresholds, honest overage display and unmetered quotas that do not fake a bar.

items.name: vijetbhat6/line-chart-panel
items.description: [Hoverlab] A year-over-year trend in inline SVG with a printed axis, no charting dependency and the same data repeated as a screen-reader table.

items.name: vijetbhat6/donut-breakdown
items.description: [Hoverlab] Where a total went, drawn as one conic-gradient ring with the total in the hole and every number repeated in the legend.

items.name: vijetbhat6/activity-heatmap
items.description: [Hoverlab] A year of daily activity as one square per day, bucketed against a quantile so a single outlier cannot flatten the scale.

items.name: vijetbhat6/funnel-conversion-panel
items.description: [Hoverlab] A funnel that leads with the step-to-step rate and the people who fell out of it, not the tidy share-of-top percentages nobody can act on. Biggest drop named in words, and a footnote saying which definition of funnel this is.

items.name: vijetbhat6/metric-alert-list
items.description: [Hoverlab] Alert thresholds with their current distance from firing, so a quiet alert is visibly armed rather than possibly broken.

items.name: vijetbhat6/kpi-summary-band
items.description: [Hoverlab] The top-of-dashboard figures, each carrying the comparison period that makes a delta mean anything.

items.name: vijetbhat6/billing-plan-summary
items.description: [Hoverlab] Current plan, next charge with an actual figure and date, payment method, and a prominent pending-cancellation state.

items.name: vijetbhat6/invoice-history-table
items.description: [Hoverlab] Past invoices with tabular figures, worded statuses rather than bare coloured dots, and per-invoice download labels.

items.name: vijetbhat6/payment-method-card
items.description: [Hoverlab] Cards on file with the two failures that cost the subscription: expiry called out before it fails, and the default stated on the row rather than implied by ordering.

items.name: vijetbhat6/subscription-cancel-flow
items.description: [Hoverlab] Self-serve cancellation with no dark patterns: the exact date access ends, what breaks, one honest alternative, and a button that works.

items.name: vijetbhat6/usage-overage-notice
items.description: [Hoverlab] Past the included allowance, with the end-of-month projection and every number the invoice will use — because a surprise bill is a product defect.

items.name: vijetbhat6/billing-seat-manager
items.description: [Hoverlab] Changing seats with the bill shown first: the part-period charge and the new recurring amount as two numbers, the arithmetic spelled out, and the asymmetry stated where it bites — removing a seat refunds nothing today.

items.name: vijetbhat6/billing-invoice-detail
items.description: [Hoverlab] One invoice with the arithmetic shown: proration split into a credit and a charge with their own date ranges, tax as a line with its jurisdiction, and totals in a real tfoot.

items.name: vijetbhat6/billing-credit-balance
items.description: [Hoverlab] Consumable credits split into the buckets they actually live in, rendered in spend order, with a proportional warning that only appears when a meaningful balance is about to expire.

items.name: vijetbhat6/support-chat-widget
items.description: [Hoverlab] The corner launcher, with real availability instead of a stock reassurance, article deflection before the form, no self-opening, and a way to make it go away.

items.name: vijetbhat6/message-bubble-thread
items.description: [Hoverlab] Bubbles with the parts that get skipped: per-message delivery state, grouping by author and time, day separators, and a retry on the failed bubble itself.

items.name: vijetbhat6/message-attachment-bubble
items.description: [Hoverlab] Five kinds of thing that is not text - image, document, link, location and an upload still in flight - each answering the question its own kind raises.

items.name: vijetbhat6/inbox-thread-list
items.description: [Hoverlab] The list half of a two-pane inbox, with unread and selected as visibly different states and bulk selection as a mode rather than a hover checkbox.

items.name: vijetbhat6/inbox-thread-detail
items.description: [Hoverlab] The reading pane with the composer always present, quoted history collapsed behind a count, and an internal-note mode whose send button names the recipient.

items.name: vijetbhat6/voice-message-player
items.description: [Hoverlab] A voice note you can navigate: a waveform that is a real seek control, a speed button, a transcript, and a played state that survives finishing.

items.name: vijetbhat6/video-call-layout
items.description: [Hoverlab] The call grid with the state that makes it usable - active speaker, per-tile connection quality, hide self-view, and the you-are-muted nudge.

items.name: vijetbhat6/call-device-settings
items.description: [Hoverlab] The green room, where every picker has a test beside it - an input meter, a test tone, a camera preview - and blocked permission is a state, not an error.

items.name: vijetbhat6/support-ticket-thread
items.description: [Hoverlab] The customer side of a ticket, where a named owner and a deadline replace Status: Open - including the waiting-on-you state that stops the argument about response times.

items.name: vijetbhat6/command-palette
items.description: [Hoverlab] The ⌘K switcher done properly: focus stays in the input while aria-activedescendant moves, arrows wrap, and the highlight resets on every query change.

items.name: vijetbhat6/search-results-panel
items.description: [Hoverlab] Results grouped by section with visible breadcrumb paths and <mark>-highlighted matches — users recognise where a result lives faster than they read its snippet.

items.name: vijetbhat6/keyboard-shortcuts-sheet
items.description: [Hoverlab] The "?" overlay, with chords written once in one notation and rendered per platform — mod becomes Command on Apple and Ctrl everywhere else, decided after mount so the markup never mismatches.

items.name: vijetbhat6/applied-filters-bar
items.description: [Hoverlab] The strip above a result set that answers "why am I only seeing four things" — every active constraint as a removable chip, with the excluded count beside it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/search-autocomplete
items.description: [Hoverlab] The field in the header, not the palette over it: Enter searches for what you typed unless you arrowed to a suggestion, late responses are dropped by sequence number, and recent searches are removable one at a time.

items.name: vijetbhat6/search-facet-panel
items.description: [Hoverlab] Faceted search with result counts on every option, zero-count options kept visible and disabled so the list stays stable, and a note explaining why the counts do not sum.

items.name: vijetbhat6/search-scope-switcher
items.description: [Hoverlab] One query counted across every scope it could have matched, as a real tablist with arrow-key movement — so an answer that is nowhere is visible without opening four tabs.

items.name: vijetbhat6/recent-search-list
items.description: [Hoverlab] The empty state of a search box, filled with the searches that are worth repeating and the ones worth saving.

items.name: vijetbhat6/search-faceted-results
items.description: [Hoverlab] The whole faceted search assembled - rail, chips, live count and sort - with the intersection actually applied and relevance offered only when there is a query.

items.name: vijetbhat6/search-facet-range
items.description: [Hoverlab] The facet that is a number: a distribution over a dual-thumb slider built from two real range inputs, with typed bounds clamped on blur rather than per keystroke.

items.name: vijetbhat6/file-dropzone
items.description: [Hoverlab] Dropzone with per-file progress and a drag counter that fixes the flicker every naive dragleave handler produces.

items.name: vijetbhat6/upload-progress-list
