items.description: [Hoverlab] Four-step wizard with completed ticks, a pulsing current step and ocean connector rails.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-split-button-8543
items.description: [Hoverlab] Primary action joined to its own caret segment by an inset rule, so the dropdown half is a separate target rather than a wider button.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-traced-border-button-8571
items.description: [Hoverlab] An ocean conic gradient rotating behind a solid inset face, so only the two-pixel rim reads as light travelling around the edge.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-percentage-ring-8583
items.description: [Hoverlab] Determinate conic ring with the value printed in the middle in tabular figures, so the number does not jitter as it counts.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-orbit-loader-8611
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three ocean satellites parked at 120-degree intervals and rotated as one group, so the ring keeps its spacing at any speed.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-sparkline-card-8623
items.description: [Hoverlab] Metric tile with a delta pill and an eight-bar sparkline drawn in CSS, so the trend needs no charting library and no SVG.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-profile-card-8651
items.description: [Hoverlab] Cover banner with an avatar pulled up over the seam by a negative margin, so the ring sits half on the gradient and half on the body.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-typewriter-text-8663
items.description: [Hoverlab] Width stepped in whole characters with `steps()` and a caret blinking on its own cycle, so the cursor keeps ticking while the text is paused.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-word-rotator-8691
items.description: [Hoverlab] A stack of words rolled behind a one-line window, holding on each long enough to read before the next snaps up.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-mesh-gradient-8703
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three heavily blurred blobs drifting on unequal periods, so the field never visibly loops back to where it started.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-contour-field-8731
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two repeating radial gradients offset into contour rings, drifting in opposite directions so the map reads as terrain rather than a texture.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-pin-code-field-8743
items.description: [Hoverlab] Six single-character boxes that mark themselves filled with `:not(:placeholder-shown)`, so state comes from the value rather than a class.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-tag-input-8771
items.description: [Hoverlab] Chips and a flexible field sharing one bordered box, with `:focus-within` lighting the whole container rather than just the input.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-sidebar-rail-8783
items.description: [Hoverlab] Vertical nav whose active marker grows from the centre out, so hover and selected read as the same gesture at two lengths.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-mega-menu-8811
items.description: [Hoverlab] Dropdown panel opening on hover and on `:focus-within`, so it is reachable by keyboard, with `visibility` transitioned so it is not tabbable while faded out.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-chevron-divider-8823
items.description: [Hoverlab] A rule interrupted by a rotated chevron, punched out of the line with a solid box-shadow rather than a background swatch that has to match.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-double-rule-divider-8851
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two hairlines bracketing a glowing node, spaced far enough apart to read as a deliberate seam rather than a doubled border.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-count-badge-8863
items.description: [Hoverlab] Unread counter pinned to the corner of a carrier tile, with a background-colored ring so it stays legible over whatever sits beneath it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-ribbon-badge-8891
items.description: [Hoverlab] Notched banner cut with `clip-path` and given a drop-shadow rather than a box-shadow, so the shade follows the arrow instead of boxing it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-labelled-switch-8903
items.description: [Hoverlab] Track carrying its own ON and OFF words, cross-faded rather than translated, with a real checkbox behind it so it keeps focus and keyboard toggling.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-segmented-control-8931
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three exclusive options as real radios, so arrow keys move between segments — a row of buttons would need a Tab stop each.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-shortcut-tooltip-8943
items.description: [Hoverlab] Hint showing its own key binding in real `<kbd>` elements, opening on hover and focus so the shortcut is discoverable from the keyboard too.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-coach-mark-8971
items.description: [Hoverlab] Product-tour callout anchored to a pinging hotspot, with step counter and advance button — the shape a first-run walkthrough actually needs.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-table-skeleton-8983
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three placeholder rows whose sweeps are staggered by a tenth of a second, so the list reads as loading top-down instead of pulsing as one block.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-article-skeleton-9011
items.description: [Hoverlab] Thumbnail, headline and three ragged text lines, sized to the article card it stands in for so nothing jumps when the content lands.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-wipe-entrance-9023
items.description: [Hoverlab] Container revealed by an inset clip while the label lifts on its own curve, so the box and its contents arrive a beat apart.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-card-deal-in-9051
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three tiles hinged from their bottom edge and dealt in on a stagger, with the perspective on the parent so they share one vanishing point.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-double-frame-9063
items.description: [Hoverlab] Outer border with an inset rule that pulls further in on hover, so the frame breathes without the box itself resizing.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-offset-frame-9091
items.description: [Hoverlab] A dashed box over a solid one offset behind it; on hover the two close the gap, so the whole thing reads as pressing down.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-step-progress-bar-9103
items.description: [Hoverlab] Segmented track with nodes at each boundary, the current leg half-filled and its node pulsing — progress and position in one control.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-half-gauge-9131
items.description: [Hoverlab] Semicircular dial built from one conic gradient masked by an inner arc, with the reading in tabular figures so it holds still as it changes.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-caption-slide-9143
items.description: [Hoverlab] Media tile whose caption bar slides up from below the frame on hover while the highlight drifts, marked up as a real figure and figcaption.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-story-ring-avatar-9171
items.description: [Hoverlab] Four-segment ring turning around the avatar while the face counter-rotates at the same rate, so the initials stay upright.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-side-drawer-9183
items.description: [Hoverlab] Panel sliding in over a blurred scrim on a decelerating curve, so it settles rather than stopping dead at the edge.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-lightbox-9211
items.description: [Hoverlab] Gallery overlay with prev/next controls and a thumbnail strip whose active frame is marked with an outline, so selection costs no layout.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-inline-alert-9223
items.description: [Hoverlab] Field-level message that says what is wrong and what to do about it, keyed by a thick left rule so it scans as attached to the input above.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-undo-toast-9251
items.description: [Hoverlab] Confirmation carrying its own reversal, with a timer bar draining by `scaleX` so the countdown animates on the compositor rather than on width.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-faq-accordion-9263
items.description: [Hoverlab] Native `<details>` rows whose plus collapses to a minus by rotating one bar — open state comes from the element, so it works without script.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-counter-tabs-9291
items.description: [Hoverlab] Tab strip carrying per-tab counts, with the underline scaled from zero and the badge recoloring only on the selected tab.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-coverflow-9303
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three panels turned toward a shared vanishing point, the flanking pair dimmed with `brightness` so depth reads without a fog layer.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-folding-panels-9331
items.description: [Hoverlab] Four leaves hinged on their left edge and folded on a stagger, darkening as they turn away so the crease reads without a gradient overlay.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-neon-outline-button-9343
items.description: [Hoverlab] Hollow tube that floods on hover, with the fill cross-faded behind the text so the label never reflows as the state changes.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-neon-level-meter-9371
items.description: [Hoverlab] Six lit bars scaled from their base on a rolling delay, brightening at the bottom of the travel so the glow pumps with the motion.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-isometric-tiling-9383
items.description: [Hoverlab] Four sheared gradients offset by half a tile into an interlocking cube lattice — one element, no SVG, and it tiles seamlessly at any size.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-woven-texture-9411
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two opposed diagonal repeats crossing into a basket weave, drifting against each other so the surface shimmers without any element moving.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-masked-gradient-text-9423
items.description: [Hoverlab] Oversized gradient clipped to the glyphs and slid across them, with a white stop so a highlight travels through the letterforms.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-chevron-flow-9451
items.description: [Hoverlab] Interlocking arrow segments cut with `clip-path`, the first and last squared off so the run reads as a pipeline with real ends.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-ranked-bars-9463
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three-column grid so labels, bars and values line up on their own axes, with widths as inline styles because the lengths are data.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-heat-calendar-9491
items.description: [Hoverlab] Contribution grid filled column-first with `grid-auto-flow`, so weeks run down and the whole thing stays one flat list of cells.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-alternating-timeline-9503
items.description: [Hoverlab] Entries flipping side to side across a centre spine, with each node punched out of the rail by a background-colored ring.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-numbered-stepper-9531
items.description: [Hoverlab] Ordered list where the connector belongs to the step behind it, so a completed leg fills without any element spanning two items.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-expandable-table-9543
items.description: [Hoverlab] Detail row spanning the full width with `colspan`, keyed by an accent rule so the child reads as belonging to the row above it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-pinned-column-table-9571
items.description: [Hoverlab] Row headers frozen with `position: sticky` while the measures scroll, using a box-shadow as the divider so the seam does not scroll away.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-prefixed-field-9583
items.description: [Hoverlab] Immutable prefix and input sharing one bordered wrapper, so the focus ring surrounds the whole control instead of half of it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-consent-row-9611
items.description: [Hoverlab] Whole card is the label, so the entire row is a hit target, with the tick scaled from zero rather than toggled on `display`.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-sticky-buy-bar-9623
items.description: [Hoverlab] Price and action pinned to the top of a scrolling pane with negative margins cancelling the padding, so the blur runs edge to edge.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-scroll-rail-9651
items.description: [Hoverlab] Progress thumb riding a sticky rail beside scrolling copy, hiding the native scrollbar so the rail is the only indicator.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-dual-range-slider-9663
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two handles bounding a filled span, positioned as percentages so the same markup serves any min and max without recomputing pixels.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-dot-carousel-9691
items.description: [Hoverlab] Slides translated as one strip with a pagination row whose active dot stretches into a pill rather than just changing color.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-folder-icon-9703
items.description: [Hoverlab] Folder drawn from one element and two pseudo-elements, the front flap hinged on its bottom edge so it opens in perspective on hover.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-location-pin-9731
items.description: [Hoverlab] Teardrop made from three rounded corners and one square one, floating over a shadow that shrinks as it rises so the lift reads as height.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-save-toggle-9743
items.description: [Hoverlab] Bookmark flag drawn with a clip-path notch, springing up on an overshoot curve as the pill fills — one checkbox, no script.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-star-rating-9771
items.description: [Hoverlab] Row reversed in flex so a plain sibling combinator lights every star to the left of the pointer — the trick that makes hover ratings work in pure CSS.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-light-leak-9783
items.description: [Hoverlab] Blurred band swept across the frame in `color-dodge` with the label in `overlay`, so both react to what passes beneath them.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-saturation-split-9811
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two copies of one surface at different saturations, split by a clip-path handle that slides on hover — a before/after with no second asset.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-provider-button-9823
items.description: [Hoverlab] Full-width sign-in row with a square slot for the provider mark and a chevron that nudges on hover, sized so several stack without ragged edges.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-hold-to-confirm-9851
items.description: [Hoverlab] Destructive action gated behind a press-and-hold fill driven by `:active`, so letting go before the sweep completes cancels it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-upload-loader-9863
items.description: [Hoverlab] File row with a CSS-drawn dog-eared document and a bar that eases as it fills, so the last stretch reads slower the way a real transfer does.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-liquid-loader-9891
items.description: [Hoverlab] An oversized blob with a 42% radius spinning inside a circular clip, which turns a plain rotation into a rolling waterline.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-product-card-9903
items.description: [Hoverlab] Commerce tile with a corner flag, price and rating on one baseline, and a full-width action — the four things a grid card has to carry.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-quote-card-9931
items.description: [Hoverlab] Testimonial with the opening mark hung outside the text block and clipped to a gradient, marked up as a real figure and blockquote.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-marker-highlight-9943
items.description: [Hoverlab] Translucent bar swept behind a real `<mark>`, sitting slightly proud of the baseline so it reads as ink rather than a background box.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-outline-fill-text-9971
items.description: [Hoverlab] Hollow display type with a filled copy in `::after` reading the same string from `data-text`, wiped in on hover so the two never disagree.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-wave-bands-9983
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three oversized near-circles rotating at different rates and directions, which reads as overlapping swells rather than three spinning discs.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-ripple-field-10011
items.description: [Hoverlab] Four rings released a beat apart and eased out, so the pulse is continuous from four elements rather than a long single-ring loop.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-number-stepper-10023
items.description: [Hoverlab] Quantity control with the field flanked by its own increment buttons, in tabular figures so the box does not resize between 9 and 10.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-swatch-picker-10051
items.description: [Hoverlab] Colour choices as real radios with selection drawn by `outline` rather than a border, so picking one costs no layout shift.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-context-menu-10063
items.description: [Hoverlab] Right-click menu with a rule between groups and each item's binding right-aligned, dimmed until the row is hovered so the shortcuts do not compete.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-pagination-10091
items.description: [Hoverlab] Page links with an elided middle and tabular numerals, so widths stay even from page 2 to page 18 and the control never reflows.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-torn-edge-10103
items.description: [Hoverlab] Scalloped seam cut by two offset radial repeats, so the notches interlock into a torn edge rather than a row of even semicircles.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-vertical-divider-10131
items.description: [Hoverlab] Column separator whose label runs with the rule via `writing-mode`, so the text rotates without a transform that would break its box.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-verified-badge-10143
items.description: [Hoverlab] Scalloped seal cut with an eighteen-point `clip-path` and a tick drawn from two borders, so the whole mark is one element and no SVG.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-sale-starburst-10171
items.description: [Hoverlab] Eight-point star made from two rounded squares at 45 degrees to each other — cheaper than a polygon and it keeps soft corners.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-pending-switch-10183
items.description: [Hoverlab] Toggle whose knob carries a spinner once flipped, for settings that persist over the network and are not actually on until the server says so.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-option-tile-10211
items.description: [Hoverlab] Plan picker where the whole card is the label and the radio dot scales in on an overshoot, so the selection has weight without a layout change.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-directional-tooltips-10223
items.description: [Hoverlab] Top and bottom variants sharing one rule set, each arrow tinted to the gradient stop nearest it so the tail never mismatches the bubble.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-confirm-popover-10251
items.description: [Hoverlab] Inline confirmation with cancel and proceed, opening on focus as well as hover so a keyboard user can reach the buttons inside it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-chart-skeleton-10263
items.description: [Hoverlab] Placeholder shaped like the chart it stands in for — title, ragged bars and an axis — so the panel does not resize when real data arrives.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-profile-skeleton-10291
items.description: [Hoverlab] Cover, overlapping avatar, name lines and a stat row, staggered top-down so the header reads as filling in rather than flashing at once.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-elastic-drop-10303
items.description: [Hoverlab] Squash-and-stretch entrance with a shadow that widens on impact, which is what sells the landing more than the bounce itself.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-character-stagger-10331
items.description: [Hoverlab] Letters wrapped individually and released seventy milliseconds apart, each rotating slightly so the line assembles rather than sliding as a block.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-beaded-frame-10343
items.description: [Hoverlab] Four repeating gradients as edges rather than a dashed border, which is the only way to animate the dashes travelling around the box.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-corner-keyline-10371
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two opposing corner brackets that grow to meet as a full frame on hover, so the border draws itself from both ends at once.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-battery-meter-10383
items.description: [Hoverlab] Charge indicator with the terminal nub drawn as a pseudo-element, so the cell body stays a clean box for the fill to sit inside.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-activity-rings-10411
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three nested conic dials each masked to a band, so one element per metric shows three independent values without any overlap maths.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-polaroid-frame-10423
items.description: [Hoverlab] Instant-photo mount tilted off-axis that straightens and develops on hover, the caption in monospace on the wide bottom margin.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-avatar-group-10451
items.description: [Hoverlab] Overlapped stack with a counted overflow chip, each face lifting out of the pile on hover with a background-colored ring keeping the seams clean.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-menu-curtain-10463
items.description: [Hoverlab] Full-bleed navigation whose links rise on a stagger, with the siblings dimming on hover so the pointed-at item is the only bright one.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-alert-dialog-10491
items.description: [Hoverlab] Centred confirmation led by a ringed icon, with the dismissive action styled quieter than the one you actually want pressed.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-transfer-toast-10503
items.description: [Hoverlab] Background-job notice carrying a spinner, a bar and a numeric read-out, so the same toast covers both indeterminate and measured phases.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-consent-bar-10531
items.description: [Hoverlab] Cookie notice giving both choices equal size, since a decline styled as an afterthought is the pattern regulators actually object to.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-tree-disclosure-10543
items.description: [Hoverlab] Nested `<details>` forming a file tree, with indentation from the nesting itself so any depth works without new rules.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-card-tabs-10571
items.description: [Hoverlab] Radio-driven tabs whose panels are stacked in one grid cell, so the container height is the tallest panel and switching never jumps.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-carousel-ring-10583
items.description: [Hoverlab] Six panels pushed out along Z at sixty-degree intervals and turned as one group, which is the whole trick behind a 3D carousel.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-parallax-scene-10611
items.description: [Hoverlab] Four layers shifted by different amounts on hover, blur increasing with distance so the depth cue is optical rather than just positional.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-neon-arrow-sign-10623
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three chevrons lighting in sequence beside a glowing label, the arrows drawn from two borders so each is a single element.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-neon-horizon-10651
items.description: [Hoverlab] Retro grid receding under a glowing sun, scrolled by exactly one cell so the loop is seamless and the lines appear to run forever.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-honeycomb-10663
items.description: [Hoverlab] Hexagonal lattice from two offset radial gradients and a rule — a tiling CSS cannot draw directly, faked with half-cell offsets.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-circuit-traces-10691
items.description: [Hoverlab] Orthogonal tracks with solder pads at the junctions, on two grid scales so the vias land between the crossings rather than on them.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-wavy-edge-10703
items.description: [Hoverlab] Section whose bottom is scalloped by a repeating radial mask, so the wave is cut out of the element rather than covered by a shape on top.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-iris-reveal-10731
items.description: [Hoverlab] Cover layer collapsed to a zero-radius circle on hover, revealing the surface beneath from the centre out with no opacity crossfade.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-stacked-area-10743
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two series cut from gradients with `clip-path` over repeating gridlines, so the plot needs no SVG path and still has real axis labels.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-conversion-funnel-10771
items.description: [Hoverlab] Stage bars narrowing by percentage width with the count inside each, so the drop-off is legible without reading a single number.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-activity-feed-10783
items.description: [Hoverlab] Event stream with avatars punched out of a connecting spine, refs set in monospace so an identifier never reads as prose.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-gantt-bars-10811
items.description: [Hoverlab] Schedule rows offset by margin and sized by width, over a gridline background positioned to start where the track does.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-selectable-table-10823
items.description: [Hoverlab] Row selection with a bulk-action bar that replaces the header, and selected rows tinted so the count and the rows agree at a glance.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-comparison-matrix-10851
items.description: [Hoverlab] Plan matrix with the recommended column tinted top to bottom, and ticks and crosses drawn from borders rather than glyphs that vary by font.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-counted-textarea-10863
items.description: [Hoverlab] Field and its meta bar joined into one control by removing the shared border, both taking the focus color so they light as a unit.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-inline-edit-field-10891
items.description: [Hoverlab] Value that reads as text until hovered, when a border and a pencil appear — the settings pattern that avoids a separate edit mode.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-back-to-top-10903
items.description: [Hoverlab] Floating return control pinned with `position: sticky` inside the scroller, so it needs no fixed positioning and no scroll listener.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-snap-gallery-10931
items.description: [Hoverlab] Horizontal rail with `scroll-snap-align: center`, so tiles settle centred rather than flush left and the row never stops half-way.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-notched-slider-10943
items.description: [Hoverlab] Discrete tier picker with the stops cut into the track by a repeating gradient, so the notches are part of the rail and cannot drift out of line.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-filmstrip-10971
items.description: [Hoverlab] Thumbnail row flanked by step controls, the active frame marked with an outline so selection costs no width and the strip never shifts.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-search-morph-10983
items.description: [Hoverlab] Magnifier whose ring flattens into a bar and whose handle counter-rotates, turning the glass into a cross without swapping any element.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-rain-cloud-11011
items.description: [Hoverlab] Cloud built from a pill and two circles inheriting its gradient, with three drops falling on a stagger so the rain never syncs into a row.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-vote-pair-11023
items.description: [Hoverlab] Up and down controls sharing one arrow drawn from a block and a triangle, the down variant just the same shape rotated.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-reaction-bar-11051
items.description: [Hoverlab] Count chips that lift on hover with the one you have picked tinted and outlined, plus an add control drawn as two crossed bars.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-chromatic-text-11063
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two coloured copies drifting apart in `screen` blend, so the fringes brighten where they overlap the way a real lens split does.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-film-vignette-11091
items.description: [Hoverlab] Stacked grade, overlay grain and a radial vignette, the grain stepped in three frames so it stutters like emulsion rather than sliding.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-speed-dial-11103
items.description: [Hoverlab] Floating action whose plus rotates into a cross while three satellites fan out along a quarter arc, each on its own translate.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-icon-toolbar-11131
items.description: [Hoverlab] Formatting cluster with a hairline separating groups, the alignment glyphs drawn from three background gradients rather than an icon font.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-typing-indicator-11143
items.description: [Hoverlab] Chat bubble with a clipped tail and three dots bobbing on a rolling delay, resting for most of the cycle so it does not read as frantic.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-build-log-11171
items.description: [Hoverlab] Pipeline steps in monospace with completed ticks, one spinner on the running line, and pending steps dimmed rather than hidden.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-event-card-11183
items.description: [Hoverlab] Listing led by a tear-off date block in a real `<time>`, so the day and month are one semantic unit rather than two decorated spans.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-notification-card-11211
items.description: [Hoverlab] Inbox rows where unread state is carried by a left rail, a faint tint and a dot at once, so it survives being skimmed at any zoom.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-kinetic-letters-11223
items.description: [Hoverlab] Characters riding one sine on a fixed phase offset, so the word ripples continuously instead of bouncing as a block.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-redacted-text-11251
items.description: [Hoverlab] Classified bars that wipe away from the right on hover, the words underneath present in the DOM the whole time so they stay selectable and searchable.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-bokeh-field-11263
items.description: [Hoverlab] Out-of-focus orbs on one keyframe with negative delays, so the six start mid-cycle and the field is already in motion on first paint.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-crt-static-11291
items.description: [Hoverlab] Phosphor tint under hard scanlines with a soft band rolling through, the three layers separate so each can be tuned without touching the others.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-amount-field-11303
items.description: [Hoverlab] Currency input with a fixed symbol and a unit picker sharing the box, the figure in tabular numerals so the caret does not shift as digits change.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-scoped-search-11331
items.description: [Hoverlab] Search bar with a leading scope menu and a trailing key hint, all three sharing one focus ring so the control reads as a single field.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-app-bar-11343
items.description: [Hoverlab] Compact product header carrying mark, search, links and account in one blurred row, the search flexing so the ends stay pinned at any width.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-wizard-header-11371
items.description: [Hoverlab] Segmented flow header where each step's arrow is a rotated square inheriting its own background, so the notch always matches the segment behind it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-badged-divider-11383
items.description: [Hoverlab] Section rule broken by a ringed medallion, the inner diamond rotated so the ornament reads as deliberate rather than as a dot.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-slant-transition-11411
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two bands with mirrored diagonal cuts meeting on one line, so the seam between sections is an angle rather than a horizontal rule.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-level-badge-11423
items.description: [Hoverlab] Rank chip whose ring is a conic gradient showing progress to the next tier, with the raw figures underneath in tabular numerals.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-category-pills-11451
items.description: [Hoverlab] Taxonomy links keyed by a colour dot rather than a filled background, so a row of them stays readable instead of turning into a paint chart.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-glyph-switch-11463
items.description: [Hoverlab] Track carrying a tick and a cross drawn from borders, cross-faded so state is legible without relying on colour alone.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-checkbox-list-11491
items.description: [Hoverlab] Grouped options under a select-all whose indeterminate state is a bar rather than a tick, the one case a checkbox has three readings.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-crosshair-readout-11503
items.description: [Hoverlab] Chart hover state as one unit — dashed guide, marker dot and a value card pinned above the same x position, so the three never drift apart.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-reaction-picker-11531
items.description: [Hoverlab] Tray that floats above its trigger on hover or focus, each option popping on an overshoot so the row feels physical rather than a menu.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-gallery-skeleton-11543
items.description: [Hoverlab] Mixed-span grid placeholder, the wide cells breaking the rhythm so the loading state reads as a real masonry rather than a uniform block.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-thread-skeleton-11571
items.description: [Hoverlab] Comment placeholders with a nested reply indented behind a rule, so the shape of the conversation is visible before any text arrives.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-unfold-expand-11583
items.description: [Hoverlab] Height animated with `grid-template-rows` from 0fr to 1fr — the one technique that transitions to intrinsic height without a hardcoded max-height.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-blind-reveal-11611
items.description: [Hoverlab] Six slats collapsing on a stagger from their top edge, so the surface behind is uncovered in bands rather than by a single wipe.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-underline-keyline-11623
items.description: [Hoverlab] Rule that draws left-to-right on enter and retracts to the right on leave, by flipping `transform-origin` between the two states.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-inset-glow-ring-11651
items.description: [Hoverlab] Selection state built entirely from stacked box-shadows — hairline, inner bloom and outer halo — so nothing about the element's size changes.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-thermometer-meter-11663
items.description: [Hoverlab] Vertical gauge with a scale beside it, the column anchored to the bottom so it fills upward the way a reading actually behaves.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-skill-bars-11691
items.description: [Hoverlab] Labelled proficiency rows on a two-column grid so the name and the figure sit on one line with the track spanning both beneath.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-action-overlay-11703
items.description: [Hoverlab] Media tile whose controls rise into a dimmed frame on a stagger, using `transition-delay` so the sequence costs no keyframes.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-image-collage-11731
items.description: [Hoverlab] Asymmetric three-up where the hero spans both rows, each tile lifting independently so the grid never reflows on hover.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-corner-promo-11743
items.description: [Hoverlab] Non-blocking announcement that slides up from the corner with its own dismiss, the pattern for news that does not deserve a modal.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-loading-veil-11771
items.description: [Hoverlab] Blocking overlay scoped to one panel rather than the page, blurring the content behind so it is clearly still there but not interactive.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-success-toast-11783
items.description: [Hoverlab] Confirmation whose tick springs in from its own corner on an overshoot, so the mark lands rather than simply appearing.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-connection-bar-11811
items.description: [Hoverlab] Persistent network notice with a pinging indicator and a manual retry, sized as a bar rather than a toast because it does not auto-dismiss.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-icon-accordion-11823
items.description: [Hoverlab] Separated disclosure cards where the icon brightens and the chevron flips on open, both keyed off `[open]` rather than a toggled class.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-scrollable-tabs-11851
items.description: [Hoverlab] Overflowing tab strip with gradient masks at both ends, so a cut-off label reads as scrollable rather than as a rendering fault.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-page-turn-11863
items.description: [Hoverlab] Leaf hinged on the spine and swept through 180 degrees, darkening as it passes edge-on so the sheet reads as having two sides.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-spinning-pyramid-11891
items.description: [Hoverlab] Four CSS triangles hinged at a shared base and splayed by quarter turns, tilted so the solid closes rather than reading as loose fins.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-ecg-trace-11903
items.description: [Hoverlab] Heartbeat line cut from a clip-path polygon and scaled vertically, with a sweeping gain band passing over it like a monitor refresh.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-halo-pill-11931
items.description: [Hoverlab] Status chip sitting over a blurred copy of itself, the halo breathing on the same cycle as the dot so the two read as one pulse.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-argyle-lattice-11943
items.description: [Hoverlab] Offset diamond blocks crossed by two thin repeating diagonals, which is what separates argyle from a plain checkerboard on the bias.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-terrazzo-11971
items.description: [Hoverlab] Seven elliptical chips at irregular positions inside one tile, sized differently so the repeat is much harder to spot than a regular grid.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-arch-window-11983
items.description: [Hoverlab] Rounded arch cut with asymmetric border-radius rather than a clip-path, so the inner keyline can follow the same curve at an inset.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-diagonal-split-12011
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two panels cut on complementary diagonals with a deliberate gap between them, the labels nudged off-centre so neither straddles the seam.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-candlestick-chart-12023
items.description: [Hoverlab] OHLC bars where each candle's wick and body come from custom properties on the element, so the data lives in the markup and the CSS stays one rule.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-donut-row-12051
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three small multiples sharing one scale, so utilisation across resources is comparable at a glance rather than three separate readings.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-milestone-track-12063
items.description: [Hoverlab] Roadmap where the current stage fills only half its connector, so "in progress" is visible on the rail rather than only in the node styling.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-release-list-12091
items.description: [Hoverlab] Changelog entries with the version as a monospace tag, the latest highlighted so "what shipped most recently" is answerable without reading dates.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-sparkline-table-12103
items.description: [Hoverlab] Trend column drawn inline per row, so direction and current value sit on the same line instead of in a chart somewhere else on the page.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-empty-table-12131
items.description: [Hoverlab] Zero-row state that keeps the header so the columns still teach what will appear, with one action rather than a bare "no data" line.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-multi-combobox-12143
items.description: [Hoverlab] Chips, a typeahead and an option list in one control, the menu opening on `:focus-within` so it survives tabbing into the field.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-date-range-12171
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two dates joined by an en-dash inside one focus ring, with quick presets underneath because most range picks are a common span, not an arbitrary one.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-sticky-contents-12183
items.description: [Hoverlab] Document outline pinned beside scrolling body copy, the active entry marked by a coloured left rule so the position reads without a filled background.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-reading-bar-12211
items.description: [Hoverlab] Progress rail stuck to the top of its own scroller, scaled rather than resized so the indicator animates without triggering layout.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-vertical-slider-12223
items.description: [Hoverlab] Level control filling upward with the handle anchored to the fill's top edge, so value and thumb cannot drift apart at any height.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-auto-testimonials-12251
items.description: [Hoverlab] Quotes cross-fading on a shared twelve-second cycle with progress bars filling in lockstep, so the indicator is the timer rather than a separate loop.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-trophy-icon-12263
items.description: [Hoverlab] Cup, stem and plinth as three elements with the handles as mirrored pseudo-elements, so the whole award is drawn without an image.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-security-shield-12291
items.description: [Hoverlab] Shield outline made by clipping a filled shape and an inset dark copy to the same polygon, with a padlock drawn from two children.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-drag-handle-12303
items.description: [Hoverlab] Sortable row whose dotted grip lights on hover and tilts fractionally while held, the cursor switching from grab to grabbing to confirm the state.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-swipe-actions-12331
items.description: [Hoverlab] List row sliding aside to expose the actions parked behind it, the destructive option furthest out so it takes the longest travel to reach.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-halftone-screen-12343
items.description: [Hoverlab] Repeating dot mask over a gradient, the cell size growing on hover so the screen coarsens the way a print separation would.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-thermal-map-12371
items.description: [Hoverlab] False-colour heat field from stacked radial gradients under an overlay scanline grid, with a monospace readout for the instrument look.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-perspective-floor-12383
items.description: [Hoverlab] Ground plane laid flat under an 78-degree rotateX so the grid converges on a horizon, with the background position scrolling one cell per cycle to read as forward travel.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-prism-drum-12411
items.description: [Hoverlab] Four labelled faces mounted around a shared axis at a quarter turn each, the drum rotating one detent on hover so the next word rolls up into place.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-facet-filters-12423
items.description: [Hoverlab] Stacked filter groups on native details elements, each summary carrying its active count and each row its result tally so the panel reads before it is opened.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-tab-overflow-12451
items.description: [Hoverlab] Tab strip that stops at the width it has and parks the remainder behind a counted overflow button, the popover anchored to its top-right corner.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-detail-alert-12463
items.description: [Hoverlab] Failure banner that keeps the stack trace folded behind a disclosure, so the summary stays one line and the detail is one click away rather than a separate screen.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-permission-prompt-12491
items.description: [Hoverlab] Consent bar in the shape a browser uses for it — origin under the ask, block and allow weighted differently, the whole thing sized to sit under an address bar.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-progressive-load-12503
items.description: [Hoverlab] Blurred low-resolution stand-in sitting under the full image, the sharp layer fading over it and the status pill dropping out once there is nothing left to wait for.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-upload-ring-12531
items.description: [Hoverlab] Profile photo wrapped in a conic progress ring that fills as the upload lands, with a camera affordance notched out of the lower-right corner.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-cellular-field-12543
items.description: [Hoverlab] Six overlapping radial cells at fixed seed positions, each drifting on its own vector so the field reorganises without any single blob reading as the subject.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-rain-streaks-12571
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three repeating-gradient sheets falling at different rates and densities, the parallax between them doing the work that individual raindrop elements would otherwise cost.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-delta-chip-12583
items.description: [Hoverlab] Percentage-change pill with a border-drawn caret, tabular figures so a column of them stays aligned, and a tinted fill derived from the same hue as the arrow.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-priority-pennant-12611
items.description: [Hoverlab] Swallow-tail flag cut from a single clip-path, the notch shallowing on hover so the tag squares off as it is picked out of a list.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-notched-legend-12623
items.description: [Hoverlab] Fieldset-style frame where the label sits in a gap punched through the stroke, the notch made by matching the label background to the surface rather than by clipping.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-segmented-ring-12651
items.description: [Hoverlab] Dashed arc border built from a conic gradient rather than dash properties, masked to a hairline so the segments can carry three colours and still rotate as one piece.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-slide-to-unlock-12663
items.description: [Hoverlab] Drag-track confirmation where the knob travels the full width and a tinted fill follows it, the prompt fading out once the gesture is past the point of being accidental.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-download-progress-12691
items.description: [Hoverlab] One control carrying three states in sequence — label, determinate bar, then a checkmark — so the transfer never leaves the place the user clicked to start it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-progress-card-12703
items.description: [Hoverlab] Course-style tile that leads with how much is left rather than what it is, the meter animating to its real position once so a reduced-motion reader still sees 44 percent.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-empty-state-card-12731
items.description: [Hoverlab] Placeholder panel with a dashed edge that reads as a slot waiting to be filled, the plus glyph tilting on hover so the whole card behaves like one target.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-radar-chart-12743
items.description: [Hoverlab] Six-axis spider plot where the web is one repeating-radial and one conic gradient, and the series is a single clip-path polygon that scales up from the centre as it plots.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-waterfall-chart-12771
items.description: [Hoverlab] Bridge from one period total to the next, each floating bar offset by the running balance beneath it and connected by dashed leader lines so the arithmetic is visible.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-zigzag-divider-12783
items.description: [Hoverlab] Sawtooth rule cut with a repeating conic mask rather than drawn as triangles, so the tooth pitch is one background-size value and widens on hover.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-ornament-divider-12811
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three lozenges at the centre of a pair of rules that taper into the surface, the middle one turning half a revolution on hover while the flankers hold still.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-line-rise-12823
items.description: [Hoverlab] Each line pushed up out of its own overflow-hidden track on a short stagger, which reads as type setting itself rather than as three blocks sliding in.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-counter-roll-12851
items.description: [Hoverlab] Odometer entrance built from three digit columns behind fixed windows, each travelling a different distance and settling at a different moment so it lands like a mechanism.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-posterize-bands-12863
items.description: [Hoverlab] Continuous gradient quantized into three tone steps by a multiplying repeating-gradient, the banding backing off on hover to show what was thrown away.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-x-ray-sweep-12891
items.description: [Hoverlab] Inverting backdrop-filter revealed by an animated inset clip, with a lit scan edge riding the boundary so the wipe reads as an instrument passing over the plate.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-card-number-field-12903
items.description: [Hoverlab] Payment entry as one joined control — number above, expiry and CVC sharing the row below — with the detected brand mark sitting inside the field it applies to.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-field-array-12931
items.description: [Hoverlab] Repeatable row group where every entry carries its own remove control and the add affordance is dashed, marking it as the one row that is not yet data.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-plasma-globe-12943
items.description: [Hoverlab] Filaments pinned to a pulsing core and swept through short arcs on mismatched cycles, each skewed as it travels so the discharge never looks like a rotating spoke.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-bulb-marquee-12971
items.description: [Hoverlab] Theatre sign whose bulbs are four repeat-axis radial gradients, stepped rather than eased so the chase clicks from lamp to lamp instead of sliding.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-ringing-bell-12983
items.description: [Hoverlab] Bell drawn from one rounded block plus a crown and a lip, pivoting at the mount while the clapper runs a second, later-peaking keyframe so the two do not move as one body.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-sync-arrows-13011
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two gapped arcs cut from one conic gradient with border-drawn heads at each opening, the whole glyph spinning on an ease that speeds through the middle of each turn.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-mention-autocomplete-13023
items.description: [Hoverlab] Composer that switches to name-matching the moment an at-sign is typed, the partial token tinted in place and the handle right-aligned so the list scans as one column.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-password-reveal-13051
items.description: [Hoverlab] Masked field whose eye control drops its strike-through by scaling the bar to nothing from the centre, so the icon changes meaning without a second glyph swapping in.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-infinity-loader-13063
items.description: [Hoverlab] Single dot traced around a lemniscate in eight keyframe stations, crossing at the waist so the two lobes read as one continuous circuit rather than two orbits.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-folding-cube-13091
items.description: [Hoverlab] Four quadrants hinged at the shared centre corner, each folding in on X and out on Y a beat after the last so the square appears to turn itself inside out.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-squircle-frame-13103
items.description: [Hoverlab] Superellipse approximated with a 28-point clip-path, which holds its continuous curvature under scale in a way a border-radius corner visibly does not.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-conic-sweep-mask-13131
items.description: [Hoverlab] Radar-style wipe driven by an animated @property angle inside the mask itself, so the reveal follows a rotating wedge rather than a straight edge crossing the box.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-add-to-cart-flight-13143
items.description: [Hoverlab] Ghost of the item arcing from the button to the basket and shrinking as it goes, the count bumping only once the flight lands so cause and effect stay in order.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-task-strike-13171
items.description: [Hoverlab] Checkbox and label treated as one gesture — the tick springs in, the rule draws left to right, and the text dims last so the sequence reads as completion rather than deletion.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-fullscreen-takeover-13183
items.description: [Hoverlab] Dialog that grows from the footprint of the control that opened it to the whole viewport, its chrome fading in only after the box has finished travelling.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-sheet-stack-13211
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three bottom sheets pushed one behind the other, each narrower and dimmer than the one in front, so depth in the navigation stack is legible without a back label.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-locale-switcher-13223
items.description: [Hoverlab] Language menu listing each option in its own script rather than in the current one, with the ISO code trailing so the list stays scannable to someone who cannot read the endonym.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-footer-sitemap-13251
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three-column link map under a gradient border-image rule, each link underlining from its leading edge so the columns stay quiet until something is pointed at.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-scale-fan-13263
items.description: [Hoverlab] Interlocking arcs from two offset radial layers, the half-cell stagger doing the overlap that makes a scale pattern read as roofing rather than as rows of circles.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-herringbone-13291
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two mirrored diagonal stripe fields butted at the centre line, which is the whole trick — herringbone is one hatch and its reflection sharing a seam.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-countdown-ring-13303
items.description: [Hoverlab] Timer that empties rather than fills, the sweep animated through a registered angle property so the arc interpolates smoothly instead of snapping between conic stops.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-signal-bars-13331
items.description: [Hoverlab] Five-step strength meter that lights bottom-up on a stagger and leaves the tallest bar dark, which is what four-of-five actually looks like on a device.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-scroll-sentinel-13343
items.description: [Hoverlab] List whose last child is a loading marker rather than a button, positioned so it enters the viewport a little before the content runs out and the next page can be fetched.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-pull-to-refresh-13371
items.description: [Hoverlab] Content sheet dragged down past its own top edge to expose a spinner parked behind it, the indicator scaling up from the gap rather than being pushed along by the sheet.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-form-skeleton-13383
items.description: [Hoverlab] Placeholder shaped to the form it precedes — short label blocks over taller field blocks, a split row, and a submit bar carrying a warmer sweep than the fields above it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-kanban-skeleton-13411
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three-column board placeholder with uneven card heights and a per-column sweep delay, so the loading state carries the same ragged rhythm the real board will.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-crossfade-slideshow-13423
items.description: [Hoverlab] Slides stacked in place and dissolved between rather than translated, which keeps a full-bleed image from ever showing an edge, with the active dot stretching to a pill.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-histogram-range-13451
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two-handle range sitting under a distribution of the values it filters, bars inside the selection lit and the rest left grey so the user can see where the results actually are.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-grouped-rows-13463
items.description: [Hoverlab] Collapsible group headers carrying their own subtotal, tinted across the row so a header never gets mistaken for data, with children indented under a disclosure caret.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-inline-edit-grid-13491
items.description: [Hoverlab] Spreadsheet-style cells that outline under the pointer and drop into an editing state in place, so committing a value never costs a dialog or a round trip to a detail page.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-variable-weight-13503
items.description: [Hoverlab] Letters travelling from light to heavy on a per-character delay, picking up a vertical gradient as they thicken so the wave of weight is also a wave of colour.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-scramble-decode-13531
items.description: [Hoverlab] Each slot holds a junk glyph and its real character stacked, swapping on a stepped keyframe left to right so the line resolves the way a cipher does rather than typing out.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-commit-graph-13543
items.description: [Hoverlab] Branch-and-merge history drawn with positioned gradient segments instead of SVG, so the fork stub, the parallel lane and the merge elbow are each one background layer.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-day-agenda-13571
items.description: [Hoverlab] Hour rail with events sitting in the slots they occupy and an empty hour left visibly empty, the current-time rule crossing the whole column with a dot on the gutter.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-indeterminate-parent-13583
items.description: [Hoverlab] Parent control in the mixed state its children actually put it in — the tick collapsed to a dash rather than swapped for a different glyph — with the tally spelled out beside it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-power-button-13611
items.description: [Hoverlab] IEC power glyph as the control itself, the broken ring and its stem lighting together and the housing picking up an ambient glow so the off state is unmistakably dead.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-glossary-popover-13623
items.description: [Hoverlab] Dotted term in running text that opens a definition card rather than a one-line tip, with the headword repeated and a category line so it reads as an entry, not a hint.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-calendar-popover-13651
items.description: [Hoverlab] Date field opening a month grid anchored beneath it, leading days from the previous month dimmed rather than blank so the week rows stay aligned to their columns.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-book-cover-13663
items.description: [Hoverlab] Hardcover hinged at the spine rather than the page edge, so it swings past 90 degrees and lies back against itself the way a real cover does.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-wireframe-globe-13691
items.description: [Hoverlab] Five circles sharing a centre at even yaw offsets, which reads as a meridian cage once the whole group rotates — no sphere primitive required.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-changelog-accordion-13703
items.description: [Hoverlab] Release entries folded by version, each summary carrying its own change-type tag and ship date so the history is readable without opening a single panel.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-sliding-panels-13731
items.description: [Hoverlab] Panels laid end to end on one track that translates by a third per tab, so switching moves horizontally instead of cross-fading in place.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-mention-toast-13743
items.description: [Hoverlab] Social notification carrying who, what they said and two ways to respond, sized so the quoted line can wrap without pushing the actions off the card.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-consent-panel-13771
items.description: [Hoverlab] Per-category cookie controls rather than one accept button, with the essential row switched on and visibly locked so the choice that is not a choice reads as such.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-photo-fan-13783
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three prints squared up as one pile that spread from a shared bottom pivot, so the fan opens like a hand of cards rather than sliding apart in parallel.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-broken-image-13811
items.description: [Hoverlab] The state every gallery eventually shows and few designs draw — a torn picture glyph over a hatched field, with the filename kept so the failure is diagnosable.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-constellation-net-13823
items.description: [Hoverlab] Node field and its link mesh built as two gradient layers on matching cell sizes and moved together, so the dots stay on the lines without a single positioned element.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-sunburst-rays-13851
items.description: [Hoverlab] Repeating conic wedges anchored below the frame so only the upper fan is visible, turning slowly under a radial haze that keeps the hub from reading as a hard point.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-split-badge-13863
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two-cell status badge with a neutral key against a coloured value, the pairing that makes a wall of these scannable down the value column alone.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-price-tag-13891
items.description: [Hoverlab] Retail swing-ticket silhouette — pointed left end cut by clip-path with a punched eyelet — tilting on hover as though hanging from the hole.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-sketch-frame-13903
items.description: [Hoverlab] Wobbly ink frame from asymmetric elliptical border-radii doubled at an offset, the two strokes disagreeing just enough to read as drawn rather than computed.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-folder-tab-13931
items.description: [Hoverlab] Manila-folder outline where the tab's bottom stroke is painted out to join the panel, so the two shapes share one continuous border instead of stacking.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-gooey-button-13943
items.description: [Hoverlab] Metaball effect from blur plus extreme contrast on a shared layer, so the two satellites stretch a liquid neck as they separate instead of simply moving apart.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-keycap-button-13971
items.description: [Hoverlab] Physical key with its travel in the shadow rather than the transform — the stem shortens as the cap descends, so the press bottoms out instead of sliding.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-weather-card-13983
items.description: [Hoverlab] Current conditions weighted large over a four-day strip, the whole panel tinted by the same hue as the sun mark so the card reads as one sky rather than a chart.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-now-playing-14011
items.description: [Hoverlab] Player row where the level meter runs on negative animation delays, so the twelve bars start mid-cycle and never line up into a visible wave.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-bullet-chart-14023
items.description: [Hoverlab] Stephen Few's replacement for the gauge — a measure bar over banded qualitative ranges with a target tick, carrying in one row what a dial needs a whole tile for.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-treemap-14051
items.description: [Hoverlab] Share-of-total as nested area rather than length, sized with fractional grid tracks so the proportions are declared once and the tiles re-solve at any width.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-wave-divider-14063
items.description: [Hoverlab] Sine edge assembled from two alternating circle masks rather than an SVG path, the pair scrolling one full period so the crests travel without the band moving.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-stitch-divider-14091
items.description: [Hoverlab] Saddle-stitch seam: a dashed rule offset by a coloured drop-shadow so each stitch appears to sit proud of the surface, shifting half a stitch on hover.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-grid-pop-14103
items.description: [Hoverlab] Tiles keyed off row plus column rather than index, so the entrance sweeps diagonally from the top-left corner instead of running along each row in turn.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-border-draw-in-14131
items.description: [Hoverlab] Four edges scaling in sequence from the corner the previous one finished at, so a single stroke appears to travel the perimeter before the label arrives.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-emboss-relief-14143
items.description: [Hoverlab] Letterforms pressed into the surface by one dark and one light offset shadow, the pair swapping sides on hover so the relief flips from debossed to raised.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-solarize-14171
items.description: [Hoverlab] Sabattier effect from an inverted copy composited with lighten, which flips only the tones the original leaves dark — the partial reversal a full invert cannot give.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-phone-field-14183
items.description: [Hoverlab] Dial code chosen inside the field it prefixes rather than in a separate control, with the valid state marked at the trailing edge where the eye finishes the line.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-signature-pad-14211
items.description: [Hoverlab] Signing surface with a dashed baseline and cross mark, the stroke revealed left to right by an animated inset clip so it draws rather than fades in.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-lightning-strike-14223
items.description: [Hoverlab] Jagged bolt cut by clip-path and lit by stacked drop-shadows, driven on stepped keyframes so the discharge snaps between states the way a real strike does.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-light-cone-14251
items.description: [Hoverlab] Volumetric beam as a blurred trapezoid between an emitter and the ellipse it lands on, all three flickering together so the shaft and its pool stay tied.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-rotating-cog-14263
items.description: [Hoverlab] Gear teeth as alternating conic stops with the disc centre masked away, the hub ring masked the opposite way — two elements, no path data, twelve teeth.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-wifi-arcs-14291
items.description: [Hoverlab] Three nested rings showing only their top border and rotated 45 degrees, which turns a circle into the quarter-arc the signal glyph is actually made of.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-date-mask-field-14303
items.description: [Hoverlab] Fixed day/month/year segments that take focus one at a time and auto-advance, so the separators are chrome the user never has to type.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-slug-preview-14331
items.description: [Hoverlab] Title field with the URL it will produce rendered underneath, domain greyed and slug highlighted, so the transformation is visible before anything is saved.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-newton-s-cradle-14343
items.description: [Hoverlab] Five pendulums where only the end pair moves and the middle three stay dead still, which is the whole illusion — momentum appears to pass through them.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-hourglass-14371
items.description: [Hoverlab] Upper cone draining and lower cone filling on matched clip-path keyframes, the whole body turning over only once the sand has run through.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-knockout-panel-14383
items.description: [Hoverlab] Solid panel multiplied over a moving field so white letterforms punch straight through to it — the type is a hole, not a fill, and the colour behind keeps drifting.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-star-tile-14411
items.description: [Hoverlab] Ten-point clip-path polygon over a conic fill, so the highlight sweeps around the points as the shape turns rather than rotating with them.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-drag-reorder-14423
items.description: [Hoverlab] Row lifting off the stack with a slight tilt while a dashed gap opens where it will land, so the drop target is shown rather than guessed at.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-confetti-burst-14451
items.description: [Hoverlab] Six scraps thrown on individually authored arcs with mismatched durations and spins, because a burst where every piece shares a curve reads as a fan.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-paywall-gate-14463
items.description: [Hoverlab] Content fading under a gradient rather than cut off at a hard line, so the reader can see there is more without being able to read it — the fade is the argument.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-video-modal-14491
items.description: [Hoverlab] Lightbox carrying real player chrome — scrubber, elapsed over total — under a blurred scrim, so the dialog reads as a player rather than a framed image.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-sidebar-groups-14503
items.description: [Hoverlab] Nav split by labelled section with the active row marked by a rail bleeding past the panel padding, so the indicator belongs to the sidebar rather than the item.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-centre-action-bar-14531
items.description: [Hoverlab] Mobile tab bar whose primary action sits raised in the middle, punched out of the bar by a ring shadow in the bar's own colour rather than by a real cut-out.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-brick-bond-14543
items.description: [Hoverlab] Running bond where the half-course offset comes from a second layer at double the cell size, so the staggered joints fall out of the geometry rather than being drawn.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-triangle-tessellation-14571
items.description: [Hoverlab] Equilateral tiling from four 60-degree gradient layers on a half-cell offset, the 59px row height being what keeps the triangles equilateral rather than merely pointy.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-needle-dial-14583
items.description: [Hoverlab] Analogue gauge whose needle overshoots its reading and settles back, the small correction being what separates an instrument from a bar drawn in a circle.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-completion-checklist-14611
items.description: [Hoverlab] Onboarding meter that shows the remaining work as items rather than a percentage, the bar and the count agreeing so neither has to be trusted alone.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-condensing-header-14623
items.description: [Hoverlab] Masthead that gives back two thirds of its height as the page moves under it — logo, wordmark and nav each shedding at their own rate rather than scaling as a block.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-scroll-shadows-14651
items.description: [Hoverlab] Overflow cue as a tinted shadow at whichever edge still has content past it, which survives a patterned backdrop where a fade-to-transparent mask would not.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-map-skeleton-14663
items.description: [Hoverlab] Loading state for a map view — tile grid, two roads at an angle and pulsing pin stubs — with the result card below carrying the usual sweep.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-video-skeleton-14691
items.description: [Hoverlab] Placeholder holding a 16:9 stage with an inert play glyph over a scrubber and two metadata lines, so the layout does not shift when the real player mounts.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-swipe-deck-14703
items.description: [Hoverlab] Card thrown off to one side with rotation tied to its travel while the stack behind promotes itself a step, each layer taking the transform the one above just left.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-dial-slider-14731
items.description: [Hoverlab] Thermostat-style control where the handle is positioned by rotate-translate-counterrotate, so it rides the arc without the knob itself ever appearing to spin.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-resizable-columns-14743
items.description: [Hoverlab] Grab handles straddling the header borders, each widening into a lit guide on hover — with fixed layout and ellipsis so a narrowed column truncates instead of reflowing.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-bulk-action-bar-14771
items.description: [Hoverlab] Action tray that rises over the table once rows are ticked, carrying the count and keeping the destructive option visually apart from the safe one.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-split-flap-14783
items.description: [Hoverlab] Departure-board character cells split across a hinge, the top leaf folding forward on a stagger so the row clatters through left to right.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-squiggle-underline-14811
items.description: [Hoverlab] Wavy rule from two offset arc gradients rather than a wavy text-decoration, which keeps the amplitude and the two colours under direct control at any font size.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-nested-steps-14823
items.description: [Hoverlab] Two-level plan where sub-tasks hang off a rail indented under their parent, each connected by a stub, so progress inside a phase is visible without expanding it.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-delivery-tracker-14851
items.description: [Hoverlab] Parcel progress with the vehicle riding the rail to the current node, both driven by the same easing so the marker and the fill arrive together.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-rotary-knob-14863
items.description: [Hoverlab] Hardware-style control turning through 240 degrees of its detent ring, the pointer riding the body so the value is read where the mark meets the ticks.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-settings-switches-14891
items.description: [Hoverlab] Preference rows where the whole line is the target and the thumb stretches under the pointer before it travels, so the switch feels pressed rather than clicked.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-share-popover-14903
items.description: [Hoverlab] Share sheet pairing a row of destination tiles with the raw link and its copy button, since the link is what most people were reaching for anyway.

items.name: vijetbhat6/ocean-filter-popover-14931
items.description: [Hoverlab] Deferred-commit filter menu — selections stage inside the panel behind reset and apply, with the active count carried on the trigger so it survives closing.

items.name: vijetbhat6/brutalist-shadow-button-14941
items.description: [Hoverlab] Neo-brutalist button with a hard offset shadow that lifts on hover and collapses flat on press.

items.name: vijetbhat6/liquid-rise-button-14943
items.description: [Hoverlab] Outline button that floods from the bottom with a curved liquid crest on hover.

items.name: vijetbhat6/corner-bracket-button-14945
items.description: [Hoverlab] Crosshair-style corner brackets that extend into a complete frame around the label on hover.

items.name: vijetbhat6/roll-label-button-14947
items.description: [Hoverlab] Button label rolls upward on hover and a second line of text rolls in from below.

items.name: vijetbhat6/dot-expand-button-14949

items.name: vijetbhat6/notched-tech-button-14951

items.name: vijetbhat6/spring-squish-button-14959

items.name: vijetbhat6/icon-expand-button-14961
items.description: [Hoverlab] A round plus button that unrolls into a labeled pill on hover while the icon twists.

items.name: vijetbhat6/double-frame-button-14965

items.name: vijetbhat6/tracking-bloom-button-14967

items.description: [Hoverlab] Outline button whose background fills in as five vertical window blinds that widen until they meet.

items.description: [Hoverlab] Full-page style side dots that stretch into a lime bar and brighten their numbered label on hover.
